agriculture.translationZh: 将动物从美国农业中移除会在一定程度上降低国家温室气体排放，但同时也会使满足人们的营养需求变得更加困难。

agriculture.sentenceEn: Many critics of animal agriculture are quick to point out that if farmers raised only plants, they could produce more pounds of food and more calories per person.
agriculture.translationZh: 许多动物农业的批评者很快指出，如果农民只种植植物，他们可以为每个人生产更多磅的食物和更多卡路里。

agriculture.sentenceEn: High-yielding crops have occupied a dominant position in modern agriculture since the green revolution in the last century.
agriculture.translationZh: 自上世纪绿色革命以来，高产作物在现代农业中一直占据主导地位。

agriculture.sentenceEn: He served as chairman of the Nebraska State Board of Agriculture .
agriculture.translationZh: 他曾在 Nebraska 州农业委员会任职。

attract.sentenceEn: Like a major department store in a mall, libraries attract large numbers of people, creating economic opportunities for numerous businesses and organizations in the surrounding area.
attract.translationZh: 图书馆如同商场中的大型百货公司，吸引着大量人群，为周边地区的众多企业和机构创造了经济机会。

attract.sentenceEn: But ultimately the chance to reduce overheads(管理费用) by employing fewer people or at lower rates will be what attracts big brands to technology.
attract.translationZh: 但最终，通过减少雇员数量或降低薪资水平来削减管理费用的机会，才是吸引各大品牌投身技术领域的核心动力。

attract.sentenceEn: Studies have shown that music can reduce stress and anxiety before surgeries and we are all attracted toward our own unique life soundtrack.
attract.translationZh: 研究表明，音乐可以减轻手术前的压力和焦虑，而我们每个人都会被自己独特的人生配乐所吸引。
attract.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第1段，第2句

attract.sentenceEn: With its links to organisational efficiency and employee wellbeing, MRS has attracted the attention of psychologists aware of the need to understand its precise causes and cures.
attract.translationZh: 由于与组织效率和员工福祉息息相关，管理退缩综合征（MRS）引起了心理学家的关注，他们意识到有必要了解其确切成因和解决方法。

attract.sentenceEn: San Francisco city government offered tax benefits to attract tech companies to establish operations in a less developed area.
attract.translationZh: 旧金山市政府提供税收优惠，吸引科技公司在欠发达地区开展业务。

attract.sentenceEn: The narrowing of the gender pay gap attracted more attention.
attract.translationZh: 性别薪酬差距的缩小引起了更多关注。

apply.sentenceEn: So instead, I applied my own eccentric approach.
apply.translationZh: 因此，我转而采用了自己独特的方法。
apply.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第4段，第5句

apply.sentenceEn: The ability to explore, experiment and repeatedly apply new knowledge in unlimited, risk-free models is what makes simulation one of the most productive forms of learning.
apply.translationZh: 能够在无限制、无风险的模型中探索、实验并反复应用新知识，这使模拟成为最高效的学习方式之一。
apply.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第6段，第3句

apply.sentenceEn: To maximize benefits from simulation, participants should immediately apply the learning from the experience to forge a smooth link between learning and doing.
apply.translationZh: 为了充分发挥模拟训练的效益，参与者应立即将从中获得的经验应用于实践，从而在学习与行动之间建立顺畅的联系。
apply.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第7段，第5句

apply.sentenceEn: If they don't, they will view the experience as a game, which can be difficult to apply on the job, or worse, irrelevant to everyday work tasks.
apply.translationZh: 如果不这样做，他们会将这种体验视为游戏，难以应用到工作中，甚至更糟的是，与日常工作任务毫不相关。
apply.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第7段，第4句

apply.sentenceEn: According to Mroz, if all his suggestions were applied , a very obvious change would be a steep decrease in the number of meetings scheduled.
apply.translationZh: 据Mroz称，如果他的所有建议都被采纳，一个非常明显的变化将是预定会议数量的急剧减少。

apply.sentenceEn: Apply promptly what they learn to their jobs.
apply.translationZh: 将所学迅速应用到工作中。

available.sentenceEn: Part of this is because women take on more of the unpaid labor at home, which can eat into time available for work and energy for career advancement.
available.translationZh: 部分原因是女性承担了更多的无偿家务劳动，这会占用她们本可用于工作的时间，消耗她们职业发展所需的精力。
available.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第8段，第1句

available.sentenceEn: It has to do with a hunger for the respect and esteem that is only available in our societies through the acquisition of material goods.
available.translationZh: 这与人们渴望获得尊重和认可有关，而在我们的社会中，这种尊重和认可只能通过获取物质财富来实现。
available.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第6段，第3句

available.sentenceEn: The opposing side agrees that renewables are crucial, but says society needs an amount of power available to meet consumers' basic demands when the sun isn't shining and the wind isn't blowing.
available.translationZh: 反对一方同意可再生能源至关重要，但认为社会需要一定量的电力储备，以满足在没有阳光照耀、没有风吹动时消费者的基本需求。
available.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第3段，第2句

available.sentenceEn: In a 2015 study which examined how thinking about scarcity or abundance influences how creatively people use their resources, Ravi Mehta at the University of Illinois and Meng Zhu at Johns Hopkins University found that people simply have no incentive to use what's available to them in novel ways.
available.translationZh: 2015年的一项研究探讨了对稀缺或充裕的思考如何影响人们创造性地利用资源的方式。伊利诺伊大学的拉维·梅塔和约翰·霍普金斯大学的朱萌发现，人们根本没有动力以新颖的方式利用可用资源。
available.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第3段，第2句

available.sentenceEn: Once completed, all the information will be publicly available to researchers.
available.translationZh: 完成后，所有信息将对研究人员公开可用。
available.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第2段，第3句

available.sentenceEn: Creative people tend to consume more available resources.
available.translationZh: 有创造力的人往往会消耗更多可用资源。

approach.sentenceEn: So instead, I applied my own eccentric approach .
approach.translationZh: 因此，我转而采用了自己独特的方法。
approach.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第4段，第5句

approach.sentenceEn: Over the years, this general approach has proved useful.
approach.translationZh: 多年来，这种通用方法已被证明行之有效。
approach.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第1段，第13句

approach.sentenceEn: It can be tempting in this situation to react harshly to the advice giver and to accuse them of being manipulative, but this approach might produce an undesired result.
approach.translationZh: 在这种情况下，人们往往会忍不住对提建议的人恶语相向，并指责对方在操纵局面，但这种做法可能会产生适得其反的效果。
approach.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第4段，第2句

approach.sentenceEn: About 23,000 of 80,000 species surveyed are approaching extinction.
approach.translationZh: 在接受调查的80,000个物种中，约有23,000个正濒临灭绝。
approach.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第5段，第3句

approach.sentenceEn: How does the speaker approach her research project?
approach.translationZh: 演讲者是如何处理她的研究项目的？

approach.sentenceEn: Reveal the undesired result of their approach .
approach.translationZh: 揭示其方法所导致的不良后果。

aim.sentenceEn: Aim to be out the door and on your way before the second alarm rings.
aim.translationZh: 目标是在第二个闹钟响起前出门上路。
aim.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第3段，第7句

aim.sentenceEn: Unlimited growth is not sustainable, and economic thinking is moving toward the idea that we should aim for sustainability in our economic models.
aim.translationZh: 无限增长是不可持续的，经济思想正朝着我们应当以经济模式可持续性为目标的方向转变。
aim.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第1段，第2句

aim.sentenceEn: The study we're looking at today aims to give us a better understanding of how good electronic books are for young children.
aim.translationZh: 我们今天要研读的这项研究，旨在让我们更好地了解电子书对幼儿的益处。
aim.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第3段，第1句

aim.sentenceEn: Should you always practise serving from the exactly same location on the court, aiming at the same spot?
aim.translationZh: 你是否应该总是站在球场的完全相同位置发球，并瞄准同一个落点？
aim.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第1段，第3句

aim.sentenceEn: What do researchers at a university in Finland aim to do in their new study?
aim.translationZh: 芬兰一所大学的研究人员在他们的新研究中旨在做什么？

aim.sentenceEn: They aim at transforming the behaviors of the workers in an organization.
aim.translationZh: 他们旨在改变组织中员工的行为。

advocate.sentenceEn: An archivist is an advocate for preservation who, among other things, coordinates the restoration of maps and paintings, the digitization of vital records, and the creation of oral history projects.
advocate.translationZh: 档案管理员是保护工作的倡导者，其职责包括协调地图与画作的修复、重要记录的数字化以及口述历史项目的创建等工作。

advocate.sentenceEn: Advocates of the passion principle found it compelling because they believed that following one's passion can provide workers with both the motivation necessary to work hard and a place to find fulfillment.
advocate.translationZh: 激情原则的拥护者认为这一理念极具吸引力，因为他们相信，追随个人激情不仅能为工作者提供努力工作所需的动力，还能为其找到成就感提供途径。
advocate.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第6段，第1句

advocate.sentenceEn: Advocates for the protection of the natural environment from destruction or pollution urge the public to eat less meat.
advocate.translationZh: 倡导保护自然环境免受破坏或污染的人士呼吁公众减少肉类 consumption。

advocate.sentenceEn: A more recent advocate of thoughtful and productive solitude is Susan Cain, author of *Quiet: The Power of Introverts in a World That Can't Stop Talking* and founder of Quiet Revolution, a company that promotes quiet and introvert-friendly workplaces.
advocate.translationZh: 苏珊·凯恩是近年来倡导深思熟虑且富有成效的独处生活的代表人物，她著有《安静：内向性格的竞争力》一书，并创立了“安静革命”组织——一家致力于推广安静且适合内向者的工作环境的公司。

advocate.sentenceEn: As far as it goes, this has much in common with proposals tabled by 'happiness' advocates .
advocate.translationZh: 就此而言，这与“幸福”倡导者提出的建议有许多共同之处。
advocate.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第5段，第1句

advocate.translationZh: 后工作理论家主张什么？

associate.sentenceEn: One 2011 study showed that in branches of a pizza chain where employees were more passive, outgoing bosses were associated with higher profits.
associate.translationZh: 2011年的一项研究显示，在员工较为被动的披萨连锁店分店中，外向的老板与更高的利润相关联。

associate.sentenceEn: He has found that personality traits commonly associated with creativity are openness (receptiveness to new thoughts and experiences), self-confidence, and autonomy—which may include "a lack of concern for social norms" and "a preference for being alone".
associate.translationZh: 他发现，通常与创造力相关的人格特质包括开放性（乐于接受新思想和新体验）、自信心和自主性——其中可能包括“不太在意社会规范”和“喜欢独处”。

associate.sentenceEn: "For example, face recognition is affected by whether people grew up in a small community or in a larger community. Exposure to fewer faces during childhood is associated with diminished face memory."
associate.translationZh: 例如，人脸识别会受到人们成长于小社区还是大社区的影响。童年时期接触的面孔较少与面孔记忆力下降有关。
associate.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第10段，第2句

associate.sentenceEn: The study specifically focused on curiosity levels, which are associated with enhanced learning and higher academic achievement in reading and math at kindergarten, and behavioral-developmental benefits, especially for children from families with lower socioeconomic status.
associate.translationZh: 该研究特别关注了好奇心水平，这种好奇心与幼儿园阶段阅读和数学学习能力的提升、学业成绩的提高有关，并且还具有行为发展方面的益处，尤其对来自社会经济地位较低家庭的儿童而言。
associate.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第2段，第3句

associate.sentenceEn: For people associating their identity with their commitments, quitting can feel like their identity is threatened.
associate.translationZh: 对于那些将身份认同与自身承诺挂钩的人来说，放弃可能会让他们觉得自己的身份受到了威胁。

associate.sentenceEn: They could associate shape with color.
associate.translationZh: 它们能够将形状与颜色联系起来。

audience.sentenceEn: The dazzling cape deployed at the end of the show, for example, bewildered many in the audience .
audience.translationZh: 例如，表演结束时展开的那件耀眼披风让许多观众感到困惑。
audience.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第3段，第2句

audience.sentenceEn: W: Our audience will be most interested in learning about a career in the foreign service.
audience.translationZh: 女：我们的听众会对了解外交领域的事业最感兴趣。
audience.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第3段，第1句

audience.sentenceEn: Motivational speakers will push their audience to be complacent to the inevitable end of losing friends.
audience.translationZh: 励志演讲者会促使他们的听众对失去朋友这一不可避免的结局感到淡然。
audience.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第6段，第4句

audience.sentenceEn: The next account was in 1906, again in the Athens Weekly Banner, again very clearly copying the original account, only slightly reworded, the 19th century equivalent of re-posts when the audience has forgotten about the original.
audience.translationZh: 下一次记载出现在1906年，同样刊登于《雅典每周旗帜报》，同样是对原始记载的明显抄袭，仅做了些许文字修改，这相当于19世纪版的“重新发布”——当读者已经忘记原始内容时的再次分享。

audience.sentenceEn: The alien finds the audience in the movie theatre clearly in a state of ______.
audience.translationZh: 外星人发现电影院里的观众显然处于一种______的状态。

audience.sentenceEn: Classical music aims to evolve, build audiences without alienating old guard
audience.translationZh: 古典音乐旨在革新发展，在不疏远老听众的同时拓展新观众

argument.sentenceEn: Any job that involves people requires good interpersonal skills, and any law professional needs to be very eloquent at articulating that argument .
argument.translationZh: 任何涉及人际交往的工作都需要良好的人际沟通能力，而任何法律专业人士都需要非常善于清晰地阐述论点。
argument.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第11段，第2句

argument.sentenceEn: A key claim underlying these arguments holds that globally, meat production generates more greenhouse gases than the entire transportation sector.
argument.translationZh: 这些论点的一个核心主张认为，在全球范围内，肉类生产产生的温室气体比整个交通运输部门还要多。

argument.sentenceEn: It's hard to make a compelling argument that the United States has a calorie deficit, given its high national rates of adult and child obesity.
argument.translationZh: 鉴于美国成人和儿童肥胖率居高不下，很难让人相信美国存在热量摄入不足的问题。

argument.sentenceEn: Several weeks later they were given one of two research-based texts to read: each was several pages long and either presented the arguments and data in favour of physical punishment or against it.
argument.translationZh: 几周后，他们被要求阅读两篇基于研究的文章中的一篇：每篇文章长达数页，要么阐述支持体罚的论点和数据，要么阐述反对体罚的论点和数据。
argument.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第2段，第3句

argument.sentenceEn: For their arguments to prevail, advocates of free trade must try to forge bonds of affection between consumers at home and producers overseas.
argument.translationZh: 要让自由贸易的主张获得认可，其倡导者必须努力在国内消费者与海外生产者之间建立情感纽带。

argument.sentenceEn: They reject employees' reasonable arguments for work efficiency.
argument.translationZh: 他们拒绝听取员工提出的关于提高工作效率的合理主张。

aspect.sentenceEn: Partly it's to do with money, but there's a psychological aspect to our fears as well.
aspect.translationZh: 部分原因与金钱有关，但我们的恐惧也包含心理层面的因素。
aspect.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第1段，第2句

aspect.sentenceEn: Going against stereotypes, the incorporation of indigenous aspects , along with your underlying signature touch, made this collection a statement of the season.
aspect.translationZh: 突破刻板印象，融入本土元素，再加上您标志性的独特风格，使这个系列成为本季的时尚宣言。
aspect.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第7段，第3句

aspect.sentenceEn: It's a way of concentrating their mind to only focus on the aspects that they need to be working on at the moment, to kind of rid themselves of distractions.
aspect.translationZh: 这是一种集中注意力的方法，让他们只专注于此刻需要处理的事务，从而摆脱各种干扰。
aspect.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第4段，第5句

aspect.sentenceEn: Lectures, training programs and workshops can explain the intellectual elements of transformation, but they are seldom effective at getting to the behavioral aspects that lie at the heart of a significant change initiative.
aspect.translationZh: 讲座、培训项目和研讨会能够阐释变革的理性要素，但在触及重大变革举措核心的行为层面时，往往收效甚微。
aspect.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第5段，第2句

aspect.sentenceEn: The new findings are important because they elaborate our understanding of a subtle but common aspect of our daily experience.
aspect.translationZh: 这些新发现非常重要，因为它们深化了我们对日常生活中一种微妙但却普遍存在的现象的理解。
aspect.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第6段，第2句

aspect.sentenceEn: It involves many aspects with great complexity.
aspect.translationZh: 这涉及多个方面，且极其复杂。

analysis.sentenceEn: For example, an analysis published in 2009 by the World Watch Institute based in Washington, D.C. asserted that 51 percent of global greenhouse gas emissions come from rearing and processing livestock.
analysis.translationZh: 例如，总部位于华盛顿特区的世界观察研究所2009年发表的一项分析断言，全球51%的温室气体排放来自牲畜的饲养和加工。

analysis.sentenceEn: With more truthful analysis of the need for more qualified, diverse educators, we can improve our recruiting, training, and retention strategies for schools across the country.
analysis.translationZh: 通过对高素质、多元化教育者需求进行更真实的分析，我们可以改进全国学校的招聘、培训和留任策略。
analysis.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第6段，第1句

analysis.sentenceEn: But, a new analysis suggests it could actually take more than 1,000 plants per square meter to gain a benefit any greater than simply opening a couple of windows.
analysis.translationZh: 然而，一项新的分析表明，要想获得比仅仅打开几扇窗户更大的益处，实际上每平方米可能需要超过1000株植物。
analysis.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第1段，第2句

analysis.sentenceEn: According to my analysis of data from the Census Bureau, the decline of American motherhood is real, occurring very quickly, and may continue for some time yet.
analysis.translationZh: 根据我对人口普查局数据的分析，美国母亲角色的衰落是真实存在的，其发生速度很快，并且可能还会持续一段时间。
analysis.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第2段，第3句

analysis.sentenceEn: What prevents women from achieving parity with men in the final analysis ?
analysis.translationZh: 归根结底，是什么阻碍了女性与男性实现平等？

analysis.sentenceEn: It is hard to decide on how many people to sit at a lunch table without data analysis .
analysis.translationZh: 若没有数据分析，很难确定午餐餐桌应该安排多少人就座。

athlete.sentenceEn: Although it's usually bad behavior that gets an athlete a spot on the six o'clock news, many high-profile players work hard to be positive role models to children.
athlete.translationZh: 尽管运动员通常是因为不良行为才登上六点钟新闻，但许多备受瞩目的运动员仍努力成为孩子们的正面榜样。
athlete.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第2段，第4句

athlete.sentenceEn: Separating an athlete's professional and personal lives can be tough.
athlete.translationZh: 要将运动员的职业生活和个人生活区分开来并非易事。
athlete.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第3段，第4句

athlete.sentenceEn: Just because an athlete has the perfect golf swing doesn't mean he is the perfect parent, friend or spokesperson.
athlete.translationZh: 运动员拥有完美的高尔夫挥杆动作，并不意味着他就是完美的父母、朋友或代言人。
athlete.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第3段，第2句

athlete.sentenceEn: Athletes are seen as heroes because they can do things that most of us can't do.
athlete.translationZh: 运动员被视为英雄，因为他们能做到大多数人做不到的事情。
athlete.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第1段，第1句

athlete.sentenceEn: Why does the speaker say athletes are often viewed as heroes?
athlete.translationZh: 为什么说话者说运动员常常被视为英雄？

athlete.sentenceEn: It may lead to athletes' over-reliance on equipment.
athlete.translationZh: 这可能会导致运动员过度依赖装备。

advance.sentenceEn: Have all of your notes and materials organized well in advance of each event, so that all you have to do is grab them and go when it's the actual day.
advance.translationZh: 每场活动前都要提前整理好所有笔记和材料，这样到了活动当天，你只需拿起它们就能出发。
advance.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第4段，第2句

advance.sentenceEn: Technological advances and changes in social behavior enable us to make more efficient use of the assets that we already have.
advance.translationZh: 技术进步和社会行为变化使我们能够更高效地利用已有的资源。
advance.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第4段，第3句

advance.sentenceEn: If history is any guide, it's almost certain that advances in AI will cause more jobs to vanish, that creative workers with human-only skills will become richer but fewer in number, and that those who own creative technology will become the new ultra-rich.
advance.translationZh: 如果以史为鉴，几乎可以肯定的是，人工智能的进步将导致更多职位的消失，仅具备人类技能的创意工作者将变得更富有但人数更少，而那些掌握创意技术的人将成为新一代的超级富豪。
advance.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第6段，第1句

advance.sentenceEn: In just the past few years, the peak childbearing age range for American women has advanced from that of 25-29 to that of 30-34.
advance.translationZh: 在过去短短几年间，美国女性的生育高峰年龄段已从25-29岁提前至30-34岁。
advance.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第4段，第1句

advance.sentenceEn: What do we learn about the countryside with industrialisation and technological advances ?
advance.translationZh: 随着工业化和技术进步，我们对农村有了哪些新的认识？

advance.sentenceEn: They advanced a new model concerning human information storage and retrieval.
advance.translationZh: 他们提出了一个关于人类信息存储与检索的新模型。

appeal.sentenceEn: It says a lot, however, that the WHO feels the need to appeal to the economic benefits of improving mental health to persuade governments that the cost of taking proposed measures is justified.
appeal.translationZh: 然而，世界卫生组织认为有必要通过强调改善心理健康所带来的经济效益来说服各国政府，让其相信采取拟议措施的成本是合理的，这一做法本身就很能说明问题。
appeal.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第6段，第5句

appeal.sentenceEn: Personalisation is seen as key to the appeal of this technology, alongside its ability to reliably push so-called "upsells" (meal deals, extras, larger drinks) to customers.
appeal.translationZh: 个性化被视为这项技术的吸引力核心，同时它还能可靠地向客户推送所谓的“追加销售”（如套餐、加餐、大杯饮料）。

appeal.sentenceEn: Tan's job is to create recipes with these still-unfamiliar ingredients that will appeal to both local and international tastes.
appeal.translationZh: 谭的工作是用这些尚不为人熟悉的食材创作出既能吸引本地口味又能满足国际味蕾的食谱。

appeal.sentenceEn: As I was born poor and in the countryside, the simple rural life seldom loses its appeal to me, but as my station changes, I have an opportunity to mingle with the newly rich, an experience which has revolutionized my view of lifestyle.
appeal.translationZh: 我出身贫寒，长在农村，简单的田园生活对我始终有着特殊的吸引力。然而，随着社会地位的变化，我有机会接触到新富阶层，这段经历彻底改变了我对生活方式的看法。
appeal.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第1段，第4句

appeal.sentenceEn: Why does the WHO feel the need to appeal to the economic benefits of improving mental health to justify its recommendations?
appeal.translationZh: 为什么世界卫生组织认为有必要诉诸改善心理健康所带来的经济效益来证明其建议的合理性？

appeal.sentenceEn: They never really appeal to her.
appeal.translationZh: 这些从来没能真正吸引她。

adopt.sentenceEn: According to our research at the University of California, Davis, if the practice of Meatless Monday were to be adopted by all Americans, we'd see a reduction of only 0.5 percent.
adopt.translationZh: 根据我们在加州大学戴维斯分校的研究，如果所有美国人都采用“无肉星期一”的做法，我们只会看到0.5%的减少。

adopt.sentenceEn: Over and above a vastly improved provision of therapeutic mental healthcare, there are preventative measures for improving mental health that governments could and should adopt .
adopt.translationZh: 除了大幅改善治疗性精神卫生服务外，政府还可以而且应该采取一些预防性措施来改善国民心理健康。
adopt.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第6段，第3句

adopt.sentenceEn: It is possible that their emotions were only validated in childhood when they were at their loudest, encouraging them to adopt responses to discomfort that are excessive in most situations.
adopt.translationZh: 这可能是因为他们在童年时期，只有在闹得最凶时情绪才会得到认可，这促使他们养成了一种在大多数情况下都表现得过于激进的不适反应方式。
adopt.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第3段，第2句

adopt.sentenceEn: Because we are creatures of habit, it's natural to assume that when we do manage to adopt and sustain a desirable behavior, that same strategy will work when we want to make another behavior change.
adopt.translationZh: 因为我们是习惯的产物，所以很自然地会认为，当我们成功养成并维持一种理想行为时，同样的策略也适用于我们想要做出的其他行为改变。

adopt.sentenceEn: Without a happy mood, it seems that our wisdom to adopt a different behavior vanishes.
adopt.translationZh: 如果没有愉悦的心情，我们采取不同行为的智慧似乎就会消失。

adopt.sentenceEn: It was adopted by Boston's upper class.
adopt.translationZh: 它被波士顿的上层阶级所采纳。

attend.sentenceEn: New moms connect at baby story-times; elderly people, often facing difficult life transitions, attend events and find that they make new friends; teenagers meet up in libraries' teen spaces after school; and readers discuss current events in the periodicals room.
attend.translationZh: 新手妈妈们通过婴儿故事会相互结识；老年人往往面临艰难的人生转折，他们参加活动并发现自己交到了新朋友；青少年放学后在图书馆的青少年专区相聚；读者们则在期刊阅览室讨论时事。

attend.sentenceEn: Despite the rising costs of concert and theater tickets, public library events (including concerts, author visits, and gallery displays) are often offered free of charge, enabling people of any income level to attend .
attend.translationZh: 尽管音乐会和戏剧门票价格不断上涨，但公共图书馆活动（包括音乐会、作家见面会和画廊展览）往往免费提供，使各收入水平的人都能参与。

attend.sentenceEn: Worrying about whether children attend school makes sense.
attend.translationZh: 担心孩子们是否上学是有道理的。
attend.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第3段，第1句

attend.sentenceEn: In 2015, the U.S. secretary of education responded to this crisis, urging communities to support every student to attend every day and be successful in school.
attend.translationZh: 2015年，美国教育部长针对这一危机作出回应，呼吁各社区支持每一位学生每天到校上课并在学业上取得成功。
attend.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第2段，第2句

attend.sentenceEn: Public libraries organize cultural events, often allowing people of different income levels to attend free of charge.
attend.translationZh: 公共图书馆组织文化活动，通常允许不同收入水平的人免费参加。

attend.sentenceEn: They do not attend conferences where these results are freely available.
attend.translationZh: 他们不会参加那些可以免费获取这些研究结果的会议。

achievement.sentenceEn: It matters less as a cause of lower student achievement due to missed instruction.
achievement.translationZh: 作为因教学缺失导致学生成绩下降的原因，它的重要性相对较低。
achievement.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第9段，第3句

achievement.sentenceEn: As social scientists we investigated how excused and unexcused absences relate to children's academic achievement .
achievement.translationZh: 作为社会科学家，我们研究了正当缺席和非正当缺席与儿童学业成绩之间的关系。
achievement.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第5段，第1句

achievement.sentenceEn: His open letter stated that missing 10% of school days in a year for any reason—excused or unexcused—is a primary cause of low academic achievement .
achievement.translationZh: 他的公开信指出，学生无论因何种原因（无论是有正当理由还是无正当理由）一年内缺课达10%，是学业成绩低下的主要原因。
achievement.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第2段，第3句

achievement.sentenceEn: Children who think effort leads to achievement outperform those who believe ability is a fixed trait.
achievement.translationZh: 认为努力能带来成就的孩子，比那些相信能力是固定特质的孩子表现更出色。
achievement.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第1段，第3句

achievement.sentenceEn: What is American society's assumption of personal achievement ?
achievement.translationZh: 美国社会对个人成就的假设是什么？

achievement.sentenceEn: They are likely to cause a decrease in students' academic achievements due to missed instruction.
achievement.translationZh: 由于错过了教学内容，它们很可能导致学生学业成绩下降。

adapt.sentenceEn: It had been adapted from the railroad signal system by a railway manager, John Peak Knight, in 1868.
adapt.translationZh: 它是由铁路经理约翰·皮克·奈特（John Peake Knight）于 1868 年根据铁路信号系统改装而成的。

adapt.sentenceEn: Even maternity wards use Mozart to help newborn babies adapt to life outside of the mother's belly.
adapt.translationZh: 就连产科病房也会播放莫扎特的音乐，帮助新生儿适应母体外的生活。
adapt.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第4段，第4句

adapt.sentenceEn: Dr. Tim Littlewood, head of Life Sciences Department at the Natural History Museum, said, "Whether you are interested in food or disease, the history of how every organism on the planet has adapted to its environment is recorded in its genetic makeup.
adapt.translationZh: 英国自然历史博物馆生命科学部主任蒂姆·利特尔伍德博士说：“无论你对食物还是疾病感兴趣，地球上每种生物如何适应环境的历史都记录在其基因构成中。”
adapt.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第4段，第1句

adapt.sentenceEn: At each stage my ability to adapt to and develop my career identity has been crucial to my wellbeing.
adapt.translationZh: 在每个阶段，我适应并发展职业身份的能力对我的幸福感至关重要。
adapt.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第3段，第8句

adapt.sentenceEn: According to a professor, when the yields of staple crops fall, we will have to adapt to eating foods from alternative crops.
adapt.translationZh: 一位教授表示，当主粮作物产量下降时，我们将不得不适应食用替代作物的食物。

adapt.sentenceEn: We have to adapt to the ever-changing goal.
adapt.translationZh: 我们必须适应不断变化的目标。

anxiety.sentenceEn: Like many, Charlene experiences climate anxiety —a chronic fear of a climate catastrophe—and was, at the time, looking for an outlet.
anxiety.translationZh: 和许多人一样，夏琳患有气候焦虑症——一种对气候灾难的长期恐惧——并且当时正在寻找一个宣泄的途径。
anxiety.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第2段，第1句

anxiety.sentenceEn: Social withdrawal is usually categorised into three types: shyness caused by fear or anxiety ; avoidance, from a dislike of socialising; and unsociability, from a preference for solitude.
anxiety.translationZh: 社交退缩通常分为三种类型：因恐惧或焦虑引起的羞怯；因不喜社交而产生的回避；以及因偏爱独处而形成的不喜交际。

anxiety.sentenceEn: When someone is giving advice in order to make themselves feel more powerful, there is underlying anxiety to their behavior that recipients of the advice tend to notice.
anxiety.translationZh: 当一个人为了让自己感觉更有权势而提供建议时，其行为背后隐藏着一种焦虑，而这种焦虑往往会被建议的接受者察觉到。
anxiety.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第4段，第1句

anxiety.sentenceEn: Mindfulness has been shown to have a number of meaningful health benefits — it can help reduce anxiety and promote healing in those suffering from chronic illness.
anxiety.translationZh: 研究表明，正念具有诸多显著的健康益处——它能帮助缓解焦虑，并促进慢性病患者的康复。
anxiety.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第1段，第1句

anxiety.sentenceEn: What is the advice receiver tempted to do when noticing the advice giver's underlying anxiety ?
anxiety.translationZh: 当察觉到建议提供者潜在的焦虑时，建议接受者往往会倾向于怎么做？

anxiety.sentenceEn: Anxiety has become a serious problem for an increasing number of people.
anxiety.translationZh: 焦虑已成为越来越多人面临的严重问题。

absence.sentenceEn: We instead suggest using unexcused absence from school as a signal to channel resources to the children and families who need them most.
absence.translationZh: 相反，我们建议将无故缺课作为一种信号，以便将资源导向最需要帮助的儿童和家庭。
absence.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第13段，第1句

absence.sentenceEn: Unexcused absences can be a powerful signal of how those out-of-school challenges affect children's academic progress.
absence.translationZh: 无故缺课能有力地反映出校外挑战对儿童学业进展的影响。
absence.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第8段，第2句

absence.sentenceEn: They also assume that schools will be able to effectively intervene by reducing student absences .
absence.translationZh: 他们还认为，学校能够通过减少学生缺课来进行有效干预。
absence.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第11段，第2句

absence.sentenceEn: Our evidence suggests unexcused absences are problematic, but for a different reason than people often think.
absence.translationZh: 我们的证据表明，无故缺勤确实是个问题，但其原因与人们通常认为的有所不同。
absence.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第9段，第1句

absence.sentenceEn: What do the authors suggest doing regarding school absences ?
absence.translationZh: 作者们对于学校缺勤问题建议做什么？

absence.sentenceEn: Children's academic performance depends on reducing the number of absences .
absence.translationZh: 儿童的学业成绩取决于减少缺勤次数。

agency.sentenceEn: As key municipal agencies , and focal points for community education, libraries are major players in creating livable, environmentally friendly cities and towns.
agency.translationZh: 作为重要的市政机构和社区教育中心，图书馆在创建宜居、环保的城镇方面发挥着重要作用。

agency.sentenceEn: According to the U.S. Environmental Protection Agency , the largest sources of U.S. greenhouse gas emissions in 2016 were electricity production (28 percent of total emissions), transportation (28 percent) and industry (22 percent).
agency.translationZh: 根据美国环境保护署的数据，2016年美国温室气体排放的最大来源是电力生产（占总排放量的28%）、交通运输（28%）和工业（22%）。

agency.sentenceEn: The agency drew a startling conclusion that livestock was doing more to harm the climate than all modes of transportation combined.
agency.translationZh: 该机构得出了一个惊人的结论：畜牧业对气候的危害比所有交通方式加起来还要大。

agency.sentenceEn: Unfortunately, the agency's initial claim that livestock was responsible for the lion's share of world greenhouse gas emissions had already received wide coverage.
agency.translationZh: 不幸的是，该机构最初声称畜牧业是全球温室气体排放的主要来源，这一说法已得到广泛报道。

agency.sentenceEn: What are space agencies and companies aiming to do at present?
agency.translationZh: 目前太空机构和公司的目标是什么？

addition.sentenceEn: In addition , many libraries present classes and discussion programs, and some even provide online continuing education courses such as the Universal Class database.
addition.translationZh: 此外，许多图书馆还提供课程和讨论项目，有些甚至提供在线继续教育课程，如环球课堂数据库。

addition.sentenceEn: In addition , library book groups allow people to explore and discuss the literary arts, and the Great Stories Club introduces at-risk youth to literature.
addition.translationZh: 此外，图书馆读书会让人们能够探索和讨论文学艺术，而“伟大故事俱乐部”则向高危青少年介绍文学作品。

addition.sentenceEn: In addition , Rachel interviewed very well.
addition.translationZh: 此外，雷切尔的面试表现非常出色。
addition.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第5段，第3句

addition.sentenceEn: In addition , introverts tend to have fewer but stronger friendships—which has been linked to greater happiness.
addition.translationZh: 此外，内向者往往拥有较少但更深厚的友谊——这与更高水平的幸福感相关联。

addition.sentenceEn: In addition , it bolsters women's sense that government cares about their concerns and inspires young women to become more politically engaged.
addition.translationZh: 此外，这增强了女性对政府关注其关切的认同感，并激励年轻女性更多地参与政治。
addition.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第2段，第2句

addition.sentenceEn: What do we learn about one of the newest additions to the gallery's collection?
addition.translationZh: 关于美术馆藏品的最新增补之一，我们了解到什么信息？

alternative.sentenceEn: Allowing participants to enter a simulated environment provides them with the opportunity to experience alternative realities which can prompt them to rethink their current beliefs.
alternative.translationZh: 让参与者进入模拟环境，能为他们提供体验另类现实的机会，这可能促使他们重新思考自己当前的信念。
alternative.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第4段，第1句

alternative.sentenceEn: To offset this bias, deliberately refocus your thinking on the gains so you can more objectively weigh the alternatives .
alternative.translationZh: 为了抵消这种偏见，请刻意将思维重新聚焦于收益上，以便更客观地权衡各种替代方案。

alternative.sentenceEn: He came across alternative crops in the 1980s through the work of women farmers he met in Niger.
alternative.translationZh: 20世纪80年代，通过与尼日尔女性农民的接触，他发现了一些替代作物。

alternative.sentenceEn: Researchers are trying to unlock the potential of these ignored crops—plants they describe as forgotten, under-used or " alternative " as they are displaced by increasingly uniform diets fuelled by processed ingredients from the major crops.
alternative.translationZh: 研究人员正试图发掘这些被忽视作物的潜力——他们称这些作物为被遗忘、未被充分利用或"替代"作物，因为在主要作物加工原料推动下日益单一化的饮食结构已经将它们挤出了人们的餐桌。

alternative.sentenceEn: Researchers are trying to find out how higher temperatures and CO₂ levels affect the nutritional composition of alternative crops.
alternative.translationZh: 研究人员正试图查明更高的温度和二氧化碳水平如何影响替代作物的营养成分。

alternative.sentenceEn: They are bent on looking for an alternative space for escape.
alternative.translationZh: 他们一心想要寻找一个可供逃避的另类空间。

attempt.sentenceEn: In a review published in the journal *Trends in Cognitive Sciences* on February 11th, researchers propose an explanation for why this might be happening: the brains of older adults allocate more space to accumulated knowledge and have more material to navigate when attempting to access memories.
attempt.translationZh: 在2月11日发表于《认知科学趋势》期刊的一篇综述中，研究人员对这种现象提出了一种解释：老年人的大脑为积累的知识分配了更多空间，在试图提取记忆时需要处理更多信息。
attempt.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第2段，第1句

attempt.sentenceEn: The fish in our study never attempted to remove the marks when no mirror was present or when the marks were just placed on the mirror.
attempt.translationZh: 在我们的研究中，当没有镜子或标记仅贴在镜面上时，这些鱼从未尝试过去除身上的标记。
attempt.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第2段，第9句

attempt.sentenceEn: And only these animals, capable of self-recognition, will attempt to remove marks placed on their skin after noticing them in the reflection.
attempt.translationZh: 只有这些具备自我识别能力的动物，在注意到镜中映像后，才会尝试清除掉涂抹在皮肤上的标记。
attempt.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第2段，第3句

attempt.sentenceEn: Unmarked fish also did not attempt to remove marks from themselves when interacting with a marked fish on the other side of a window.
attempt.translationZh: 当在窗户另一侧与有标记的鱼互动时，未受标记的鱼也没有尝试清除自己身上的标记。
attempt.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第2段，第10句

attempt.sentenceEn: Unsuccessful attempts in the past are another strong contributing factor to why people don't intervene—they tend to prefer to defer that action to someone else for all future situations.
attempt.translationZh: 过去的失败尝试是人们不愿干预的另一个重要因素——他们往往倾向于在未来所有情况下都将行动推迟给他人。
attempt.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第6段，第4句

attempt.sentenceEn: They attempt to use consumers' long-term memories to promote addiction.
attempt.translationZh: 他们试图利用消费者的长期记忆来加剧成瘾

app.sentenceEn: The cost of hiring a private tutor is well beyond what many library patrons can afford, so libraries offer homework help and tutoring online, by phone, in person, and even through social media and homework apps .
app.translationZh: 聘请私人家教的费用远远超出了许多图书馆用户的承受能力，因此图书馆通过在线、电话、面对面等多种方式提供作业辅导和家教服务，甚至还通过社交媒体和作业应用程序来开展。

app.sentenceEn: Soon when you log into a restaurant app , it will be able to use your data and purchasing history to recommend dishes to you — factoring in everything from the weather to, if you are ordering at a screen that can read your face, your mood.
app.translationZh: 不久之后，当你登录餐厅应用时，系统将能利用你的个人数据和购买历史为你推荐菜肴——它会综合考虑从天气状况到你当前心情的所有因素，如果你是在一个具备面部识别功能的屏幕前下单，系统甚至能读懂你的情绪。

app.sentenceEn: Until then, early adopters, such as the Manchester bar owner Andy Smith, who uses the Ordoo app at his venue 33 Oldham Street, may well experience growing but "lower than expected" acceptance.
app.translationZh: 在此之前，早期的尝试者——比如在自己的 33 Oldham Street 酒吧里使用 Ordoo 应用程序的曼彻斯特酒吧老板安迪·史密斯（Andy Smith）——很可能会经历一个虽然在增长但仍“低于预期”的接受过程。

app.sentenceEn: And scientists here have told me there are plenty of phone apps that will facilitate this.
app.translationZh: 这里的科学家告诉我，有很多手机应用程序可以实现这一点。
app.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第8段，第3句

app.sentenceEn: What do some experts think of fitness apps like Slimmeretics?
app.translationZh: 一些专家如何看待像Slimmeretics这样的健身应用程序？

adolescent.sentenceEn: It is ideal, then, for people to start exercising when they are children or adolescents , and it is good to maintain an active lifestyle at all times regardless of your age.
adolescent.translationZh: 因此，理想的情况是从儿童或青少年时期就开始锻炼，而且无论年龄大小，始终保持积极活跃的生活方式都是非常有益的。
adolescent.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第3段，第7句

adolescent.sentenceEn: M: I went to university and I studied public health and learned about the seriousness of the obesity epidemic, particularly among kids and adolescents in poor communities.
adolescent.translationZh: 男：我上了大学，学习了公共卫生，了解到肥胖症流行的严重性，尤其是在贫困社区的儿童和青少年中。
adolescent.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第6段，第1句

adolescent.sentenceEn: The American Academy of Pediatrics (AAP), which first issued that recommendation back in 1999, has extensively updated and revised its guidelines for children and adolescents to reflect new research and new habits.
adolescent.translationZh: 美国儿科学会(AAP)早在1999年首次提出这一建议，如今已对其儿童和青少年指南进行了全面更新和修订，以反映新的研究成果和新的习惯。
adolescent.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第3段，第1句

adolescent.sentenceEn: Marconi needed to achieve the goal that was set in his mind as an adolescent ; by the time he reached adulthood, he understood, intuitively, that in order to have an impact he had to both develop an independent economic base and align himself with political power.
adolescent.translationZh: 马可尼自青少年时期起心中就确立了一个必须实现的目标；到成年时，他凭直觉明白，要想产生影响力，就必须既建立独立的经济基础，又与政治权力结盟。

adolescent.sentenceEn: But Gigi Luk at Harvard cites at least one brain-imaging study on adolescents that shows similar changes in brain structure when compared with those who are bilingual from birth, even when they didn't begin practicing a second language in earnest before late childhood.
adolescent.translationZh: 但哈佛大学的吉吉·陆引用了至少一项针对青少年的脑成像研究，该研究显示，即使这些青少年在童年后期才开始认真学习第二语言，他们的大脑结构变化也与那些从出生起就接触双语的人相似。

adolescent.sentenceEn: Various programs organized by public libraries for children and adolescents help narrow the gap between students from varying economic backgrounds.
adolescent.translationZh: 公共图书馆为儿童和青少年组织的各类项目有助于缩小不同经济背景学生之间的差距。

artificial.sentenceEn: Along with a couple of classmates, Charlene did a quick web search and discovered a small but growing movement led by the organization, Herbicide-Free Campus (HFC), to rid college campuses of artificial herbicides(灭草剂).
artificial.translationZh: 沙琳和几位同学一起快速搜索了网络，发现了一个由“无除草剂校园”(HFC)组织领导的小型但正在发展壮大的运动，旨在清除大学校园中的人工除草剂。
artificial.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第1段，第3句

artificial.sentenceEn: After the workout, the app's artificial intelligence software system gives feedback from Ms. Weiner and its other 53 million users around the world to adjust future training sessions.
artificial.translationZh: 锻炼结束后，该应用的人工智能软件系统会结合Weiner女士及全球其他5300万用户的反馈，来调整未来的训练课程。
artificial.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第1段，第10句

artificial.sentenceEn: Artificial intelligence, for example, is altering humanity.
artificial.translationZh: 例如，人工智能正在改变人类。
artificial.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第1段，第3句

artificial.sentenceEn: Researchers have identified a potent new antibiotic compound using artificial intelligence.
artificial.translationZh: 研究人员利用人工智能发现了一种强效新型抗生素化合物。
artificial.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第1段，第1句

artificial.sentenceEn: What does the passage say artificial intelligence is able to do in antibiotic research?
artificial.translationZh: 这篇文章称人工智能在抗生素研究中能够做什么？

artificial.sentenceEn: Natural beauty is rarely surpassed by artificial beauty.
artificial.translationZh: 自然之美很少能被人工之美超越。

assert.sentenceEn: They assert that although doing some work might be necessary, meaning, purpose and social value reside in the communities and relationships built and sustained outside of the workplace.
assert.translationZh: 他们认为，尽管从事一些工作可能是必要的，但生活的意义、目标和社会价值存在于工作场所以外建立和维系的社区与人际关系中。
assert.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第6段，第5句

assert.sentenceEn: For example, an analysis published in 2009 by the World Watch Institute based in Washington, D.C. asserted that 51 percent of global greenhouse gas emissions come from rearing and processing livestock.
assert.translationZh: 例如，总部位于华盛顿特区的世界观察研究所2009年发表的一项分析断言，全球51%的温室气体排放来自牲畜的饲养和加工。

assert.sentenceEn: Treating stray dogs with sensitivity and respect, and giving them space, the researchers assert , can reduce much conflict.
assert.translationZh: 研究人员断言，以敏感和尊重的态度对待流浪狗，并给予它们空间，可以大幅减少冲突。
assert.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第3段，第7句

assert.sentenceEn: Yoon asserts cooking is akin to sewing.
assert.translationZh: 尹（Yoon）断言烹饪与缝纫有异曲同工之妙。
assert.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第1段，第7句

assert.sentenceEn: They assert that the behavior is analogous to when people have no choice but to eat alone in the school cafeteria.
assert.translationZh: 他们声称，这种行为就像是人们在学校食堂里别无选择、只能独自用餐的情况一样。
assert.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第5段，第2句

assert.sentenceEn: They assert it will narrow the gap between the wealthy and the poor.
assert.translationZh: 他们声称这将缩小贫富差距。

aware.sentenceEn: Since ancient times, meanwhile, people have been aware of a link between isolation and mental focus.
aware.translationZh: 与此同时，自古以来，人们就意识到独处与精神专注之间存在联系。

aware.sentenceEn: They may not be fully aware of this drive, however.
aware.translationZh: 然而，他们可能并未完全意识到这种驱动力的存在。
aware.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第2段，第2句

aware.sentenceEn: Usually, we are not aware of how we act in conflict situations.
aware.translationZh: 通常，我们并未意识到自己在冲突情况下是如何行动的。
aware.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第1段，第3句

aware.sentenceEn: With its links to organisational efficiency and employee wellbeing, MRS has attracted the attention of psychologists aware of the need to understand its precise causes and cures.
aware.translationZh: 由于与组织效率和员工福祉息息相关，管理退缩综合征（MRS）引起了心理学家的关注，他们意识到有必要了解其确切成因和解决方法。

aware.sentenceEn: So stop drinking coffee by 2 pm and have a maximum of 2 cups of coffee a day, but be aware of your own reaction to it.
aware.translationZh: 所以下午2点前停止喝咖啡，每天最多喝2杯，同时注意观察自己对咖啡的反应。
aware.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第2段，第7句

aware.sentenceEn: Be aware there has never been such a thing as a better or worse person.
aware.translationZh: 要知道，从来没有什么人是更好或更差的。

automation.sentenceEn: But unless changes are made to the structure of work, automation will simply exert downward pressure on wages and further diminish work opportunities.
automation.translationZh: 但除非对工作结构进行改革，否则自动化只会对工资造成下行压力，并进一步减少就业机会。
automation.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第5段，第3句

automation.sentenceEn: Fourth, automation puts jobs and wages at risk.
automation.translationZh: 第四，自动化使就业岗位和工资面临风险。
automation.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第5段，第1句

automation.sentenceEn: " Automation systems designed to make the process more idiot-proof are trying to bridge that gap," says Stefan Chomka, the editor of Restaurant magazine.
automation.translationZh: 《餐厅》杂志编辑斯特凡·乔姆卡表示：“旨在使流程更加简单易用、防止误操作的自动化系统，正试图填补这一空白。”

automation.sentenceEn: "We're urging Members of Parliament to ensure automation does not just benefit a wealthy few like previous industrial revolutions."
automation.translationZh: 我们正敦促国会议员确保自动化进程不会像之前的工业革命那样，仅仅让少数富人受益。

automation.sentenceEn: In an industry keen to slash labor costs and increase profits, further automation seems inevitable.
automation.translationZh: 在一个热衷于大幅削减劳动力成本并增加利润的行业中，进一步实现自动化似乎是必然的。

automation.sentenceEn: What does automation do, according to the passage?
automation.translationZh: 根据文章内容，自动化有什么作用？

awareness.sentenceEn: This ability suggests a level of higher intelligence and awareness .
awareness.translationZh: 这种能力表明其具备较高水平的智力与意识。
awareness.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第2段，第4句

awareness.sentenceEn: The memory bias was unrelated to the measures of how well they'd understood or recalled the text, suggesting these factors didn't play a role in memory of initial belief or awareness of belief change.
awareness.translationZh: 记忆偏差与他们对文本的理解或回忆程度无关，这表明这些因素在初始信念记忆或信念变化意识中并未发挥作用。
awareness.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第3段，第4句

awareness.sentenceEn: And yet a new paper in the Quarterly Journal of Experimental Psychology suggests that we actually have very poor awareness of our own belief change, meaning that we will tend to underestimate how much we've been swayed by a convincing article.
awareness.translationZh: 然而，《实验心理学季刊》上的一项新研究表明，我们实际上对自己的信念变化缺乏清晰的认知，这意味着我们往往会低估自己被一篇有说服力的文章所影响的程度。
awareness.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第1段，第3句

awareness.sentenceEn: The panel found that phonics, along with explicit instruction in phonemic(音位的) awareness , fluency and comprehension, worked best.
awareness.translationZh: 该委员会发现，将自然拼读法与音位意识、阅读流畅度和阅读理解能力的明确教学相结合，效果最佳。
awareness.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第5段，第3句

awareness.sentenceEn: Companies can build customer loyalty by creating a positive culture of environmental awareness .
awareness.translationZh: 企业可以通过营造积极的环保意识文化来建立客户忠诚度。
他们提高了顾客的环保意识。

acquire.sentenceEn: It also includes consciously aspiring to acquire things in your life that will positively impact your sense of well-being.
acquire.translationZh: 它还包括有意识地渴望在生活中获得那些能对幸福感产生积极影响的事物。
acquire.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第2段，第3句

acquire.sentenceEn: The "dark side" of this drive to acquire is being mindlessly driven to possess more and more "things" and to socially compare our "stuff" with all the stuff other people have in their lives.
acquire.translationZh: 这种获取欲的“阴暗面”在于，我们会盲目地被驱使去拥有越来越多的“东西”，并在社交层面上把自己的“物品”与他人生活中的所有物品进行比较。
acquire.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第1段，第3句

acquire.sentenceEn: Each of us, according to research, has an inborn drive to acquire .
acquire.translationZh: 研究表明，我们每个人天生都有获取的欲望。
acquire.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第1段，第2句

acquire.sentenceEn: So the question is, how do we ensure we tap into our drive to acquire in positive ways that will benefit our well-being?
acquire.translationZh: 那么问题来了：我们如何确保以积极的方式利用获取欲，从而促进我们的幸福感呢？
acquire.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第1段，第4句

acquire.sentenceEn: What might happen if we do not harness our inborn drive to acquire ?
acquire.translationZh: 如果我们不利用天生的求知欲，会发生什么？

acquire.sentenceEn: We might acquire an incorrect sense of well-being.
acquire.translationZh: 我们可能会产生一种不正确的幸福感。

advanced.sentenceEn: The character traits held for every kind of community, be they traditional hunter gatherers or advanced civilizations, helping to uphold civilized society and foster social cooperation, researchers found.
advanced.translationZh: 研究人员发现，无论是传统的狩猎采集者群体还是先进文明社会，各类社群都具备一些共同的性格特征，这些特征有助于维护文明社会并促进社会合作。
advanced.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第2段，第3句

advanced.sentenceEn: If we really care about global welfare, globalization is the only way forward to ensure that economic prosperity is shared among all countries and not only a select few advanced economies.
advanced.translationZh: 如果我们真正关心全球福祉，全球化是确保经济繁荣惠及所有国家，而非仅由少数发达经济体独享的唯一途径。
advanced.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第3段，第2句

advanced.sentenceEn: While it is true that globalization has put some downward pressure on middle-class wages in advanced economies in recent decades, it has also helped lift hundreds of millions of people above the global poverty line.
advanced.translationZh: 诚然，近几十年来全球化给发达经济体的中产阶级工资带来了一定下行压力，但它也帮助数亿人摆脱了全球贫困线。
advanced.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第3段，第1句

advanced.sentenceEn: They say that extreme sports can often lead to devastating injuries, especially as young thrill-seekers may attempt feats that are too advanced for them.
advanced.translationZh: 他们认为极限运动往往会导致严重伤害，尤其是年轻的寻求刺激者可能会尝试超出自身能力的高难度动作。
advanced.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第2段，第5句

advanced.sentenceEn: Building connections between farms and major purchasers of their produce can promote African farmers' use of advanced farming techniques.
advanced.translationZh: 建立农场与其农产品主要采购商之间的联系，能够促进非洲农民采用先进的耕作技术。

advanced.sentenceEn: Make use of advanced technologies to improve people's lives.
advanced.translationZh: 利用先进技术改善人们的生活。

aid.sentenceEn: While this wealth of prior knowledge can make memory retrieval challenging, the researchers say it has its upsides—this life experience can aid with creativity and decision-making.
aid.translationZh: 虽然丰富的先前知识会使记忆提取变得困难，但研究人员表示这也有其优势——这些生活经验有助于提升创造力和决策能力。
aid.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第2段，第2句

aid.sentenceEn: In fact, school children in many English-speaking countries are taught to remember the name "Roy G. Biv" as an aid for remembering the colors of a rainbow and their order.
aid.translationZh: 事实上，许多英语国家的学童被教导记住"Roy G. Biv"这个名字，以帮助他们记忆彩虹的颜色及其顺序。
aid.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第2段，第2句

aid.sentenceEn: The pressure is on, so you want all the help you can get to aid your memory and raise your grades.
aid.translationZh: 压力越来越大，所以你会想尽一切办法来帮助记忆，提高成绩。
aid.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第1段，第2句

aid.sentenceEn: The majority of arguments in this vein refer to giving aid to poorer nations but they may also refer to giving time within one's immediate community.
aid.translationZh: 这类观点大多涉及向较贫穷国家提供援助，但也可能包括在个人所在社区投入时间。
aid.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第3段，第4句

aid.sentenceEn: What is an advantage of providing financial aid for students?
aid.translationZh: 为学生提供经济资助有什么好处？

aid.sentenceEn: It has succeeded in maintaining sustainable financial aid programs.
aid.translationZh: 这些院校成功维持了可持续的助学金项目。

assume.sentenceEn: They also assume that schools will be able to effectively intervene by reducing student absences.
assume.translationZh: 他们还认为，学校能够通过减少学生缺课来进行有效干预。
assume.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第11段，第2句

assume.sentenceEn: These policies assume that missing school for any reason harms children academically because they are missing classroom instruction.
assume.translationZh: 这些政策认为，无论何种原因缺课都会对儿童的学业造成负面影响，因为他们错过了课堂教学。
assume.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第11段，第1句

assume.sentenceEn: Whenever the truth is obscure, assuming positive intent and agreeing to move on can be a constructive decision.
assume.translationZh: 当事实真相不明时，假设对方出于善意并同意继续向前，可能是一个建设性的决定。
assume.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第1段，第14句

assume.sentenceEn: We assumed the best about both of them and moved on.
assume.translationZh: 我们把他们两个人都往好处想，然后就没再纠结了。
assume.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第1段，第10句

assume.sentenceEn: It is wrong to assume the strategies we use to start a change of behavior will work equally well in helping maintain it.
assume.translationZh: 认为我们用来启动行为改变的策略同样能有效帮助维持这种改变，这种想法是错误的。

assume.sentenceEn: They assumed the best about them and moved on.
assume.translationZh: 他们往好处想，然后继续前行。

appropriate.sentenceEn: Some airports have sophisticated automated systems, including scanners that read baggage labels, destination-coded vehicles that load and unload the bags without stopping, and sorting machines that route baggage to the appropriate gate.
appropriate.translationZh: 部分机场配备了先进的自动化系统，包括读取行李标签的扫描仪、无需停顿即可装卸行李的目的地代码自动传送车，以及将行李分拣至对应登机口的自动分拣机。
appropriate.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第2段，第5句

appropriate.sentenceEn: I personally think they're perfectly appropriate .
appropriate.translationZh: 我个人认为它们是非常合适的。
appropriate.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第5段，第2句

appropriate.sentenceEn: Even so, this idea of a standard accent is influential and many workplace and educational environments perpetuate the idea that accents that deviate from the current standard are less appropriate , or even inappropriate.
appropriate.translationZh: 即便如此，这种标准口音的概念依然具有影响力，许多职场和教育环境都在强化这样一种观念：即偏离现有标准的口音是不够得体、甚至是不合时宜的。
appropriate.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第4段，第1句

appropriate.sentenceEn: The evolution of traffic light signals could not have a more appropriate context than Motor City.
appropriate.translationZh: 交通信号灯的演进，没有比在‘汽车之城’更合适的背景了。

appropriate.sentenceEn: Instead, you need to recognise when circumstances have changed, so you can take appropriate action based on what is, rather than how you wish the world would be.
appropriate.translationZh: 相反，你需要认识到情况何时发生了变化，以便能够根据实际情况采取适当行动，而非基于你对世界的期望。
appropriate.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第1段，第9句

appropriate.sentenceEn: It is imperative to have appropriate titles to explain scientific issues.
appropriate.translationZh: 为科学问题提供恰当的解释说明至关重要。

assess.sentenceEn: W: So how should managers go about assessing young people's productivity?
assess.translationZh: 女：那么，管理者应该如何评估年轻人的生产力呢？
assess.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第9段，第1句

assess.sentenceEn: With a written list in hand, you can ensure you focus on what you can control and better assess whether your continued efforts are worth the expense.
assess.translationZh: 手写一份清单，可以确保你专注于自己能够掌控的事情，并能更好地评估你持续付出的努力是否值得。
最后，对收入水平进行了评估。
assess.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第2段，第7句

assess.sentenceEn: Researchers assessed hours of daily television exposure and frequency of parent-screen-time conversation among 1,500 preschoolers, and then measured early childhood curiosity in kindergarten.
assess.translationZh: 研究人员评估了1500名学龄前儿童的每日电视接触时长和父母-屏幕时间对话频率，随后测量了这些儿童在幼儿园时期的早期好奇心。
assess.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第2段，第2句

assess.sentenceEn: The total amount of damage to Notre Dame Cathedral can be assessed only when its structure is considered safe.
assess.translationZh: 只有当巴黎圣母院的建筑结构被认为安全后，才能评估其全部受损情况。

assess.sentenceEn: Its consequences are usually difficult to assess .

association.sentenceEn: Offered by libraries across the country, American Library Association's Let's Talk about It programs are wonderful examples of scholar-facilitated learning opportunities in libraries.
association.translationZh: 由全国各地图书馆提供的美国图书馆协会“让我们讨论”项目，是图书馆内由学者主持的学习机会的绝佳范例。

association.sentenceEn: While the mechanisms behind these associations are not fully understood, Monteiro argues that the existing evidence is sufficient to justify discouraging consumption of ultra-processed foods in dietary recommendations and government policies.
association.translationZh: 虽然这些关联背后的机制尚未完全明确，但蒙泰罗认为现有证据已足以支持在膳食建议和政府政策中劝阻超加工食品消费。
association.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第4段，第2句

association.sentenceEn: But, because of the strong emotional associations these memories evoke, people who remember something due to a scent are often convinced that the memories are accurate, even when they aren't.
association.translationZh: 但是，由于这些记忆会唤起强烈的情感联想，那些因气味而记起某事的人往往坚信这些记忆是准确的，即便事实并非如此。
association.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第5段，第4句

association.sentenceEn: This problem is highlighted by new research conducted by the American Heart Association .
association.translationZh: 美国心脏协会开展的新研究凸显了这一问题。
association.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第1段，第4句

association.sentenceEn: But they are a constant source of human anxieties—with a cultural association with witches and wickedness dating back to the middle ages.
association.translationZh: 但它们始终是人类焦虑的源头——这种文化上与女巫和邪恶的关联可追溯至中世纪。
association.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第2段，第6句

association.sentenceEn: What did the new research by the American Heart Association find?

ahead.translationZh: 为即将到来的一天做好准备。

ahead.sentenceEn: "Restaurants will prepare food ahead of orders coming in," predicts Just Eat's director of engineering, Daniel Richardson.

ahead.sentenceEn: It does not mean full-throttle(全速) ahead .
ahead.translationZh: 这并不意味着要全速前进。

ahead.sentenceEn: We strive for perfection, it seems, because we feel we must in order to get ahead .
ahead.translationZh: 看来，我们追求完美是因为我们觉得为了取得成功必须如此。

ahead.sentenceEn: Or they might handicap their performance ahead of time.
ahead.translationZh: 或者他们可能会提前为自己的表现设置障碍。

ahead.sentenceEn: Despite consumer resistance, researchers are pushing ahead with genetic modification of crops.
ahead.translationZh: 尽管消费者存在抵触情绪，研究人员仍在推进农作物的基因改造工作。

attack.sentenceEn: This is no wonder, when the news focuses on reporting catastrophes, terrorist attacks , wars, and famines.
attack.translationZh: 这不足为奇，因为新闻总是聚焦于报道灾难、恐怖袭击、战争和饥荒。
attack.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第1段，第2句

attack.sentenceEn: The crop was attacked by pests.
It was easy to feel depressed by the wars in different parts of the world, the spread of deadly viruses or terror attacks .

attack.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第1段，第2句

attack.sentenceEn: While these attacks are motivated by misguided ideas, we need to do a better job of explaining why these claims are false and why what we do is valuable.
attack.translationZh: 尽管这些抨击源于一些错误的观念，但我们仍需更好地阐明为何这些说法与事实不符，以及我们所做工作的价值所在。
attack.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第4段，第1句

attack.sentenceEn: Merian's masterpiece came under attack a century after its publication.

attack.sentenceEn: They have been constantly attacked for being too elite and too expensive.
attack.translationZh: 这些院校一直因过于精英化且费用过高而备受抨击。

agricultural.sentenceEn: According to the FAO, as much as 70 percent of all agricultural land globally is range land that can only be utilized as grazing land for ruminant livestock.
agricultural.translationZh: 根据联合国粮农组织（FAO）的数据，全球高达70%的农业用地是牧场，只能用作反刍家畜的放牧地。

agricultural.sentenceEn: Other than CFF, which bills itself as the world's first research centre dedicated solely to under-utilised crops, there are other key groups championing agricultural diversity including Crop Trust, Slow Food, Icrisat and Bioversity International.
agricultural.translationZh: 除了自称是全球首个专门致力于未充分利用作物研究的中心CFF外，还有其他一些倡导农业多样性的重要组织，包括作物信托基金会、慢食协会、国际半干旱热带作物研究所和国际生物多样性中心。

agricultural.sentenceEn: Victims of erosion lose their houses, agricultural land and jobs as farmers, fishermen and day laborers.
agricultural.translationZh: 土地侵蚀的受害者失去了房屋、农田以及作为农民、渔民和日工的生计。

agricultural.sentenceEn: These included measures to reduce air pollution; to control the damage to marine ecosystems, which can have a huge effect on fish stocks on which hundreds of millions of people depend; and to curb the degradation of land where modern agricultural methods were pursued without regard to the longer-term consequences.
agricultural.translationZh: 这些措施包括减少空气污染；控制对海洋生态系统的破坏——这可能对亿万人口赖以生存的鱼类资源产生巨大影响；以及遏制土地退化，这种退化源于不顾长远后果而推行现代农业方法的行为。
agricultural.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第5段，第2句

agricultural.sentenceEn: To their credit, the world's agricultural scientists are embracing such a broad view.
agricultural.translationZh: 值得称赞的是，全球农业科学家正秉持这种广阔视野。
agricultural.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第4段，第1句

agricultural.sentenceEn: It is said that agricultural productivity in many African countries has remained low for a century.
agricultural.translationZh: 据说，非洲许多国家的农业生产力一个世纪以来一直很低。

analyze.sentenceEn: The problem was that analysts from the FAO used a comprehensive life-cycle assessment to study the climate impact of livestock, but a different method when they analyzed transportation.
analyze.translationZh: 问题在于，联合国粮农组织(FAO)的分析师在研究畜牧业对气候的影响时使用了全面的生命周期评估方法，而在分析交通运输时却采用了另一种不同的方法。

analyze.sentenceEn: The researchers also calculated the clean air delivery rate for plants in the studies they analyzed and found that the rate at which plants disperse the compounds was well below the usual rate of air exchange in a normal building, caused by the movement of people coming and going, opening doors and windows.
analyze.translationZh: 研究人员还计算了他们所分析研究中植物的洁净空气输送率，发现植物驱散化合物的速率远低于普通建筑物中通常的空气交换率，后者是由人员往来、门窗开关等活动引起的。
analyze.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第3段，第4句

analyze.sentenceEn: The team accessed the world's best archives to analyze accounts from more than 600 sources of 60 societies around the world.
analyze.translationZh: 该团队查阅了全球最优质的档案，对来自世界60个社会600多个来源的记录进行了分析。
analyze.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第3段，第2句

analyze.sentenceEn: He used data science to analyze historical trends.
analyze.translationZh: 他运用数据科学分析历史趋势。
analyze.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第4段，第2句

analyze.sentenceEn: What did researchers from an American university analyze in their initial study?
analyze.translationZh: 美国一所大学的研究人员在其初步研究中分析了什么？

analyze.sentenceEn: Its root cause should be meticulously examined and analyzed .
analyze.translationZh: 其根本原因应当被仔细审视和分析。

antibiotic.translationZh: 答案就是抗生素耐药性。
antibiotic.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第2段，第3句

antibiotic.sentenceEn: This makes finding new antibiotics very important.
antibiotic.translationZh: 因此，寻找新型抗生素变得至关重要。
antibiotic.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第2段，第6句

antibiotic.sentenceEn: Some experts assert that this work signifies a paradigm shift in antibiotic discovery.
antibiotic.translationZh: 一些专家认为，这项研究标志着抗生素发现领域的范式转变。
antibiotic.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第2段，第16句

antibiotic.sentenceEn: Antibiotic resistance is a serious threat to health and the problem is growing.
antibiotic.translationZh: 抗生素耐药性对健康构成严重威胁，且这一问题日益加剧。
antibiotic.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第2段，第5句

antibiotic.sentenceEn: What makes it important to find new antibiotic drugs?
antibiotic.translationZh: 为什么寻找新的抗生素药物如此重要？

application.sentenceEn: There are now many computer, online, and mobile device applications that claim to be able to "train your brain," and they typically tap into a variety of cognitive abilities.
application.translationZh: 现在有许多电脑、在线和移动设备应用程序声称能够“训练你的大脑”，它们通常会开发各种认知能力。

application.sentenceEn: We often mistake this automatic compatibility testing of new ideas with existing beliefs as an application of common sense, but, in reality, it is more about judging than thinking.
application.translationZh: 我们常常将这种新观点与既有信念之间的自动兼容性检验误认为是运用常识，但实际上，这更多是判断而非思考。
application.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第3段，第1句

application.sentenceEn: Applications are at record highs, and their financial aid programs make them more accessible than ever.
application.translationZh: 申请人数创下历史新高，而它们的助学金项目也使这些学校比以往任何时候都更容易进入。
application.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第2段，第2句

application.sentenceEn: Companies sometimes offer candidates the chance to disclose disabilities on their application form, but people shouldn't feel restricted by this method or timing.
application.translationZh: 有些公司会在申请表中提供残疾情况披露选项，但求职者不应受这种方式或时机的限制。
application.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第4段，第1句

application.sentenceEn: What may result from increasing application of recommendation engines in our consumption of culture?
application.translationZh: 推荐引擎在我们的文化消费中应用日益广泛，可能会产生什么结果？

application.sentenceEn: Provide incentives for the application of creative passwords.
application.translationZh: 为创意密码的应用提供激励措施。

accelerate.sentenceEn: An effective simulation can be better than experience as a learning tool because it accelerates time, compresses space, and unlike reality, is specifically designed to maximize participant learning.
accelerate.translationZh: 作为一种学习工具，有效的模拟可能比实际经验更优越，因为它能加速时间、压缩空间，而且与现实不同，模拟是专门为最大限度提升参与者学习效果而设计的。
accelerate.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第6段，第1句

accelerate.sentenceEn: With population increases and global urbanisation ever accelerating , much attention is focused on the sustainability of our cities and scarce attention is paid to the countryside.
accelerate.translationZh: 随着人口增长和全球城市化进程的不断加速，人们的注意力大多集中在城市的可持续发展上，而对农村地区的关注则少之又少。
accelerate.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第1段，第1句

accelerate.sentenceEn: The moves in China coincide with accelerating efforts in the U.S. and Europe to rein in Amazon.com, Apple, Facebook, and Google.
accelerate.translationZh: 中国的这些举措与美国和欧洲加大力度管控亚马逊、苹果、脸书和谷歌的行动不谋而合。
accelerate.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第2段，第3句

accelerate.sentenceEn: What this means: aging is a dynamic process that could possibly be accelerated or slowed—and, in some aspects, even reversed.
accelerate.translationZh: 这意味着：衰老是一个动态过程，它可能会加速或减缓——在某些方面甚至可以逆转。
accelerate.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第4段，第1句

accelerate.sentenceEn: The deterioration of the ecological system is accelerating because of the dramatic increase of human production and consumption.
accelerate.translationZh: 由于人类生产和消费的急剧增长，生态系统的恶化正在加速。

accelerate.sentenceEn: It would accelerate the progress of AI research.
accelerate.translationZh: 它将加速人工智能研究的进展。

accessible.sentenceEn: Improved travel connections and affordability have made the world more accessible , creating a "global village".
accessible.translationZh: 交通连接的改善和出行成本的降低让世界变得更加触手可及，形成了一个“地球村”。
accessible.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第5段，第4句

accessible.sentenceEn: As technology renders the seabed more accessible , the hunt for treasure-filled ships has drawn a fresh tide of salvors(打捞人员) and their investors—as well as marine archaeologists(考古学家) wanting to bring to light the lost relics.
accessible.translationZh: 随着技术使海底更易于探测，对满载宝藏船只的搜寻吸引了新一波打捞人员及其投资者——还有希望让这些失落遗迹重见天日的海洋考古学家。

accessible.sentenceEn: But this can be resolved by researchers engaging the services of professional writers or communication officers to help with translating their study into more accessible language and share it widely with media outlets and the public.
accessible.translationZh: 但研究人员可以通过聘请专业撰稿人或传播专员来解决这个问题，他们能将研究内容转化为更通俗易懂的语言，并通过媒体渠道广泛传播给公众。
accessible.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第11段，第2句

accessible.sentenceEn: To benefit both researchers and the communities, the need to find innovative, accessible ways to share the work cannot be overstated.
accessible.translationZh: 为了使研究人员和社区双方受益，寻找创新且易于理解的方式来分享研究成果的重要性怎么强调都不为过。
accessible.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第8段，第1句

accessible.sentenceEn: AMSAT operates on the principle of having all its technical data accessible to its members, preventing the abuse of amateur satellites.
accessible.translationZh: AMSAT 奉行所有技术数据对其成员开放获取的原则，以防止业余卫星被滥用。

accessible.sentenceEn: Cosmetic surgery should be made more accessible to the masses.
accessible.translationZh: 整容手术应该让更多大众能够负担和获取。

annual.sentenceEn: Annual summer reading programs also have a positive impact on student performance and, according to a 2010 study conducted by Dominican University's Graduate School of Library and Information Science, students' reading skills get a boost from these popular nationwide events.
annual.translationZh: 年度暑期阅读计划对学生表现也有积极影响。根据多米尼加大学图书馆与信息科学研究生院2010年的一项研究，这些在全国范围内广受欢迎的活动有助于提高学生的阅读能力。

annual.sentenceEn: In 2015, average annual meat consumption per person in developed countries was 92 kilograms, compared to 24 kilograms in the Middle East and North Africa and 18 kilograms in Southeast Asia.
annual.translationZh: 2015年，发达国家人均年肉类消费量为92公斤，而中东和北非地区为24公斤，东南亚地区为18公斤。

annual.sentenceEn: In both groups, the researchers found the closer a town's average annual temperature was to 22 degrees, the more its population exhibited those personality characteristics.
annual.translationZh: 在两组人群中，研究人员发现，一个城镇的年平均气温越接近22度，该城镇的居民就越明显地表现出这些性格特征。
annual.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第4段，第7句

annual.sentenceEn: A city with an average annual temperature closer to 22 tends to have a population who are more agreeable, conscientious, emotionally stable, and outgoing.
annual.translationZh: 年均气温接近22摄氏度的城市，其居民往往更随和、更有责任心、情绪更稳定且更外向。
annual.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第1段，第4句

annual.sentenceEn: W: How did your annual performance evaluation meeting with your manager go?
annual.translationZh: 你和经理的年度绩效评估会议怎么样了？
annual.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第1段，第1句

annual.sentenceEn: Their annual death rate is about twice that of the global average.
annual.translationZh: 泰国的年道路死亡率几乎是全球平均水平的两倍。

additional.sentenceEn: You must take into account whether all members of the family truly enjoy visitors, want to repeatedly discuss local sites and activities, and have the time and energy to handle the additional cooking, cleaning, laundry and the bookkeeping involved.
additional.translationZh: 你必须考虑到家里的所有成员是否真的喜欢有客人来访，是否愿意反复讨论当地的景点和活动，以及是否有时间和精力去应付额外增加的烹饪、清洁、洗涤和相关的账目开支。
additional.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第3段，第6句

additional.sentenceEn: Ask yourself: What additional strengths do I have (or aspire to have) that would be helpful to employ here?
additional.translationZh: 问问你自己：我还拥有（或渴望拥有）哪些额外的优势，可以在此处派上用场？

additional.sentenceEn: But note also the delicious additional irony that the Captcha is described as an "automated Turing test".
additional.translationZh: 但请注意，还有一个极具讽刺意味的细节：验证码被描述为一种“自动图灵测试”。
additional.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第4段，第2句

additional.sentenceEn: All 50 states recognize the April observance, although many hold an additional state Arbor Day in a month more suited to local tree planting.
additional.translationZh: 美国所有50个州都认可这一四月的庆祝活动，但许多州还会在更适合当地植树的月份额外举办州级植树节。
additional.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第5段，第2句

additional.sentenceEn: Additional protein was found to help strengthen the muscles of overweight seniors seeking weight loss.
additional.translationZh: 研究发现，补充蛋白质有助于增强寻求减重的超重老年人的肌肉力量。

additional.sentenceEn: It may make household appliances serve an additional air cleaner function.
additional.translationZh: 它能使家用电器兼备空气净化器的功能。

alter.sentenceEn: But again, these altered menu designs backfired with those who ate vegetarian food more frequently, leading them to be less likely to choose a vegetarian dish.
alter.translationZh: 但同样地，这些改动后的菜单设计在那些经常吃素的人群中起到了反作用，导致他们选择素食的可能性降低了。
alter.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第2段，第8句

alter.sentenceEn: The system defines ultra-processed foods as those made using sequences of processes that extract substances from foods and alter them with chemicals in order to formulate the final product.
alter.translationZh: 该系统将超加工食品定义为：通过一系列加工过程从食物中提取物质，并使用化学物质对其进行改造以形成最终产品的食品。
alter.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第3段，第2句

alter.sentenceEn: However, our beliefs on most topics are in the moderate range, and as we go about our daily lives reading informative material, these intriguing findings suggest we are mostly ignorant of how what we just read has updated and altered our own position.
alter.translationZh: 然而，我们对大多数话题的看法都处于温和范围，而当我们在日常生活中阅读信息性材料时，这些有趣的研究结果表明，我们大多不知道刚刚阅读的内容如何更新和改变了我们自己的立场。
alter.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第4段，第2句

alter.sentenceEn: Artificial intelligence, for example, is altering humanity.
alter.translationZh: 例如，人工智能正在改变人类。
alter.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第1段，第3句

alter.sentenceEn: How do altered menu designs affect frequent eaters of vegetarian food?
alter.translationZh: 菜单设计的改变如何影响素食常客？
