attach.sentenceEn: It seems today that people are terrified of the term, particularly of having the label attached to them.
attach.translationZh: 如今，人们似乎对这个词感到恐惧，尤其是害怕被贴上这个标签。
attach.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第1段，第2句

attach.sentenceEn: It has gotten to the point that many women are afraid to call themselves feminists because of the stigma attached to the word.
attach.translationZh: 如今，情况已发展到许多女性因为“女权主义者”这个词所背负的污名而不敢自称女权主义者。
attach.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第3段，第1句

attach.sentenceEn: Schools or teachers who sign up for the National Math Club receive a kit full of activities and resources, but there's no special teacher training and no competition attached .
attach.translationZh: 报名参加全国数学俱乐部的学校或教师会收到一套包含各种活动和资源的工具包，但不会获得专门的教师培训，也没有附加的竞赛。

attach.sentenceEn: There are also dozens of summer camps—many attached to universities—that aim to prepare elite math students.
attach.translationZh: 此外，还有数十个暑期夏令营——其中许多附属于大学——旨在培养精英数学学生。

attach.sentenceEn: Employers attach more importance to applicants' computer skills than their language competence.
attach.translationZh: 雇主更重视申请人的计算机技能而非语言能力。

attach.sentenceEn: They attach little importance to recipes.

attribute.sentenceEn: Mississippi's success is attributed to implementing reading methods supported by a body of research known as the science of reading.
attribute.translationZh: 密西西比州的成功归功于实施了一套阅读教学方法，这套方法得到了被称为'阅读科学'的大量研究的支持。
attribute.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第5段，第1句

attribute.sentenceEn: It is characterized by two main attributes : not being satisfied by eating, and having a desire to stay sedentary(久坐不动的).
attribute.translationZh: 这种现象有两个主要特征：进食无法带来满足感，以及渴望久坐不动。
attribute.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第1段，第5句

attribute.sentenceEn: Gender inequality in science is often attributed to the fact that senior academics are more likely to be male, because historically science was male-dominated: it's argued that as time goes on and more women rise to senior roles, the field will become more equal.
attribute.translationZh: 科学界的性别不平等常常被归因于资深学者更可能是男性这一事实，因为从历史上看，科学领域一直由男性主导：有人认为，随着时间推移以及更多女性晋升到高级职位，该领域将变得更加平等。
attribute.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第6段，第1句

attribute.sentenceEn: The second cause was attributed to the managers' characteristics.
attribute.translationZh: 第二个原因与管理者的个人特质有关。
attribute.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第4段，第1句

attribute.sentenceEn: What does the author say Mississippi's success is attributed to?
attribute.translationZh: 作者认为密西西比州的成功归功于什么？

attribute.sentenceEn: Low academic achievement is mainly attributed to school absences.
attribute.translationZh: 学业成绩低下主要归因于缺课。

abandon.sentenceEn: However, abandoning meat and meat products is not the environmental panacea(万灵药) many would have us believe.
abandon.translationZh: 然而，放弃肉类及肉制品并非许多人所认为的环境万灵药。

abandon.sentenceEn: We are all susceptible to the sunk-cost delusion, an unconscious bias that leads us to persist in an endeavor we have already invested time, effort, or money into — even when abandoning it would be more beneficial.
abandon.translationZh: 我们都容易受到沉没成本谬误的影响。这是一种无意识的偏见，促使我们坚持投入了时间、精力或金钱的事业——即便放弃它会更有利。

abandon.sentenceEn: Ryan had invested two years and a lot of effort in a design project that wasn't delivering the needed outcomes, but the thought of abandoning it after all she had put in was hard to bear.
abandon.translationZh: 莱恩在一个设计项目上投入了两年的时间和大量心血，但该项目一直没有达到预期的成果。即便如此，想到要放弃自己付出这么多努力的项目，她仍感到难以割舍。

abandon.sentenceEn: The perfectionist in you might be screaming to abandon your goals altogether, but try to see it in the bigger picture.
abandon.translationZh: 你内心的完美主义可能在尖叫着让你彻底放弃目标，但不妨从更宏观的角度来看待这件事。

abandon.sentenceEn: What would cause you to abandon it?
abandon.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第3段，第3句

abandon.sentenceEn: One need not abandon their goals completely just because they missed their target temporarily; they can start anew.
abandon.translationZh: 不必因为暂时未达成目标就完全放弃，人们可以重新开始。

admit.sentenceEn: Nicole admitted she was fortunate, as she was able to live with her parents and overhaul her spending—and life—to get herself on track financially.
admit.translationZh: 妮可承认自己很幸运，因为她可以和父母同住，并彻底调整自己的消费方式——乃至整个生活——以让自己的财务状况回到正轨。
admit.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第4段，第1句

admit.sentenceEn: He also admits that if he had children of his own, he would encourage them to take music lessons and go to university.
admit.translationZh: 他也承认，如果他有自己的孩子，他会鼓励他们上音乐课和读大学。

admit.sentenceEn: Whether policymakers and politicians admit it or not, workers have made clear their feelings about their economic insecurity and desire to keep good jobs in America.
admit.translationZh: 无论政策制定者和政客们是否承认，工人们已经明确表达了他们对经济不安全的感受，以及希望在美国保住好工作的愿望。
admit.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第4段，第5句

admit.sentenceEn: When confronted with an uncomfortable set of facts, the tendency is often to double down on their current position rather than publicly admit to being wrong.
admit.translationZh: 当面对一系列令人不安的事实时，人们往往会更加坚定自己当前的立场，而不是公开承认错误。

admit.sentenceEn: The FAO was worthy of praise in that it admitted its mistake once it was pointed out.
admit.translationZh: 粮农组织在错误被指出后能够承认错误，这一点值得称赞。

admit.sentenceEn: They admit more students than they can handle.
admit.translationZh: 这些大学招收的学生数量超出了其所能容纳的范围。

affordable.sentenceEn: In Cleveland, an African-American inventor named Garrett Morgan came up with an affordable , patented traffic signal.
affordable.translationZh: 在克利夫兰，一位名叫加勒特·摩根的非裔美国发明家构思出一种价格低廉且拥有专利的交通信号灯。

affordable.sentenceEn: Ford made cars affordable for more common people, rather than the wealthy, by creating larger scale factory production.
affordable.translationZh: 福特通过大规模工厂化生产，使汽车变得更加平民化，让普通大众而非少数富人也能负担得起。

affordable.sentenceEn: By doing so, we will be able to build affordable housing within acceptable commuting distances for a significant bulk of the workforce.
affordable.translationZh: 通过这样做，我们将能够为大部分劳动力在可接受的通勤距离内建造经济适用房。

affordable.sentenceEn: If contributing factors leading to housing becoming less than affordable are not resolved over multiple generations, a small elite will control a vast share of the country's total wealth.
affordable.translationZh: 如果导致住房难以负担的促成因素在几代人的时间里得不到解决，一小部分精英阶层将控制国家总财富的绝大部分。

affordable.sentenceEn: Tiny colleges must be made affordable in order to play a role in higher education.
affordable.translationZh: 微型学院要想在高等教育领域发挥作用，就必须做到经济实惠。

affordable.sentenceEn: A vacation will be affordable if one saves 20 dollars a week.
affordable.translationZh: 如果每周存20美元，度假就不再是奢望。

apart.sentenceEn: Apart from the AI creativity gap, great cooking involves a subtle understanding of ingredients and delicate cooking that would be enormously challenging for robots.
apart.translationZh: 除了 AI 在创造力方面的差距外，精湛的烹饪还涉及对食材的细微理解和精细的烹饪技巧，而这对于机器人来说将是极大的挑战。

apart.sentenceEn: This is how Tocqueville—rather pessimistically—describes us: Each, standing apart , is like a stranger to the destiny of others; his children and personal friends forming for him the entire human race.
apart.translationZh: 这就是托克维尔——带着几分悲观——对我们的描述：每个人都独立存在，对他人的命运漠不关心；对他而言，子女和私人朋友便构成了他的全部人类世界。

apart.sentenceEn: To see these values coming apart so publicly adds insult to injury for a region once defined by its progressive social fabric.
apart.translationZh: 对于这个曾经以进步社会结构为特征的地区而言，眼睁睁看着这些价值观如此公开地崩塌，无疑是雪上加霜。

apart.sentenceEn: Most people that age think the same thing, but people drift apart .
apart.translationZh: 大多数那个年纪的人都这么想，但人们终究会渐行渐远。
apart.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第1段，第8句

apart.sentenceEn: What gives rise to our worry about careers apart from money?
apart.translationZh: 除了金钱之外，还有什么让我们对职业感到担忧？

apart.sentenceEn: It is what tells apart two adjacent generations.
apart.translationZh: 正是这种对抗重复性的努力，让相邻的两代人彼此区别开来。

assign.sentenceEn: Each parent-child pair was randomly assigned to read either two educational electronic books or two printed books with the same content.
assign.translationZh: 每对家长和孩子被随机分配阅读两本电子教育书籍，或两本内容相同的纸质书。
assign.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第3段，第3句

assign.sentenceEn: And the most valuable kind of homework for elementary-level children was simply assigned free reading.
assign.translationZh: 而对小学生最有价值的家庭作业，其实就是老师布置的自由阅读。
assign.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第2段，第3句

assign.sentenceEn: Studies found that in remote areas, the poor quality or lack of internet access can put students at a disadvantage because 70% of teachers in these areas assign homework that requires internet access.
assign.translationZh: 研究发现，在偏远地区，互联网接入质量差或缺乏互联网会使学生处于不利地位，因为这些地区70%的教师布置的家庭作业需要联网完成。
assign.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第3段，第2句

assign.sentenceEn: The author, composer and psychologist Glenn Schellenberg had conducted an experiment with 144 children randomly assigned to four groups: one learned the keyboard for a year, one took singing lessons, one joined an acting class, and a control group had no extracurricular training.
assign.translationZh: 该论文作者——作曲家兼心理学家格伦·舍伦贝格(Glenn Schellenberg)——对144名儿童进行了一项实验，这些儿童被随机分为四组：一组学习了一年键盘乐器，一组参加声乐课程，一组加入表演班，而对照组则不接受任何课外培训。

assign.sentenceEn: What did the study find about randomly assigned interracial roommates at Ohio State University?
assign.translationZh: 关于俄亥俄州立大学随机分配的跨种族室友，这项研究有何发现？

assign.sentenceEn: They were assigned to decode enemy messages.
assign.translationZh: 他们被指派去破译敌方信息。

accurate.sentenceEn: But, because of the strong emotional associations these memories evoke, people who remember something due to a scent are often convinced that the memories are accurate , even when they aren't.
accurate.translationZh: 但是，由于这些记忆会唤起强烈的情感联想，那些因气味而记起某事的人往往坚信这些记忆是准确的，即便事实并非如此。
accurate.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第5段，第4句

accurate.sentenceEn: They aren't always accurate , and they can change over time.
accurate.translationZh: 它们并非总是准确的，而且会随着时间变化。
accurate.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第5段，第2句

accurate.sentenceEn: According to a new study, people are relatively accurate judges of only some of their behaviors.
accurate.translationZh: 一项新研究表明，人们只能相对准确地判断自己的部分行为。
accurate.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第1段，第2句

accurate.sentenceEn: That enables you to make more accurate , informed and effective choices.
accurate.translationZh: 这能让你做出更准确、更明智且更有效的选择。
accurate.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第1段，第10句

accurate.sentenceEn: Accurate flood forecasts require an understanding of the situation on the ground.
accurate.translationZh: 准确的洪水预报需要了解实际地面情况。
accurate.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第1段，第9句

accurate.sentenceEn: The agronomist is sure that he will obtain a nearly accurate count of plant population with his software.
accurate.translationZh: 这位农学家确信，他的软件将能提供近乎准确的植株数量统计。

adverse.sentenceEn: Long working hours contribute to the feeling of "time poverty", which has an adverse effect on psychological well-being.
adverse.translationZh: 长时间工作导致了"时间贫困"感，这对心理健康产生了不利影响。
adverse.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第4段，第3句

adverse.sentenceEn: Researchers found that the behavior had adverse effects on participants' sense of belonging, need for meaning and self-esteem.
adverse.translationZh: 研究人员发现，这种行为会对参与者的归属感、对意义的需求以及自尊产生负面影响。
adverse.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第5段，第4句

adverse.sentenceEn: As a result, to avoid feelings of shame and worthlessness associated with failure, they extend themselves to such a degree that there's a subsequent adverse effect on their well-being.
adverse.translationZh: 因此，为了避免与失败相关的羞耻感和无价值感，他们过度透支自己，结果对自身福祉产生了不利影响。
adverse.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第3段，第3句

adverse.sentenceEn: This attempts to address the fact that Congress' previously mentioned student loan forgiveness plan largely helps out the wealthy, but is an adverse incentive for universities to keep raising tuition and for students to choose to major in low-earning degree programs.
adverse.translationZh: 这一方案试图解决国会先前提到的学生贷款豁免计划主要惠及富人的问题，但却会产生反向激励，促使大学继续提高学费，并让学生选择那些收入前景不佳的学位课程。
adverse.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第4段，第1句

adverse.sentenceEn: What does the speaker say you should do when you have an adverse reaction?
adverse.translationZh: 讲话者说当你出现不良反应时应该怎么做？

adverse.sentenceEn: Houseplants in a normal environment rarely have any adverse impact on the air.
adverse.translationZh: 正常环境下的室内植物很少对空气产生任何不良影响。

alcohol.sentenceEn: Before he died, baseball star Mickey Mantle, who was plagued with alcohol problems, told young ballplayers and the fans who admired him "to play like me, don't be like me."
alcohol.translationZh: 棒球明星米基·曼特尔生前深受酗酒问题困扰，他曾告诫那些年轻球员和仰慕他的球迷：'要像我一样打球，但不要像我一样生活。'
alcohol.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第3段，第6句

alcohol.sentenceEn: Investigative reporter Michael Moss says processed food is engineered to hook you, not unlike alcohol , cigarettes, or other harmful substances.
alcohol.translationZh: 调查记者迈克尔·莫斯表示，加工食品经过精心设计，旨在让你上钩，这与酒精、香烟或其他有害物质并无二致。
alcohol.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第1段，第2句

alcohol.sentenceEn: I spent a lot of my time and money on alcohol and other drugs.
alcohol.translationZh: 我把大量时间和金钱都花在了酗酒和吸毒上。
alcohol.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第3段，第3句

alcohol.sentenceEn: In the same year, a CGI Bruce Lee appeared in a Chinese-language ad for a whisky brand, which offended many fans because Lee was widely known not to drink alcohol at all.
alcohol.translationZh: 同年，一个CGI合成的李小龙出现在某威士忌品牌的中文广告中，这引起了许多粉丝的不满，因为众所周知，李小龙根本不喝酒。

alcohol.sentenceEn: In what way does Michael Moss think processed food is comparable to alcohol and cigarettes?
alcohol.translationZh: 迈克尔·莫斯认为加工食品在哪些方面可与酒精和香烟相提并论？

alcohol.sentenceEn: He created a drink containing alcohol without breaking law.
alcohol.translationZh: 他创造了一种含酒精却不违法的饮品。

anticipate.sentenceEn: Anticipate that by giving yourself extra time to arrive.
anticipate.translationZh: 预计一下，给自己留出额外的到达时间。
anticipate.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第2段，第3句

anticipate.sentenceEn: Combined with machine learning of anticipated order volumes and the minute-by-minute cooking data generated by systems such as QSR, that robot fleet could deliver almost instantly.
anticipate.translationZh: 结合对预期订单量的机器学习，以及由 QSR 等系统生成的每分钟烹饪数据，该机器人机群几乎可以实现即时交付。

anticipate.sentenceEn: This means simply that it is possible to observe ourselves having a craving, or a happy thought, or even a scary emotion, without reacting in the moment in a way that amplifies the feeling or sends the mind spiraling off into thinking about old memories or anticipating events.
anticipate.translationZh: 简单来说，这意味着我们可以观察自己产生某种渴望、愉悦的念头，甚至是恐惧的情绪，而不会在当下立即做出反应，从而避免加剧这种感受，或让思绪陷入对往事的回忆以及对未来的忧虑中。
anticipate.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第2段，第2句

anticipate.sentenceEn: Their findings suggest that how likely you are to remember your password has less to do with the password itself and more to do with how often you anticipate using it.
anticipate.translationZh: 他们的研究结果表明，你记住密码的可能性大小，与其说与密码本身有关，不如说与你预期使用密码的频率关系更大。
anticipate.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第2段，第3句

anticipate.sentenceEn: What is the risk the man anticipates ?
anticipate.translationZh: 男士预期的风险是什么？

anticipate.sentenceEn: It triggers our mind to reflect on past experiences or anticipate future events.
anticipate.translationZh: 它会触动我们的思绪，让我们去反思过往的经历，或去憧憬未来的图景。

authority.sentenceEn: Even if some of these traits look right-wing or conservative, for example, deferring to authority , left-wing people will still have a group loyalty and deference to someone or something.
authority.translationZh: 即使其中一些特质看似右翼或保守，例如顺从权威，但左翼人士仍然会有群体忠诚度，并对某人或某事表现出顺从。
authority.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第2段，第6句

authority.sentenceEn: Don't challenge anyone with authority unless you are famous or very rich.
authority.translationZh: 除非你声名显赫或腰缠万贯，否则不要挑战任何权威人士。
authority.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第1段，第2句

authority.sentenceEn: Authorities finally caught one notorious thief named Thomas Morgan and banned him from the fountain after he fished out thousands of dollars in change over 34 years using a magnetic stick.
authority.translationZh: 当局最终抓获了一名名叫托马斯·摩根的臭名昭著的窃贼，并禁止他靠近喷泉。在过去34年里，摩根一直用磁棒从喷泉中捞出数千美元的硬币。
authority.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第3段，第8句

authority.sentenceEn: However, after a lifetime of moving within the circles of power, he was unable to break with authority , and served Mussolini faithfully (as president of Italy's national research council and royal academy, as well as a member of the Fascist Grand Council) until the day he died—conveniently—in 1937, shortly before he would have had to take a stand in the conflict that consumed a world that he had, in part, created.
authority.translationZh: 然而，在权力圈子中周旋了一生之后，他已无法与权威决裂，而是一直忠实地为墨索里尼效力（担任意大利国家研究委员会主席、皇家科学院院长以及法西斯大委员会成员），直至1937年他"适时"离世——就在他即将不得不对那场吞噬了一个部分由他亲手创造的世界的冲突表明立场之前不久。

authority.sentenceEn: France's tax on overnight stays was introduced to assist thermal spa(温泉) towns to develop, and around half of French local authorities use it today.
authority.translationZh: 法国的过夜税最初是为了帮助温泉小镇发展而设立的，如今约有一半的法国地方政府都在征收这项税费。
authority.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第2段，第3句

authority.sentenceEn: Ascertain whether deferring to authority was confined to right-wing people.
authority.translationZh: 确定是否只有右翼人士才会盲从权威。

acknowledge.sentenceEn: However, scientists who engage in science communication must acknowledge that even in their area, their expertise is deep but narrow.
acknowledge.translationZh: 然而，从事科学传播的科学家必须承认，即使在自己的研究领域，他们的专业知识也是深度有余而广度不足。
acknowledge.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第3段，第1句

acknowledge.sentenceEn: You can begin by acknowledging that you are at fault, taking responsibility for the hurt you caused, then reflecting on why the event occurred.
acknowledge.translationZh: 你可以先承认自己有错，为自己造成的伤害承担责任，然后反思事情发生的原因。
acknowledge.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第3段，第4句

acknowledge.sentenceEn: Increasingly, even Silicon Valley has to acknowledge the costs of the intoxicating(令人陶醉的) hurry that characterises its culture.
acknowledge.translationZh: 如今，即便是硅谷也不得不承认其文化中那种令人陶醉的匆忙所带来的代价。
acknowledge.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第6段，第1句

acknowledge.sentenceEn: And acknowledging this in an interview will go a long way towards suggesting that you might be the right person for the position you are applying for.
acknowledge.translationZh: 在面试中承认这一点，将大大有助于表明你可能就是该职位的合适人选。
acknowledge.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第4段，第4句

acknowledge.sentenceEn: Merian acknowledged the help she got from natives of South America.
acknowledge.translationZh: 梅里安承认她从南美洲当地人那里获得的帮助。

acknowledge.sentenceEn: Hunting is universally acknowledged as a savage behavior.
acknowledge.translationZh: 狩猎被普遍认为是一种野蛮行为。

actual.sentenceEn: Have all of your notes and materials organized well in advance of each event, so that all you have to do is grab them and go when it's the actual day.
actual.translationZh: 每场活动前都要提前整理好所有笔记和材料，这样到了活动当天，你只需拿起它们就能出发。
actual.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第4段，第2句

actual.sentenceEn: My counterpart and I agreed we might never ascertain the actual facts of the matter; quite likely there were elements of truth in both employees' stories.
actual.translationZh: 我和对方一致认为，我们可能永远无法查明此事的真相；很可能这两名员工的说法中都包含一定的属实成分。
actual.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第1段，第8句

actual.sentenceEn: It doesn't have to be a hard fantasy novel with actual spells, it can be the magic found between two people who just have that special something.
actual.translationZh: 它不一定非得是包含真实咒语的严肃奇幻小说，也可以是两个人之间那种难以言喻的特殊感觉中所蕴含的魔力。
actual.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第8段，第2句

actual.sentenceEn: But the actual science of how the two halves of our brains work together is sometimes stranger than fiction.
actual.translationZh: 但关于我们大脑两半球如何协同工作的实际科学研究，有时比虚构故事还要离奇。
actual.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第3段，第3句

actual.sentenceEn: Humans cannot survive without a fair knowledge of the actual world.
actual.translationZh: 人类若不能对真实世界有一个相当准确的认识，就无法生存。

actual.sentenceEn: They tried to ascertain the actual facts of the matter.
actual.translationZh: 他们试图查明事情的真相。

ad.sentenceEn: The researchers believe that other companies could bolster sales of healthy foods with similar ads , depicting their products as attractive and a source of pleasure.
ad.translationZh: 研究人员认为，其他公司也可以通过类似的广告来促进健康食品的销售，将其产品描绘成具有吸引力且能带来愉悦体验的来源。
ad.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第8段，第5句

ad.sentenceEn: For example, the ads focused on the bright, beautiful orange color and crisp texture of the carrots.
ad.translationZh: 例如，这些广告着重展现了胡萝卜鲜亮迷人的橙色和清脆的口感。
ad.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第8段，第3句

ad.sentenceEn: In the same year, a CGI Bruce Lee appeared in a Chinese-language ad for a whisky brand, which offended many fans because Lee was widely known not to drink alcohol at all.
ad.translationZh: 同年，一个CGI合成的李小龙出现在某威士忌品牌的中文广告中，这引起了许多粉丝的不满，因为众所周知，李小龙根本不喝酒。

ad.sentenceEn: "In the last five years, it's become more affordable and more achievable in a whole movie," says Tim Webber at UK visual effects firm Framestore, the company behind the Hepburn chocolate ad .
ad.translationZh: 英国视觉特效公司Framestore（赫本巧克力广告的幕后制作方）的蒂姆·韦伯表示：“在过去五年里，这种技术的成本降低了，也能够在整部电影中应用了。”

ad.sentenceEn: What does the passage say appears in almost all ads for Coca-Cola?
ad.translationZh: 文章中提到什么出现在几乎所有可口可乐的广告中？

ad.sentenceEn: George Grune joined it as an ad salesman.
ad.translationZh: 乔治·格鲁恩最初以广告推销员的身份加入《读者文摘》。

adjust.sentenceEn: Studies have linked consumption of ultra-processed foods—which are packed high in salt, sugar, and fat—with weight gain and an increased risk of chronic diseases, even after adjusting for the amount of salt, sugar, and fat in the diet.
adjust.translationZh: 研究表明，即使在调整了饮食中盐、糖和脂肪的摄入量后，食用超加工食品——这类食品通常富含盐、糖和脂肪——仍与体重增加和慢性疾病风险升高有关。
adjust.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第4段，第1句

adjust.sentenceEn: After the workout, the app's artificial intelligence software system gives feedback from Ms. Weiner and its other 53 million users around the world to adjust future training sessions.
adjust.translationZh: 锻炼结束后，该应用的人工智能软件系统会结合Weiner女士及全球其他5300万用户的反馈，来调整未来的训练课程。
adjust.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第1段，第10句

adjust.sentenceEn: While the authors of the paper found truth in this explanation, they assert that low wages can't be the only factor, as wages for men without college degrees, adjusting for inflation, haven't changed much since the 1960s, making it hard to see why fewer men seem willing to accept those wages.
adjust.translationZh: 虽然该论文的作者认为这种解释有一定道理，但他们断言低工资并非唯一因素，因为扣除通货膨胀因素后，没有大学学位的男性的工资自20世纪60年代以来并没有太大变化，这让人难以理解为什么似乎越来越少的男性愿意接受这些工资水平。
adjust.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第3段，第5句

adjust.sentenceEn: This remained the case when adjusting for other factors, such as participants' own education, social background and health status before and after marriage.
adjust.translationZh: 即使在对其他因素进行调整后，情况依然如此，这些因素包括参与者自身的教育水平、社会背景以及婚前婚后的健康状况。
adjust.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第1段，第11句

adjust.sentenceEn: By adjusting their metabolism, resurrection plants can recover from an extended period of drought.
adjust.translationZh: 通过调整新陈代谢，复苏植物能够从长期干旱中恢复生机。

adjust.sentenceEn: The UK is set to adjust its policy on taxation.
adjust.translationZh: 英国正准备调整其税收政策。

aside.sentenceEn: To give this gift means putting away your phone, turning off social media, and setting aside other common distractions.
aside.translationZh: 赠送这份礼物意味着放下手机，关闭社交媒体，并撇开其他常见的干扰因素。
aside.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第8段，第2句

aside.sentenceEn: These finer points aside , one major consequence of the older-moms trend is that fewer years of a woman's life are spent as a mother.
aside.translationZh: 暂且不论这些细节，母亲高龄化趋势的一个主要后果是女性一生中作为母亲的时间减少了。
aside.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第5段，第4句

aside.sentenceEn: Set aside , for the moment, the familiar argument for higher wages: fairness.
aside.translationZh: 暂且不论提高工资的常见理由——公平性。
aside.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第6段，第1句

aside.sentenceEn: Aside from the salvors, their investors, and the maritime archaeologists who serve as expert witnesses, the battles sweep in local and international governments and organizations like UNESCO that work to protect under-water heritage.
aside.translationZh: 除了打捞人员、他们的投资者以及担任专家证人的海洋考古学家外，这些争夺战还将地方和国际政府以及像联合国教科文组织这样致力于保护水下遗产的组织卷入其中。

aside.sentenceEn: As a result, forests around the world have been set aside as parks or wilderness areas.
aside.translationZh: 因此，世界各地的森林被划作公园或 wilderness 保护区。

aside.sentenceEn: They persuaded them to put their conflict aside .
aside.translationZh: 他们说服他们放下分歧。

alleviate.sentenceEn: So, what can be done to alleviate these problems?
alleviate.translationZh: 那么，我们可以做些什么来缓解这些问题呢？
alleviate.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第6段，第1句

alleviate.sentenceEn: Understanding how humans shape stray dogs' behavior may help alleviate this problem.
alleviate.translationZh: 了解人类如何影响流浪狗的行为可能有助于缓解这一问题。
alleviate.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第3段，第4句

alleviate.sentenceEn: Even if a competent person isn't required, supervisors need a broad set of skills to not only identify and alleviate workplace hazards but also build a safety climate within their team that supports intervening and open communication among them.
alleviate.translationZh: 即使不需要专业人员，主管也需要具备广泛的技能，不仅要识别和减轻工作场所的危害，还要在团队中营造安全氛围，支持团队成员之间的干预和开放沟通。
alleviate.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第8段，第2句

alleviate.sentenceEn: If you're looking to alleviate stress, you might want to give classical music a try.
alleviate.translationZh: 如果你想缓解压力，不妨试试古典音乐。
alleviate.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第2段，第1句

alleviate.sentenceEn: What may help alleviate the problem caused by stray dogs?
alleviate.translationZh: 有什么方法可以帮助缓解流浪狗造成的问题？

alleviate.sentenceEn: Psychological intervention should be introduced to alleviate it.
alleviate.translationZh: 应引入心理干预以缓解这一问题。

accomplish.sentenceEn: So if humans ever succeed in reaching the stars, they may accomplish this feat, in part, by standing on the shoulders of the tiny eight-legged endurance specialists in your backyard.
accomplish.translationZh: 因此，如果人类最终成功抵达星际，这一壮举的实现，在某种程度上，可能要归功于那些生活在你后院、拥有超凡耐力的小小八脚专家。
accomplish.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第6段，第1句

accomplish.sentenceEn: Many fields will be a hybrid, where some humans find a lucky place, but most of the work is done by computers, like in manufacturing today, where much of the work is accomplished by robots, but some humans must be there to oversee the machines.
accomplish.translationZh: 许多领域都将转变为混合模式，其中一部分幸运的人能够找到自己的位置，但大部分工作将由计算机完成。就像当今的制造业一样，虽然大部分工作是由机器人完成的，但仍需部分人员留守以监管机器。
accomplish.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第5段，第2句

accomplish.sentenceEn: M: Generally, young people believe their productivity should not be measured by the number of hours they work, since someone can work for eight hours and accomplish next to nothing of significance for the company.
accomplish.translationZh: 男：通常，年轻人认为不应以工作时长来衡量生产力。因为一个人即便工作八小时，也可能对公司没有做出任何实质性的贡献。
accomplish.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第10段，第1句

accomplish.sentenceEn: What job applicants ought to be looking for is what the company is up to, what they are trying to accomplish and what is preventing them from accomplishing those things.
accomplish.translationZh: 求职者应该了解的是公司目前的发展方向、他们试图达成的目标以及阻碍他们实现这些目标的因素。
accomplish.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第4段，第5句

accomplish.sentenceEn: Recent history shows reduction of pollution, once seemingly impossible, can actually be accomplished .
accomplish.translationZh: 近代历史表明，曾经看似不可能的污染减排实际上是可以实现的。

accomplish.sentenceEn: They accomplish feats many of us cannot.
accomplish.translationZh: 他们能完成我们大多数人无法完成的壮举。

activate.sentenceEn: Then analysts who didn't know which condition each baby was in, watched video tapes of the experiment and counted how many times babies tried to activate the toy by pressing the button.
activate.translationZh: 然后，不清楚每个婴儿处于哪种实验条件的分析师们观看了实验录像，并统计了婴儿们通过按按钮试图启动玩具的次数。
activate.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第3段，第6句

activate.sentenceEn: Then we introduced the baby to a novel music toy that seemed as if it could be activated by pushing a big button on top.
activate.translationZh: 然后我们给宝宝介绍了一个新奇的音乐玩具，它似乎可以通过按顶部的大按钮来启动。
activate.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第3段，第2句

activate.sentenceEn: Daydreaming in the absence of such distractions activates the brain's default-mode network.
activate.translationZh: 在没有此类干扰的情况下做白日梦会激活大脑的默认模式网络。

activate.sentenceEn: If the act of giving advice is contributing actively to someone's feelings of self-worth, an outright(直率的) rejection may be perceived as a threat, activating their fight-or-flight response, possibly causing them to double down on their validation-seeking behavior, or leading to a larger conflict.
activate.translationZh: 如果给予建议这一行为正积极地支撑着一个人的自我价值感，那么直接的拒绝可能会被视为一种威胁，从而激发其战斗或逃跑反应。这可能导致他们加倍寻求认可，或者引发更大的冲突。
activate.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第5段，第1句

activate.sentenceEn: Activating the brain's social network involved in socially motivated learning and memory may allow students to tap unused mental powers.
activate.translationZh: 激活大脑中参与社会动机学习和记忆的社交网络，或许能让学生利用未被开发的心智能力。

activate.sentenceEn: It activates their evolved fear system and their unique fantasy.
activate.translationZh: 这会激活他们进化后的恐惧系统和独特的幻想。

adequate.sentenceEn: The search for an adequate response to climate change occupies centre stage in international diplomacy.
adequate.translationZh: 寻求应对气候变化的适当措施已成为国际外交的核心议题。

adequate.sentenceEn: Hence, prejudice means to judge before having adequate knowledge.
adequate.translationZh: 因此，偏见就是指在掌握足够知识之前就下判断。
adequate.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第1段，第6句

adequate.sentenceEn: Jean-Michel Leniaud, the president of the scientific council at the National Heritage Institute, said: "What happened was bound to happen. The lack of adequate maintenance and daily attention to such a majestic building is the cause of this catastrophe."
adequate.translationZh: 国家遗产研究所科学委员会主席让-米歇尔·勒尼奥表示：“所发生的一切是必然的。对这样一座宏伟建筑缺乏足够的维护和日常关注是这场灾难的原因。”

adequate.sentenceEn: Reserves proposed earlier this year for Australia's southwestern and northwestern coastal regions have also been criticised for failing to give habitats adequate protection.
adequate.translationZh: 今年早些时候为澳大利亚西南和西北沿海地区提议设立的保护区也因未能给予栖息地充分保护而受到批评。
adequate.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第7段，第1句

adequate.sentenceEn: Adequate rest not only helps one recover, but also increases one's work efficiency.
adequate.translationZh: 充足的休息不仅有助于恢复精力，还能提高工作效率。

adequate.sentenceEn: Our communication with birds was far from adequate .
adequate.translationZh: 我们与鸟类的交流远远不够充分。

advancement.sentenceEn: Part of this is because women take on more of the unpaid labor at home, which can eat into time available for work and energy for career advancement .
advancement.translationZh: 部分原因是女性承担了更多的无偿家务劳动，这会占用她们本可用于工作的时间，消耗她们职业发展所需的精力。
advancement.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第8段，第1句

advancement.sentenceEn: Unfortunately, our deeply rooted divisions are delaying these advancements .
advancement.translationZh: 遗憾的是，我们之间根深蒂固的分歧正在推迟这些进步。
advancement.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第7段，第1句

advancement.sentenceEn: W: So they generally don't want to defer happiness in return for career advancement ?
advancement.translationZh: 所以他们通常不想为了职业晋升而推迟幸福感吗？
advancement.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第5段，第1句

advancement.sentenceEn: Our modern world is preoccupied with technological advancements .
advancement.translationZh: 我们的现代世界一心专注于技术进步。
advancement.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第5段，第2句

advancement.sentenceEn: With technological advancement in recent years, salvors now can detect the invaluable man-made objects lying buried under the sea.
advancement.translationZh: 近年来，随着技术的进步，打捞人员现在能够探测到埋在海底的珍贵人工制品。

advancement.sentenceEn: It is delaying advancements toward racial equality.
advancement.translationZh: 这正在阻碍种族平等进程的推进。

apparently.sentenceEn: Apparently , they did a massive renovation a few years ago.
apparently.translationZh: 据了解，他们在几年前进行了一次大规模翻修。
apparently.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第11段，第3句

apparently.sentenceEn: More often than not, you then have to choose photos that include a street sign, as this apparently provides solid evidence to your computer that you are, in fact, a human being.
apparently.translationZh: 通常情况下，你接着需要选择包含路标的照片，因为这显然能向电脑提供确凿证据，证明你确实是人类。
apparently.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第1段，第3句

apparently.sentenceEn: The average male creative arts students, indeed, apparently earn much less than they would, had they simply never gone to university.
apparently.translationZh: 事实上，男性创意艺术专业毕业生的平均收入，明显低于他们当初干脆不上大学可能获得的收入。
apparently.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第2段，第4句

apparently.sentenceEn: The internet is apparently taking down yet another industry.
apparently.translationZh: 互联网显然又在摧毁另一个行业。

apparently.sentenceEn: This rise is also apparently boosted by policies embedded in European framework funding schemes.
apparently.translationZh: 这种增长显然也得益于欧洲框架资助计划中所嵌入的政策。
apparently.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第12段，第3句

apparently.sentenceEn: They apparently have little to do with moderate beliefs.
apparently.translationZh: 它们显然与温和的信念没什么关系。

attractive.sentenceEn: Place-based economic development stresses the importance of offering attractive , functional, and community-based places, such as libraries, in town squares and depressed neighborhoods.
attractive.translationZh: 区位经济发展强调提供有吸引力、功能性强且以社区为基础的场所的重要性，例如城镇广场和经济欠发达社区中的图书馆。

attractive.sentenceEn: Food companies know that better color gives better prices, so they ensure that their products are attractive in color to bolster earnings.
attractive.translationZh: 食品企业深知色泽越好，售价越高，因此他们确保产品拥有诱人的色泽以提高收益。
attractive.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第1段，第2句

attractive.sentenceEn: Adventure sports are undeniably attractive to many energetic and thrill-seeking kids.
attractive.translationZh: 不可否认，冒险运动对许多精力充沛、追求刺激的孩子具有极大吸引力。
attractive.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第1段，第1句

attractive.sentenceEn: A focus on wage growth would provide an antidote(矫正方法) to the attractive simplicity of the belief in the magical power of tax cuts.
attractive.translationZh: 将关注点放在工资增长上，能够纠正那种认为减税具有神奇力量的错误观念——尽管这种观念因其简单易懂而颇具吸引力。
attractive.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第13段，第1句

attractive.sentenceEn: What idea does the woman find attractive ?
attractive.translationZh: 这位女士觉得什么主意有吸引力？

attractive.sentenceEn: It is very attractive for real estate developers.
attractive.translationZh: 这对房地产开发商极具吸引力。

adventure.sentenceEn: Adventure sports have many of the same risks and dangers, but they have an additional sense of adventure , courage and autonomy that is important to foster in young children.
adventure.translationZh: 探险运动确实存在许多类似的风险和危险，但它们能带来一种额外的冒险精神、勇气和自主意识，这些特质对于培养孩子至关重要。
adventure.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第3段，第3句

adventure.sentenceEn: Camping under the stars, fishing, stargazing or even just playing in the woods can help a lot in building the same sense of self-confidence and risk-taking as in adventure sports.
adventure.translationZh: 在星空下露营、钓鱼、观星，甚至只是在树林里玩耍，都能极大地帮助孩子建立与冒险运动相同的自信心和风险承担意识。
adventure.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第3段，第6句

adventure.sentenceEn: Some adventure sports may be associated with high risks of injury, so it's important for kids to figure out when to take risks, and when not to.
adventure.translationZh: 一些探险运动可能伴随着较高的受伤风险，因此孩子们需要学会判断何时可以冒险，何时不应冒险，这一点至关重要。
adventure.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第2段，第2句

adventure.sentenceEn: But if you do decide that adventure sports are a bit too much, do try to introduce other forms of outdoor adventures into their lives.
adventure.translationZh: 但如果你确实认为冒险运动有点太过火，一定要尝试在孩子的生活中引入其他形式的户外探险活动。
adventure.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第3段，第5句

adventure.sentenceEn: What should parents do if they decide adventure sports are a bit too much for their kids?
adventure.translationZh: 如果父母认为冒险运动对孩子来说有点太过了，他们应该怎么做？

adventure.sentenceEn: They prevent kids from enjoying adventure sports.
adventure.translationZh: 它们会妨碍孩子们享受冒险运动的乐趣。

aesthetic.sentenceEn: Most institutions of higher education rely on synthetic pesticides and fertilizers to achieve aesthetic goals.
aesthetic.translationZh: 大多数高等教育机构依靠合成农药和化肥来达到美观目的。
aesthetic.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第3段，第2句

aesthetic.sentenceEn: Rather, I always try to incorporate something slightly absurd into my aesthetic .
aesthetic.translationZh: 相反，我总是尝试在我的美学风格中融入些许荒诞元素。
aesthetic.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第2段，第3句

aesthetic.sentenceEn: Also, humans are such absorbent social beings that when we surround ourselves with others, we automatically take in their opinions and aesthetics .
aesthetic.translationZh: 此外，人类是极具感染力的社会性生物，当我们身处人群中时，会不由自主地接纳他人的观点和审美。

aesthetic.sentenceEn: This legislative proposal essentially set out to harmonize the aesthetic appearance of all the houses in Berkton.
aesthetic.translationZh: 这项立法提案的本质目的是统一伯克顿所有房屋的外观美感。
aesthetic.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第6段，第5句

aesthetic.sentenceEn: What does the woman say she always tries to incorporate into her aesthetic ?
aesthetic.translationZh: 这位女士说她总是试图将什么融入自己的审美中？

aesthetic.sentenceEn: It embodies beauty with a wide array of aesthetic features.
aesthetic.translationZh: 它集多种美学特色于一身，彰显美感。

aging.sentenceEn: One of the other things is, rather than just taking one perspective, so rather than looking at aging and health just from the perspective of the psychologist, we are now bringing together a lot of different techniques and a lot of different viewpoints to actually look at the sort of different factors affecting health.
aging.translationZh: 另一个方面是，我们不再局限于单一视角——不再仅从心理学家的角度研究衰老与健康，而是汇集了多种不同的技术和观点，来探究影响健康的各类因素。
aging.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第4段，第6句

aging.sentenceEn: Scientists hope that cracking the genetic code of plants and animals could help uncover new treatments for infectious diseases, slow aging , improve crops in agriculture, and create new bio-materials.
aging.translationZh: 科学家们希望，破解动植物的遗传密码能够帮助发现传染病的新疗法、延缓衰老、改良农业作物并创造新的生物材料。
aging.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第1段，第2句

aging.sentenceEn: First of all, dementia is not an inevitable part of the normal aging process.
aging.translationZh: 首先，痴呆并非正常衰老过程中不可避免的一部分。

aging.sentenceEn: Other studies of successful aging suggest that being connected to one's community and having plenty of social interaction is also important in delaying or even preventing the onset of dementia.
aging.translationZh: 其他关于健康老龄化的研究表明，融入社区生活并保持丰富的社交互动对于延缓甚至预防痴呆症的发病也很重要。

aging.sentenceEn: What do we learn from the last paragraph about the process of aging ?
aging.translationZh: 从最后一段我们能了解到关于衰老过程的什么信息？

aging.sentenceEn: It slows down our aging process.
aging.translationZh: 它能减缓我们的衰老过程。

algorithm.sentenceEn: Algorithms could soon—if they don't already—have a better idea about which show you'd like to watch next and which job candidate you should hire than you do.
algorithm.translationZh: 算法可能很快——如果还没有的话——就比你自己更清楚你接下来想看什么节目，以及你应该雇佣哪个求职者。
algorithm.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第8段，第1句

algorithm.sentenceEn: As machine learning algorithms improve and as they train on more extensive data sets, larger parts of everyday life are likely to become utterly predictable.
algorithm.translationZh: 随着机器学习算法的改进以及对更广泛数据集的训练，日常生活中越来越多的方面可能会变得完全可预测。
algorithm.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第7段，第1句

algorithm.sentenceEn: Remote sensors enable algorithms (算法) to interpret a field's environment as statistical data that can be understood and useful to farmers for decision-making.
algorithm.translationZh: 远程传感器使算法能够将农田环境解读为统计数据，这些数据可为农民所理解并用于决策。

algorithm.sentenceEn: Algorithms process the data, adapting and learning based on the data received.
algorithm.translationZh: 算法对数据进行处理，并基于接收到的数据进行自适应学习。

algorithm.sentenceEn: What is likely to happen to larger parts of our daily life as machine learning algorithms improve?
algorithm.translationZh: 随着机器学习算法的改进，我们日常生活中的大部分内容可能会发生什么？

algorithm.sentenceEn: There are no appropriate algorithms to process the face samples.

arouse.sentenceEn: What should learning leaders do to arouse learners' passion for change?

assumption.sentenceEn: Society tends to celebrate personal achievement and commend it based on the assumption that winning or succeeding is a consequence of working harder than the next person.
assumption.translationZh: 社会倾向于颂扬个人成就，并基于一种假设对其给予嘉奖：即获胜或成功是比他人更加努力的结果。
assumption.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第5段，第2句

assumption.sentenceEn: It might be useful, however, to at least push back on this assumption because people evaluate environment, situations, and people aesthetically.
assumption.translationZh: 然而，至少对这一假设提出质疑或许是有益的，因为人们会从美学角度对环境、情境和人进行评价。
assumption.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第1段，第3句

assumption.sentenceEn: And it is always good to question our assumptions .

assumption.sentenceEn: In other words, Marconi had the advantage of not being burdened by preconceived assumptions .

autonomous.sentenceEn: So, to gain access to an automated service that will benefit financially from my input, I first have to do some unpaid labor to help improve the performance of autonomous vehicles.
autonomous.translationZh: 所以，为了获得一项能从我的输入中获利的自动化服务，我首先得干些义务劳动，去帮他们改进自动驾驶汽车的性能。
autonomous.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第3段，第2句

autonomous.sentenceEn: Take the recent discovery of two modern human teeth found in the Luna cave in China's Guangxi Zhuang Autonomous Region.
autonomous.translationZh: 以中国广西壮族自治区月岩洞穴中发现的两颗现代人牙齿为例。
autonomous.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第2段，第3句

autonomous.sentenceEn: Vast quantities of iron ore are then transported by autonomous trains to ocean ports.
autonomous.translationZh: 随后，大量铁矿石由自动驾驶列车运往海港。
autonomous.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第2段，第6句

autonomous.sentenceEn: The 240 giant autonomous trucks in use, in the Western Australian mines, can weigh 400 tons, fully loaded, and travel at speeds of up to 60 kilometers per hour.
autonomous.translationZh: 西澳大利亚州的矿场中，正在使用的240辆巨型自动驾驶卡车满载时重达400吨，行驶速度可达每小时60公里。
autonomous.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第2段，第3句

autonomous.sentenceEn: At one level, Marconi could be fiercely autonomous and independent of the constraints of his own social class.

他们既充满好奇，又具备自主性。

autonomy.sentenceEn: He has found that personality traits commonly associated with creativity are openness (receptiveness to new thoughts and experiences), self-confidence, and autonomy —which may include "a lack of concern for social norms" and "a preference for being alone".
autonomy.translationZh: 他发现，通常与创造力相关的人格特质包括开放性（乐于接受新思想和新体验）、自信心和自主性——其中可能包括“不太在意社会规范”和“喜欢独处”。

autonomy.sentenceEn: Consequently, individuality and autonomy are sacrificed to maintain the unity of the group.
autonomy.translationZh: 因此，为了维持团体的统一，个性和自主权被牺牲掉了。
autonomy.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第5段，第4句

autonomy.sentenceEn: And if surveillance tools take away autonomy , that's when they prove most unpopular.
autonomy.translationZh: 而如果监控工具剥夺了员工的自主权，那它们就会变得极其不受欢迎。
autonomy.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第5段，第3句

autonomy.sentenceEn: Adventure sports have many of the same risks and dangers, but they have an additional sense of adventure, courage and autonomy that is important to foster in young children.
autonomy.translationZh: 探险运动确实存在许多类似的风险和危险，但它们能带来一种额外的冒险精神、勇气和自主意识，这些特质对于培养孩子至关重要。
autonomy.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第3段，第3句

autonomy.sentenceEn: Despite his autonomy , Marconi felt alienated and suffered from a lack of acceptance.
autonomy.translationZh: 尽管马可尼能够保持高度自主，但他仍感到自己是个局外人，并因缺乏他人的接纳而深受困扰。

autonomy.sentenceEn: They present a false picture of the autonomy cars provide.
autonomy.translationZh: 它们描绘了汽车所能提供的自主权的虚假图景。

alert.sentenceEn: I thought she came across as bright and alert .

alert.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第5段，第4句

alert.sentenceEn: However, while coffee may make you more alert , individuals can build up a tolerance, meaning this is short-lived.
alert.translationZh: 然而，尽管咖啡可能让你更加警觉，但人体会逐渐产生耐受性，这意味着这种效果是短暂的。
alert.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第2段，第2句

alert.sentenceEn: These days, LinkedIn alerts us when our rival gets a new job, and Instagram can let us know how well "liked" our lives are compared with a friend's.

alert.sentenceEn: Some suggestions include making space in your diary for the only periods during which you'll be checking emails, setting a timer for yourself so you don't become distracted by your inbox for too long, turning off email alerts so you're not interrupted by them.
alert.translationZh: 一些建议包括：在日程表中预留专门时段处理邮件，设置计时器以避免长时间被收件箱分心，关闭邮件提醒以防止被打扰。
alert.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第5段，第2句

alert.sentenceEn: Paris prosecutor Remy Heitz said that an initial fire alert was sounded at 6:20 pm on Monday evening but no fire was found.

absorb.sentenceEn: Creators are simply humans who use what they inherit, who absorb the past and manipulate it to create possible futures.

absorb.sentenceEn: Degradation of the world's natural resources by humans is rapidly outpacing the planet's ability to absorb the damage, a recent UN environmental study has found.
absorb.translationZh: 联合国近期的一项环境研究发现，人类对世界自然资源的破坏速度正迅速超过地球吸收这些损害的能力。
absorb.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第1段，第1句

absorb.sentenceEn: When we absorb information for the purpose of imparting it to others, we do so with greater accuracy and depth.
absorb.translationZh: 当我们为了教授他人而吸收信息时，我们会学得更加准确和深入。

academy.sentenceEn: Nottingham Trent University and the Chinese Academy of Sciences have been trying to find a way to prevent deadly outdoor air pollution from penetrating indoors.
academy.translationZh: 诺丁汉特伦特大学与中国科学院一直致力于研究如何防止致命的室外空气污染渗透进室内。
academy.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第1段，第1句

academy.sentenceEn: The American Academy of Pediatrics (AAP), which first issued that recommendation back in 1999, has extensively updated and revised its guidelines for children and adolescents to reflect new research and new habits.
academy.translationZh: 美国儿科学会(AAP)早在1999年首次提出这一建议，如今已对其儿童和青少年指南进行了全面更新和修订，以反映新的研究成果和新的习惯。
academy.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第3段，第1句

academy.sentenceEn: However, after a lifetime of moving within the circles of power, he was unable to break with authority, and served Mussolini faithfully (as president of Italy's national research council and royal academy , as well as a member of the Fascist Grand Council) until the day he died—conveniently—in 1937, shortly before he would have had to take a stand in the conflict that consumed a world that he had, in part, created.
academy.translationZh: 然而，在权力圈子中周旋了一生之后，他已无法与权威决裂，而是一直忠实地为墨索里尼效力（担任意大利国家研究委员会主席、皇家科学院院长以及法西斯大委员会成员），直至1937年他"适时"离世——就在他即将不得不对那场吞噬了一个部分由他亲手创造的世界的冲突表明立场之前不久。

academy.sentenceEn: "If they're alive today, you can put them in scanning rigs, you can get every detail of their body analysed very carefully and that makes it much easier, whereas working from available photographs is tricky," says Webber, who won an Academy Award for his visual effects work on the 2013 film Gravity.
academy.translationZh: 韦伯表示：“如果当事人尚在世，你可以让他们进入扫描设备，极其细致地分析他们身体的每一个细节，这会使整个过程容易得多，而仅依据现有照片进行创作则非常棘手。”他曾因2013年电影《地心引力》的视觉特效工作获得奥斯卡奖。

academy.sentenceEn: It is the first to compare organic and conventional agriculture across the main goals of sustainability identified by the National Academy of Sciences: productivity, economics, and environment.
academy.translationZh: 这是首项基于美国国家科学院确定的可持续发展主要目标（生产力、经济效益和环境影响）对有机农业和传统农业进行全面比较的研究。
academy.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第2段，第2句

academy.sentenceEn: What did Professor Gang Pan of the Chinese Academy of Sciences say about their study?
academy.translationZh: 中国科学院的潘纲教授对他们的研究有何评价？

alike.sentenceEn: Chinese and American lawyers might be trained to interact based on the assumption that the Chinese person is less individualistic, even though their similar social economic situations make it probable they are actually quite alike in that regard.
alike.translationZh: 中美两国的律师可能接受的培训是基于"中国人不那么个人主义"这一假设进行互动，尽管他们相似的社会经济状况使得他们在这方面很可能实际上非常相似。
alike.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第7段，第2句

alike.sentenceEn: The evidence implies that people with similar jobs and incomes are more culturally alike , regardless of where they live.
alike.translationZh: 有证据表明，拥有相似工作和收入的人在文化上更为相似，无论他们生活在哪里。
alike.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第6段，第1句

alike.sentenceEn: So the problem with deploying machine learning and artificial intelligence in agriculture is not that scientists lack the capacity to develop programs and protocols to begin to address the biggest of growers' concerns; the problem is that in most cases, no two environments will be exactly alike , which makes the testing, validation and successful rollout of such technologies much more laborious than in most other industries.
alike.translationZh: 因此，在农业领域应用机器学习和人工智能的问题，并非科学家缺乏开发程序和协议以着手解决种植者最大关切的能力；问题在于，在大多数情况下，没有两个环境是完全相同的，这使得此类技术的测试、验证和成功推广比在大多数其他行业要困难得多。

alike.sentenceEn: Teachers and students alike have experienced the curious paradox that beginners, as a rule, tend to think too little about what they are doing because they think too much about what they are doing.
alike.translationZh: 师生们都曾经历过一个奇怪的悖论：通常来说，初学者往往对自己正在做的事思考得太少，因为他们对自己正在做的事思考得太多。
alike.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第1段，第1句

alike.sentenceEn: Plagued by long delays, perpetual mismanagement and ever-soaring costs, the airport has become something of a joke among Germans—and a source of frustration for local politicians, business leaders and residents alike .
alike.translationZh: 由于长期延误、管理混乱以及成本不断飙升，这座机场已沦为德国人的笑柄，也成为当地政客、商界领袖和居民共同的失望之源。
alike.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第2段，第2句

alike.sentenceEn: They think and behave alike in different social groups.
alike.translationZh: 他们在不同的社交群体中有着相似的思维和行为方式。

ancestor.sentenceEn: And so it was that on October 9, 1946, under the direction of Professor Roy Bowden of the College of Agriculture at the University of Georgia, this little tree was transplanted to the location of its ancestor .
ancestor.translationZh: 于是在1946年10月9日，在佐治亚大学农学院罗伊·鲍登教授的指导下，这棵小树被移植到了它祖先所在的位置。

ancestor.sentenceEn: As opposed to the ancestors Tocqueville compares us to, we do not know the people with whom we have to do, in either the economic or the political sphere.
ancestor.translationZh: 与托克维尔用来比较我们的先辈不同，无论是在经济领域还是政治领域，我们都不了解那些必须与之打交道的人。

ancestor.sentenceEn: This is not to deny that basic forms of trade took place, but, for the most part, our primitive ancestors lived fairly self-reliant, if crushingly poor, lives.
ancestor.translationZh: 这并非否认存在基本形式的贸易活动，但在大多数情况下，我们的远古祖先过着相当自给自足、尽管极度贫困的生活。

ancestor.sentenceEn: Unlike our ancestors in their primitive townships, we rarely have to meet face-to-face the people who've invented, built, shipped, or supplied our goods.
ancestor.translationZh: 与生活在原始村落中的祖先不同，我们很少需要与那些发明、制造、运输或供应我们所需商品的人面对面接触。

ancestor.sentenceEn: In an organized archive, people can do research on their family history and find out how their ancestors came to settle in the new land.
ancestor.translationZh: 在井然有序的档案库中，人们可以研究自己的家族史，了解祖先如何来到这片新土地定居。

ancestor.sentenceEn: Their ancestor is different from that of micro bats.
ancestor.translationZh: 它们的祖先与微型蝙蝠的祖先不同。

appearance.sentenceEn: This legislative proposal essentially set out to harmonize the aesthetic appearance of all the houses in Berkton.
appearance.translationZh: 这项立法提案的本质目的是统一伯克顿所有房屋的外观美感。
appearance.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第6段，第5句

appearance.sentenceEn: Instead, the appearance of a rainbow depends entirely upon the position of the observer in relation to the direction of light.
appearance.translationZh: 相反，彩虹的出现完全取决于观察者相对于光线方向的位置。
appearance.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第1段，第4句

appearance.sentenceEn: Once the desired beauty ideal has been internalized, users are given tools or features to change their appearance to suit the accepted beauty ideal such as editing the image, choosing the ideal filter, the right background.
appearance.translationZh: 一旦用户将理想的 beauty 标准内化，系统就会提供工具或功能让他们调整自己的外貌以符合公认的 beauty 标准，例如编辑图片、选择理想滤镜和合适的背景。
appearance.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第6段，第1句

appearance.sentenceEn: That is to say, comedies that represent the complex and sophisticated code of behaviour current in fashionable circles of society, where appearances count more than true moral character.
appearance.translationZh: 也就是说，这类喜剧描绘了上流社会中复杂而精致的行为准则，在这些圈子里，表面形象比真实品德更为重要。
appearance.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第2段，第5句

appearance.sentenceEn: So how important is the appearance of food?
appearance.translationZh: 那么，食物的外观究竟有多重要呢？
appearance.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第3段，第2句

appearance.sentenceEn: They cannot easily tell apart people with near-identical appearances .
appearance.translationZh: 它们难以区分长相极为相似的人。

archaeologist.sentenceEn: Archaeologists regard themselves as protectors of history, and they see salvors as careless destroyers.
archaeologist.translationZh: 考古学家视自己为历史的守护者，而他们则将打捞人员看作是粗心大意的破坏者。

archaeologist.sentenceEn: Who is more at fault, Bass asks, the professional archaeologist who carefully excavates a site and never publishes on it or the treasure hunter who locates a submerged wreck, salvages part, conserves part, and publishes a book on the operation?
archaeologist.translationZh: 巴斯问道：一位专业考古学家精心发掘了遗址却从不发表研究成果，与一位找到水下沉船、打捞部分文物、保存部分文物并出版相关著作的寻宝者相比，谁的过失更大？

archaeologist.sentenceEn: Archaeologists don't want artifacts ending up in a private collection instead of taking humanity on a journey of understanding.
archaeologist.translationZh: 考古学家不希望这些文物最终落入私人收藏家手中，而是希望它们能带领人类踏上一段启迪心智的认知之旅。

archaeologist.sentenceEn: High-stakes fights over shipwrecks pit archaeologists against treasure hunters in a vicious cycle of accusations.
archaeologist.translationZh: 围绕沉船的高风险争夺战使考古学家与寻宝者陷入相互指责的恶性循环。

archaeologist.sentenceEn: For the archaeologist , everything in a wreck matters—hair, fabric, a fragment of a newspaper, rat bones-all things speak volumes.
archaeologist.translationZh: 对考古学家而言，沉船中的每一件物品都意义非凡——头发、织物、报纸残片、老鼠骨头——所有这些都承载着丰富的信息。

archaeologist.sentenceEn: Salvors of treasures in sunken ships and marine archaeologists are now hostile to each other.
archaeologist.translationZh: 沉船宝藏打捞人员与海洋考古学家如今彼此敌对。

accumulate.sentenceEn: In a review published in the journal *Trends in Cognitive Sciences* on February 11th, researchers propose an explanation for why this might be happening: the brains of older adults allocate more space to accumulated knowledge and have more material to navigate when attempting to access memories.
accumulate.translationZh: 在2月11日发表于《认知科学趋势》期刊的一篇综述中，研究人员对这种现象提出了一种解释：老年人的大脑为积累的知识分配了更多空间，在试图提取记忆时需要处理更多信息。
accumulate.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第2段，第1句

accumulate.sentenceEn: They further hypothesize that older adults may be well served by their prior knowledge when it comes to decision-making, where they can pull on their accumulated wisdom.
accumulate.translationZh: 他们进一步假设，在决策方面，老年人可能会从自己的先验知识中受益匪浅，因为他们可以运用自己积累的智慧。
accumulate.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第4段，第3句

accumulate.sentenceEn: Each might have different viewpoints on how to lead one's lifestyle: some prefer simplicity, some love luxuries, some spend extravagantly, some accumulate as much as they can like a country mouse.
accumulate.translationZh: 每个人对如何生活可能都有不同的看法：有人崇尚简朴，有人喜爱奢华，有人挥霍无度，有人则像田鼠一样拼命积累。
accumulate.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第1段，第3句

accumulate.sentenceEn: Rhetoric is viewed by many philosophers as the method through which the powerful accumulate more power.
accumulate.translationZh: 许多哲学家认为，修辞是有权势者积累更多权力的手段。
accumulate.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第8段，第2句

accumulate.sentenceEn: Before the 20th century, a handful of scientists had been interested in the theoretical relationship between greenhouse gases and climate change, but only the empirical evidence accumulated since the late 20th century established a clear connection between the burning of fossil fuels and a vastly accelerated rise in global temperatures.
accumulate.translationZh: 20世纪之前，仅有少数科学家对温室气体与气候变化之间的理论关系感兴趣，但直到20世纪后期积累的经验证据才明确确立了化石燃料燃烧与全球气温急剧上升之间的联系。

accumulate.sentenceEn: Young adults accumulate knowledge much more quickly than older adults.
accumulate.translationZh: 年轻人积累知识的速度比年长者快得多。

actively.sentenceEn: By both actively promoting civil discourse through these programs, and modeling and upholding the principles of free inquiry and expression for all, libraries help individuals rediscover the importance of and increased need for civil discourse in American life.
actively.translationZh: 图书馆通过这些项目积极促进文明对话，并为所有人树立和坚持自由探究与表达的原则，帮助个人重新认识到文明对话在美国生活中的重要性和日益增长的必要性。

actively.sentenceEn: If the act of giving advice is contributing actively to someone's feelings of self-worth, an outright(直率的) rejection may be perceived as a threat, activating their fight-or-flight response, possibly causing them to double down on their validation-seeking behavior, or leading to a larger conflict.
actively.translationZh: 如果给予建议这一行为正积极地支撑着一个人的自我价值感，那么直接的拒绝可能会被视为一种威胁，从而激发其战斗或逃跑反应。这可能导致他们加倍寻求认可，或者引发更大的冲突。
actively.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第5段，第1句

actively.sentenceEn: A third reason has to do with the way memory works: when training is variable, learners are forced to actively reconstruct their memories.
actively.translationZh: 第三个原因与记忆的工作方式有关：当训练具有可变性时，学习者被迫主动重建他们的记忆。
actively.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第9段，第1句

actively.sentenceEn: Rather than simply blaming the inequality of editorial boards on tradition, we should be actively breaking down these existing barriers.
actively.translationZh: 我们不应简单地将编辑委员会的性别不平等归咎于传统，而应积极打破这些现有的障碍。
actively.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第7段，第4句

actively.sentenceEn: Why does actively opting out of using the internet become a matter of privilege?
actively.translationZh: 为什么主动选择不使用互联网会成为一种特权？

actively.sentenceEn: They have been actively engaged in civic life beyond the school campus.
actively.translationZh: 他们在校外积极参与公民生活。

alien.sentenceEn: Imagine you're an alien sent to Earth to document the behaviour of the mammals inhabiting the planet.
alien.translationZh: 想象一下，你是一名被派往地球的外星人，任务是记录这个星球上哺乳动物的行为。
alien.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第1段，第1句

alien.sentenceEn: Anything found there will be totally alien to what's on the surface of the earth, says Siegert.
alien.translationZh: 西格特说，在那里发现的任何生物都将与地球表面的生物截然不同。
alien.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第3段，第1句

alien.sentenceEn: Imagine that an alien species landed on Earth and, through their mere presence, those aliens caused our art to vanish, our music to homogenize, and our technological know-how to disappear.
alien.translationZh: 试想，如果有外星物种登陆地球，仅仅因为它们的存在，就让我们的艺术消亡、音乐变得同质化、技术知识消失殆尽。
alien.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第1段，第1句

alien.sentenceEn: As a possible home for alien life, it has been voted the planet least likely to succeed.
alien.translationZh: 作为外星生命可能的家园，金星被认为是最不可能有生命存在的行星。
alien.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第4段，第2句

alien.sentenceEn: The alien finds the audience in the movie theatre clearly in a state of ______.
alien.translationZh: 外星人发现电影院里的观众显然处于一种______的状态。

alien.sentenceEn: It is a paradise of romance for alien life.
alien.translationZh: 它曾是外星生命的浪漫天堂。

artifact.sentenceEn: Archives preserve historic artifacts , oral histories, digital history projects, and scholarly writings relevant to the community, including minority groups.
artifact.translationZh: 档案馆保存与社区相关的历史文物、口述历史、数字历史项目和学术著作，包括少数群体的相关资料。

artifact.sentenceEn: Communities lucky enough to have archivists have a great advantage when it comes to organizing historical records and artifacts .
artifact.translationZh: 拥有档案管理员的社区在整理历史记录和文物方面具有巨大优势。

artifact.sentenceEn: When people get involved in making artifacts in architecture or art, they apply these very general concepts in unique ways.
artifact.translationZh: 当人们参与建筑或艺术领域的创作时，他们会以独特方式运用这些非常普遍的概念。
artifact.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第9段，第2句

artifact.sentenceEn: This is why it's important to experience diverse cultures and their artifacts because it opens us up to different ways of approaching or constructing beauty.
artifact.translationZh: 这就是为什么体验多元文化及其产物如此重要——因为它能让我们接触到欣赏和构建美的不同方式。
artifact.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第10段，第1句

artifact.sentenceEn: The results from this study show that people agree very much in their aesthetic evaluation of natural objects, but they disagree more about artifacts , or human-made objects.
artifact.translationZh: 本研究结果表明，人们对自然物体的审美评价存在高度共识，但对人工制品或人为制造物体的评价则分歧较大。
artifact.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第2段，第2句

artifact.sentenceEn: Why do artifacts not always hold universal appeal?
artifact.translationZh: 为什么文物并不总能具有普遍吸引力？

artistic.sentenceEn: Those who have produced their own music, or even fans of authentic, artistic music, will also argue that a computer could never emulate the work (and human touch) of a true musician.
artistic.translationZh: 那些自己创作音乐的人，甚至是真正艺术音乐的爱好者，也会认为计算机永远无法模仿真正音乐家的作品（以及其中的人文温度）。
artistic.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第3段，第4句

artistic.sentenceEn: In recent years, feminists, historians and artists have all praised Merian's tenacity(坚韧), talent and inspirational artistic compositions.
artistic.translationZh: 近年来，女权主义者、历史学家和艺术家都对梅里安的坚韧、才华以及富有启发性的艺术作品赞誉有加。

artistic.sentenceEn: It also adds the element of artistic creativity to attract a new pool of students who may not see themselves as "math people".
artistic.translationZh: 它还加入了艺术创意元素，以吸引那些可能不认为自己是'数学人'的新学生群体。

artistic.sentenceEn: One boy said, "I'd rather be concentrating on artistic efforts than saving the world or something."
artistic.translationZh: 一名男孩表示：“我宁愿专注于艺术创作，也不想去拯救世界之类的。”

artistic.sentenceEn: It is true of critics as well as ordinary people that the popularity of artistic works is closely associated with publicity.
artistic.translationZh: 艺术作品的受欢迎程度与宣传曝光密切相关，这一点对评论家而言与普通大众无异。

artistic.sentenceEn: It is quite common to misinterpret artistic works.
artistic.translationZh: 人们常常会误解艺术作品。

assessment.sentenceEn: There is no comparable full life-cycle assessment for transportation.
assessment.translationZh: 目前尚无类似的交通运输全生命周期评估。

assessment.sentenceEn: The problem was that analysts from the FAO used a comprehensive life-cycle assessment to study the climate impact of livestock, but a different method when they analyzed transportation.
assessment.translationZh: 问题在于，联合国粮农组织(FAO)的分析师在研究畜牧业对气候的影响时使用了全面的生命周期评估方法，而在分析交通运输时却采用了另一种不同的方法。

assessment.sentenceEn: In its most recent assessment report, the FAO estimated that livestock produces 14.5 percent of global greenhouse gas emissions from human activities.
assessment.translationZh: 联合国粮农组织（FAO）在其最新评估报告中估计，畜牧业产生的温室气体排放量占人类活动总排放量的14.5%。

assessment.sentenceEn: Its fourth graders have moved from 49th (out of 50 states) to 29th on the National Assessment of Educational Progress, a nationwide exam.
assessment.translationZh: 该州四年级学生在全国教育进展评估（一项全国性考试）中的排名已从（50个州中的）第49位上升至第29位。
assessment.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第4段，第4句

assessment.sentenceEn: Six laboratory assistants rated each participant's audio clips to see how their observations compared with people's assessment of themselves.
assessment.translationZh: 六位实验室助理对每位参与者的音频片段进行了评分，以比较他们的观察结果与参与者的自我评估。
assessment.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第2段，第1句

assessment.sentenceEn: Its prevalence appears unrelated to any rational assessment of risk.
assessment.translationZh: 这种恐惧的普遍存在似乎与对风险的任何理性评估无关。
assessment.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第2段，第3句

absolutely.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第3段，第2句

absolutely.translationZh: 社交媒体如今无处不在。
absolutely.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第1段，第1句

absolutely.sentenceEn: According to psychologist Sharon Draper, our clothing choices can absolutely affect our well-being.
absolutely.translationZh: 心理学家莎伦·德雷珀认为，我们的着装选择绝对会影响我们的幸福感。
absolutely.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第1段，第1句

absolutely.sentenceEn: David Wallinga, for example, says, "In previous guidelines, they've always been concerned with things like food security—which is presumably the mission of the USDA. You absolutely need to be worried about climate impacts and future sustainability if you want secure food in the future."
absolutely.translationZh: 例如，大卫·沃林加（David Wallinga）表示：“在以往的指南中，他们总是关注粮食安全等问题——这想必是美国农业部的使命所在。如果想要保障未来的粮食安全，就绝对需要关注气候影响和未来的可持续性。”
absolutely.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第8段，第2句

absolutely.sentenceEn: There are likely lots of people who know absolutely nothing about why the moon appears to change its size regularly but act like they know.
absolutely.translationZh: 很可能有很多人完全不知道月亮为什么看起来会有规律地改变大小，却装作自己很懂。

absolutely.sentenceEn: Intimacy is essential but not absolutely indispensable to love.
absolutely.translationZh: 亲密是爱情的重要组成部分，但并非绝对不可或缺。

acre.sentenceEn: After Professor Ward purchased the land, Jackson and his family purchased a 655 acre parcel a few miles away and moved there.
acre.translationZh: 沃德教授买下这片土地后，杰克逊和他的家人在几英里外购买了一块655英亩的土地，并搬到了那里。

acre.sentenceEn: Whatever the case, in 1832 a four acre parcel, which included the land the tree was on and the neighboring land Jackson lived on, among others, was sold to University professor Malthus A Ward.
acre.translationZh: 无论如何，1832年，一块四英亩的土地被卖给了大学教授马尔萨斯·A·沃德，其中包括那棵树所在的土地以及杰克逊等人居住的邻近土地。

acre.sentenceEn: Since 1885, Nebraska has planted more than 700,000 acres of trees, earning it the nickname "the Tree Planters State".
acre.translationZh: 自1885年以来，内布拉斯加州已种植了超过70万英亩的树木，因此赢得了“植树之州”的美誉。
acre.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第3段，第7句

acre.sentenceEn: Most recently a plan proposed building 34 acres of much-needed affordable housing and parking spaces adjacent to the park, bringing with them noise, traffic and pollution.
acre.translationZh: 最近有一项计划提议在公园附近建设34英亩急需的经济适用房和停车场，这将带来噪音、交通拥堵和污染问题。

acre.sentenceEn: Published in the journal Frontiers in Sustainable Cities, the study examined attitudes toward Discovery Park, the heavily forested 534- acre public park in Seattle, Washington.
acre.translationZh: 这项研究发表在《可持续城市前沿》期刊上，调查了人们对探索公园（Discovery Park）的看法。该公园位于华盛顿州西雅图市，是一片森林茂密的公共园区，占地534英亩。

acre.sentenceEn: It is polluting millions of acres of cropland.
acre.translationZh: 它正在污染数百万英亩的农田。

amateur.sentenceEn: In 1969, the Radio Amateur Satellite Corporation (AMSAT) was created in order to foster ham radio enthusiasts'(业余无线电爱好者) participation in space research and communication.
amateur.translationZh: 1969年，无线电业余卫星公司（AMSAT）成立，旨在促进业余无线电爱好者参与太空研究与通信。

amateur.sentenceEn: Yet as LEO opens up to more amateur satellites, they may pose an increasing threat.
amateur.translationZh: 然而，随着近地轨道向更多业余卫星开放，它们可能会构成日益严重的威胁。

amateur.sentenceEn: Some "expert amateurs " in the satellite game could provide some inspiration for how to proceed responsibly.
amateur.translationZh: 卫星领域的一些"业余专家"或许能为如何负责任地推进这项技术提供一些启示。

amateur.sentenceEn: The challenge here, of course, is ensuring that what an amateur community considers to be responsible, actually is.
amateur.translationZh: 当然，这里的挑战在于确保业余爱好者群体所认为的负责任行为，确实是真正负责任的。

amateur.sentenceEn: Yet the evidence from AMSAT and other areas of technology development suggests that responsible amateur communities can and do emerge around novel technologies.
amateur.translationZh: 然而，来自无线电业余卫星公司（AMSAT）和其他技术开发领域的证据表明，负责任的业余爱好者社区能够并且确实围绕新兴技术形成。

amateur.sentenceEn: AMSAT operates on the principle of having all its technical data accessible to its members, preventing the abuse of amateur satellites.
amateur.translationZh: AMSAT 奉行所有技术数据对其成员开放获取的原则，以防止业余卫星被滥用。

anger.sentenceEn: If the tone of a dialogue heats up and anger erupts, the dialogue flips from collaborative to adversarial, and progress is likely to come to an immediate halt.
anger.translationZh: 如果对话的语气变得激烈并爆发愤怒，对话就会从合作性转变为对抗性，进展很可能会立即停滞。
anger.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第2段，第5句

anger.sentenceEn: Carrying the hurt or anger of an offense leads the body to release stress chemicals.
anger.translationZh: 背负着伤害或因冒犯而产生的愤怒会导致身体释放压力化学物质。
anger.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第1段，第6句

anger.sentenceEn: Forgiveness is the release of resentment or anger .
anger.translationZh: 宽恕是对怨恨或愤怒的释放。
anger.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第1段，第1句

anger.sentenceEn: Cynical hostility is defined by high anger and frequent thoughts that other people cannot be trusted.
anger.translationZh: 愤世嫉俗的敌意表现为强烈的愤怒情绪和频繁认为他人不可信的想法。
anger.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第3段，第2句

anger.sentenceEn: Unburdening yourself of frustration, and perhaps even anger to someone who isn't a friend or close colleague can be wonderfully freeing.
anger.translationZh: 向非亲非故的同事倾诉自己的沮丧，甚至愤怒，会让人感到无比轻松。
anger.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第4段，第3句

anger.sentenceEn: One of the first steps in dealing with emotions such as anger or fear is to acknowledge them as normal and human.
anger.translationZh: 处理愤怒或恐惧等情绪的首要步骤之一，是承认这些情绪是正常的人性表现。
anger.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第2段，第1句

award.sentenceEn: We are expected to tangibly succeed, earn awards , get higher positions, earn better grades.
award.translationZh: 我们被期望能取得实实在在的成功、赢得奖项、晋升更高职位以及取得更好的成绩。
award.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第7段，第2句

award.sentenceEn: When they don't get some award , she encourages them to remember that "one outcome is not a basis for a broad conclusion about the person's intelligence, qualifications, or potential for the future."
award.translationZh: 当他们未能获得某项奖项时，她会鼓励他们记住：'单一结果并不能作为对个人智力、资质或未来潜力下定论的依据。'

award.sentenceEn: Prizes were awarded to counties, cities, and individuals who planted the largest number of trees.
award.translationZh: 植树数量最多的县、市和个人获得了奖励。
award.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第3段，第5句

award.sentenceEn: Her first novel, Behind the Scenes at the Museum, won the 1995 UK Book of the Year award .
award.translationZh: 她的第一部小说《博物馆幕后》荣获1995年英国年度图书奖。
award.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第1段，第7句

award.sentenceEn: It was in 1956 that the very first bachelor of science in environmental studies was awarded , at the State University of New York College of Forestry at Syracuse.
award.translationZh: 1956年，纽约州立大学锡拉丘兹环境科学与林业学院授予了首个环境研究学学士学位。

award.sentenceEn: A special prize was awarded to Julius Morton.
award.translationZh: 朱利叶斯·莫顿获得了一项特别奖。

abundant.sentenceEn: Abundant research shows the harms of social isolation, considered a serious public health problem in countries that have rapidly ageing populations (though talk of a 'loneliness epidemic' may be exaggerated).
abundant.translationZh: 大量研究表明，社会隔离会带来诸多危害。在人口快速老龄化的国家，这已被视为一个严重的公共卫生问题（尽管有关“孤独流行病”的说法可能言过其实）。

abundant.sentenceEn: "Anything you see here is a forgotten crop," says Sayed Azam-Ali of the abundant plants weaving through the gardens of CFF outside Malaysia's capital Kuala Lumpur.
abundant.translationZh: 马来西亚首都吉隆坡郊外的CFF花园里，各种植物枝繁叶茂、交错生长。赛义德·阿扎姆-阿里指着这些植物说：“你在这里看到的每一种都是被遗忘的作物。”

abundant.sentenceEn: Hale wasn't just a writer, she was also a fierce social advocate, and she was particularly obsessed with an ideal New England, which she associated with abundant Thanksgiving meals that she claimed had "a deep moral influence."
abundant.translationZh: 黑尔不仅是一位作家，还是一位积极的社会倡导者。她对理想中的新英格兰情有独钟，在她看来，这个地区与丰盛的感恩节大餐密不可分，而她认为这样的大餐具有“深远的道德影响力”。
abundant.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第2段，第1句

abundant.sentenceEn: Based on the findings, the researchers suggest that the key to boosting your willpower is to believe that you have an abundant supply of it.
abundant.translationZh: 基于这些发现，研究人员提出，增强意志力的关键在于相信自己拥有充沛的意志力。
abundant.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第3段，第1句

abundant.sentenceEn: There is abundant evidence that we are now facing a possible ecological disaster.
abundant.translationZh: 有充分证据表明，我们目前正面临一场可能发生的生态灾难。

abundant.sentenceEn: Humans had access to abundant food sources there.
abundant.translationZh: 那里有丰富的食物来源可供人类获取。

acceptance.sentenceEn: During his acceptance speech for the Nobel Peace Prize, Martin Luther King Jr. said, "I believe that unarmed truth and unconditional love will have the final word in reality."
acceptance.translationZh: 马丁·路德·金在诺贝尔和平奖获奖演说中说道：“我相信，赤手空拳的真理和无条件的爱将在现实中拥有最终的发言权。”
acceptance.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第1段，第1句

acceptance.sentenceEn: Until then, early adopters, such as the Manchester bar owner Andy Smith, who uses the Ordoo app at his venue 33 Oldham Street, may well experience growing but "lower than expected" acceptance .
acceptance.translationZh: 在此之前，早期的尝试者——比如在自己的 33 Oldham Street 酒吧里使用 Ordoo 应用程序的曼彻斯特酒吧老板安迪·史密斯（Andy Smith）——很可能会经历一个虽然在增长但仍“低于预期”的接受过程。

acceptance.sentenceEn: "A significant milestone in the cultural evolution of human minds was the acceptance that the Earth is not the centre of the universe, the so-called Copernican Revolution," he writes.
acceptance.translationZh: 他写道：“人类思想文化演进的一个重要里程碑是接受地球并非宇宙中心这一观点，即所谓的哥白尼革命。”
acceptance.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第2段，第2句

acceptance.sentenceEn: In the 1990s, the hypothesis found widespread acceptance .
acceptance.translationZh: 20世纪90年代，这一假说获得了广泛认可。
acceptance.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第1段，第4句

acceptance.sentenceEn: At the same time, he also suffered tremendously from a need for acceptance that drove, and sometimes stained, every one of his relationships.
acceptance.translationZh: 与此同时，他也因极度渴望被接纳而深受煎熬，这种渴望驱动着他的每一段人际关系，有时也玷污了这些关系。

acceptance.sentenceEn: Despite his autonomy, Marconi felt alienated and suffered from a lack of acceptance .
acceptance.translationZh: 尽管马可尼能够保持高度自主，但他仍感到自己是个局外人，并因缺乏他人的接纳而深受困扰。

accomplishment.sentenceEn: Brustein says his perfectionist clients tend to devalue their accomplishments , so that every time a goal is achieved, the high lasts only a short time, like "a gas tank with a hole in it."
accomplishment.translationZh: 布鲁斯坦表示，他的完美主义客户往往会贬低自己的成就，因此每当达成一个目标时，那种成就感带来的愉悦感只会持续很短时间，就像“一个有漏洞的油箱”。

accomplishment.sentenceEn: But repeating that accomplishment is often not realistic, which can lead to severe negative emotional consequences when it doesn't reoccur.
accomplishment.translationZh: 但重复那种成就往往不切实际，当无法再次实现时，可能会导致严重的负面情绪后果。
accomplishment.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第2段，第3句

accomplishment.sentenceEn: In the workplace, if that pleasure comes from a triumph which swells our self-respect, people will try to repeat the accomplishment .
accomplishment.translationZh: 在职场中，如果这种愉悦感来自于某项提升自尊的成就，人们就会尝试重复这一成就。
accomplishment.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第2段，第2句

accomplishment.sentenceEn: The third cause of poor management was associated with a deficiency of qualifications not so much the formal variety one obtains from a university, but the informal variety that comes from credible work experience and professional accomplishments .
accomplishment.translationZh: 管理不善的第三个原因与资质欠缺有关——这里所说的资质并非主要指大学所授予的那种正规学历，而是来自可靠工作经验和专业成就的非正规资质。
accomplishment.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第5段，第1句

accomplishment.sentenceEn: The celebration of milestones may prompt staff to be more grateful about their own accomplishments and privileges.
accomplishment.translationZh: 对里程碑的庆祝可能会促使员工对自己的成就和所享有的待遇更加心存感激。
accomplishment.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第2段，第4句

accomplishment.translationZh: 它有助于个人取得成就。

accustomed.sentenceEn: Sometimes we become accustomed to relying on our guts when it comes to decision-making.
accustomed.translationZh: 在做决策时，我们有时会习惯于依赖自己的直觉。

accustomed.sentenceEn: Fruitful debates might actually take place in this area, as opposed to the familiar ritual we've become accustomed to of condemnation met with counter-condemnation.
accustomed.translationZh: 在这一领域或许能开展富有成效的辩论，而非我们早已习惯的那种相互谴责的熟悉套路。

accustomed.sentenceEn: I bet it would be hard though, giving up something you're accustomed to eating.
accustomed.translationZh: 不过我敢说，要戒掉你已经习惯吃的东西肯定很难。
accustomed.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第6段，第4句

accustomed.sentenceEn: Not only have we grown accustomed to getting the information we want instantaneously, our attention spans are much shorter.
accustomed.translationZh: 我们不仅已经习惯了即时获取所需信息，注意力持续时间也变得短多了。
accustomed.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第3段，第4句

accustomed.sentenceEn: Though many people are accustomed to wearing shoes during all their waking hours, the more time you spend wearing shoes, the more likely you are to incur foot injuries as a result.
accustomed.translationZh: 尽管许多人习惯在醒着的所有时间都穿着鞋，但你穿鞋的时间越长，就越有可能因此导致脚部受伤。
accustomed.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第3段，第3句

accustomed.sentenceEn: She was accustomed to tight schedules.
accustomed.translationZh: 她习惯了紧凑的日程安排。

administration.sentenceEn: It looks like the government of Winopia seems to be undergoing some sort of crisis of legitimacy, and an interim administration has been transitionally established until a head of state is agreed on.
administration.translationZh: 维诺比亚政府似乎正在经历某种合法性危机，目前已成立临时内阁，直到就国家元首人选达成一致为止。
administration.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第4段，第2句

administration.sentenceEn: American colleges and universities are using 64 percent less coal than they did a decade ago, burning 700,000 tons last year, down from 2 million tons in 2008, the U.S. Energy Information Administration (EIA) said in a report released yesterday.
administration.translationZh: 美国能源信息署（EIA）在昨日发布的一份报告中指出，美国高校的煤炭使用量较十年前减少了64%，去年燃煤量为70万吨，低于2008年的200万吨。
administration.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第1段，第1句

administration.sentenceEn: A time-determined revalidation would ease administration for everybody.
administration.translationZh: 按时间定期重新认证将简化各方的管理工作。

administration.sentenceEn: Morgan notified the Haslam administration of his decision to opt out in a letter sent last week.
administration.translationZh: 摩根在上周致信哈斯拉姆政府，告知其决定退出该计划。
administration.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第5段，第1句

administration.sentenceEn: What does Laura Hamilton say about college administrations ?
administration.translationZh: 劳拉·汉密尔顿对大学行政部门有何评价？

administration.sentenceEn: Allow taxpayers to participate in college administration .
administration.translationZh: 允许纳税人参与大学管理

affair.sentenceEn: As Tocqueville notes, "as soon as a man begins to deal with common affairs in public, he begins to perceive that he is not so independent of his fellow men as he had first imagined, and that in order to obtain their support he must often lend them his cooperation."
affair.translationZh: 正如托克维尔所指出的：“当一个人开始处理公共事务时，他就会意识到自己并不像最初想象的那样独立于他人，而为了获得他人的支持，他往往必须给予他人合作。”

affair.sentenceEn: Accusing individuals or groups of being radical often serves to silence them into submission, thereby maintaining the existing state of affairs , and, more important, preserving the power of a select minority who are mostly wealthy white males in western society.
affair.translationZh: 指责个人或群体"极端"，往往是为了迫使他们保持沉默、顺从，从而维持现状，更重要的是，维护少数精英的权力——在西方社会，这些精英大多是富有的白人男性。
affair.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第1段，第3句

affair.sentenceEn: To me, a radical is simply someone who rebels against the norm or advocates a change in the existing state of affairs .
affair.translationZh: 在我看来，所谓激进者，不过是那些反抗常规或主张改变现状的人。
affair.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第4段，第1句

affair.sentenceEn: So why then is deviation from the present situation such a threat when the state of affairs itself is unstable and subject to relentless transformation?
affair.translationZh: 那么，既然现状本身就不稳定，且不断经历着无情的变革，为何偏离现状会被视为如此大的威胁呢？
affair.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第5段，第1句

affair.sentenceEn: What does the man say about most people when they get into love affairs ?
affair.translationZh: 这位男士说大多数人开始恋爱时是怎样的？

affluent.sentenceEn: A key obstacle to promoting fading local crops in Malaysia, for example, is "the obsession with imported products", says Jenifer Kuah, co-founder of a restaurant that champions locally-sourced food in an affluent suburb of Kuala Lumpur.
affluent.translationZh: 例如，在马来西亚推广日渐式微的本地农作物面临的一个主要障碍是“对进口产品的痴迷”，詹妮弗·夸（Jenifer Kuah）表示，她是吉隆坡一个富裕郊区一家倡导本地食材餐厅的联合创始人。

affluent.sentenceEn: This policy is just giving money away to universities and the most affluent students in attendance.
affluent.translationZh: 这项政策不过是在把钱白白送给大学和那些最富裕的在校生。
affluent.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第2段，第2句

affluent.sentenceEn: A Stanford study in 2014 suggested the same was true for students in California's affluent communities.
affluent.translationZh: 斯坦福大学2014年的一项研究表明，这一结论同样适用于加利福尼亚富裕社区的学生。
affluent.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第2段，第1句

affluent.sentenceEn: People living in the most deprived areas are four times more prone to die from avoidable causes than counterparts in more affluent places.
affluent.translationZh: 生活在最贫困地区的人们死于可避免原因的可能性是富裕地区居民的四倍。
affluent.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第4段，第2句

affluent.sentenceEn: Parenting approaches of working-class and affluent families both have advantages.
affluent.translationZh: 工薪阶层和富裕家庭的育儿方式各有优势。

affluent.sentenceEn: It is a choice more affluent people will endorse.
affluent.translationZh: 这是更富裕人群会认可的选择。

agent.sentenceEn: And make sure your name is on the bag, along with your phone number, so an agent can contact you.
agent.translationZh: 请务必在包上标明您的姓名和电话号码，以便工作人员与您联系。
agent.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第5段，第2句

agent.sentenceEn: "You might imagine micro-robots as agents to repair or assemble small structures or machines in industry or as surgical assistants to clear clogged arteries, to stop internal bleeding, or to eliminate cancerous tumours—all in minimally invasive procedures," Rogers said.
agent.translationZh: 罗杰斯说：“你可以将微型机器人想象成工业中用于修复或组装小型结构或机器的工具，或者是外科手术的助手，用于疏通堵塞的动脉、止血或消除癌性肿瘤——所有这些都通过微创手术完成。”
agent.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第4段，第2句

agent.sentenceEn: It is important to buy the insurance from companies that are financially sound and that are represented by honest, well-trained agents .
agent.translationZh: 重要的是，要从财务状况良好的保险公司购买保险，且这些公司应有诚实、训练有素的代理人提供服务。
agent.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第1段，第3句

agent.sentenceEn: M: That's what forwarding agents are for.
agent.translationZh: 这正是货运代理的用处。
agent.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第26段，第1句

agent.sentenceEn: Typists, ticket agents , bank tellers and many production-line jobs have been dispensed with, just as the weavers were.
agent.translationZh: 打字员、票务代理、银行柜员以及许多生产线岗位都已不复存在，就像当年的手工织布工一样。
agent.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第1段，第4句

agent.sentenceEn: Get the airline agent 's phone number before boarding.
agent.translationZh: 登机前请先获取航司代理的电话号码。

aggressive.sentenceEn: The chaos and never-ending turmoil that accompanies everyday life is an aggressive obstacle in the pursuit of stable friendships.
aggressive.translationZh: 日常生活中伴随的混乱与无休止的纷扰，是追求稳定友谊道路上的巨大障碍。
aggressive.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第2段，第1句

aggressive.sentenceEn: Will it be one where the elite command the vast bulk of wealth and regional culture is defined by an aggressive business world?
aggressive.translationZh: 我们会成为一个由精英阶层掌控绝大部分财富、区域文化被激进商业世界所定义的社会吗？

aggressive.sentenceEn: His 2013 book, Salt Sugar Fat, explored food companies' aggressive marketing of those products and their impact on our health.
aggressive.translationZh: 他2013年出版的著作《盐糖脂》探讨了食品公司对这些产品的激进营销策略及其对我们健康的影响。
aggressive.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第1段，第3句

aggressive.sentenceEn: However, conflict between characters is often depicted with characters being unkind to each other or they may use emotionally aggressive tactics with each other.
aggressive.translationZh: 然而，角色之间的冲突往往被描绘为角色间的不友善行为，或者他们可能会使用情感攻击策略对待彼此。
aggressive.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第2段，第5句
