aggressive.sentenceEn: Currently, under an aggressive Hindu nationalist government, Muslims, Christians, disadvantaged classes and indigenous communities are being compelled to give up their traditional foods.
aggressive.translationZh: 当前，在奉行激进印度教民族主义的政府统治下，穆斯林、基督徒、弱势群体以及原住民正被迫放弃他们的传统饮食。
aggressive.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第5段，第1句

aggressive.sentenceEn: Remove aggressive obstacles in the way.

alarm.sentenceEn: As soon as the first alarm goes off, stop what you're doing.
alarm.translationZh: 第一声警报一响，立即停下手中的事情。
alarm.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第3段，第4句

alarm.sentenceEn: This will only work if you take the alarms seriously, so make sure you react as soon as you hear them.
alarm.translationZh: 这只有在你认真对待警报的情况下才会奏效，所以听到警报时一定要立即采取行动。
alarm.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第3段，第8句

alarm.sentenceEn: Aim to be out the door and on your way before the second alarm rings.
alarm.translationZh: 目标是在第二个闹钟响起前出门上路。
alarm.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第3段，第7句

alarm.sentenceEn: This observation is bound to set Marxist alarm bells ringing in the minds of some readers, but it was first made by Alexis de Tocqueville in 1840.
alarm.translationZh: 这一观察定会让部分读者脑中的马克思主义警钟敲响，但它最初是由亚历克西斯·德·托克维尔在1840年提出的。

alarm.sentenceEn: Along with other therapists, Pryor, who is now with the Family Institute at Northwestern University, is trying to sound the alarm about a tendency among young adults and college students to strive for perfection in their work—sometimes at any cost.
alarm.translationZh: 普赖尔目前就职于西北大学家庭研究所，她正与其他治疗师一起，试图就年轻人和大学生在工作中追求完美——有时不惜任何代价——这一趋势发出警告。

alarm.sentenceEn: College professors are increasingly raising alarm bells about the effects smartphones, laptops, and tablets have on academic performance.
alarm.translationZh: 大学教授们越来越对智能手机、笔记本电脑和平板电脑对学业成绩的影响敲响警钟。
alarm.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第3段，第1句

altogether.sentenceEn: Last Tuesday, it just stopped working altogether .
altogether.translationZh: 上周二，它就完全停止工作了。
altogether.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第8段，第3句

altogether.sentenceEn: The perfectionist in you might be screaming to abandon your goals altogether , but try to see it in the bigger picture.
altogether.translationZh: 你内心的完美主义可能在尖叫着让你彻底放弃目标，但不妨从更宏观的角度来看待这件事。

altogether.sentenceEn: "Growing economic power, growing influence on local markets all over the world, and a growing concern of competitors and consumers altogether have made it happen now."
altogether.translationZh: 日益增强的经济实力、对全球各地本地市场日益扩大的影响力，以及竞争对手和消费者与日俱增的担忧，共同促成了当前局面的形成。
altogether.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第3段，第2句

altogether.sentenceEn: When they become too short, the cell stops dividing altogether .
altogether.translationZh: 当端粒变得过短时，细胞就会完全停止分裂。
altogether.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第2段，第4句

altogether.sentenceEn: Recent research has shown that even if Americans quit eating meat altogether , the resulting reduction of greenhouse gases in the U.S. would be slight.
altogether.translationZh: 近期研究表明，即使美国人完全停止食用肉类，美国温室气体排放的减少幅度也会非常有限。

altogether.sentenceEn: It will take away humans' jobs altogether .
altogether.translationZh: 它会彻底夺走人类的工作。

ambitious.sentenceEn: In Los Angeles, California, an ambitious project to go a step further and synchronize(使同步) every red light in Los Angeles cost over 400 million dollars.
ambitious.translationZh: 在加利福尼亚州洛杉矶，一项旨在更进一步、同步全市所有红绿灯的雄心勃勃的项目耗资超过了 4 亿美元。

ambitious.sentenceEn: "You're in New York because you're ambitious , you have this need to strive," he says.
ambitious.translationZh: 他说：“你来到纽约，是因为你有野心，有这种不断追求的渴望。”

ambitious.sentenceEn: However, the ambitious scientist received negligible support from the government.
ambitious.translationZh: 然而，这位雄心勃勃的科学家从政府获得的支持微乎其微。
ambitious.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第5段，第1句

ambitious.sentenceEn: Co-founder Kresse Wesling said, "Late last year we launched an ambitious five-year partnership with the Burberry Foundation. The main aim of this is to scale our leather rescue project, starting with off-cuts from the production of Burberry leather goods. We are working tirelessly to expand our solutions and would love to welcome anyone to our workshop to come and see what we are doing."
ambitious.translationZh: 联合创始人克雷斯·韦斯林表示：“去年年底，我们与博柏利基金会启动了一项雄心勃勃的五年合作计划。其主要目的是扩大我们的皮革回收项目规模，首先从博柏利皮革制品生产过程中产生的边角料入手。我们正在不懈努力拓展解决方案，非常欢迎任何人来我们的工作室参观我们的工作。”

ambitious.sentenceEn: According to the speaker, what should you do if your ultimate aim is rather ambitious ?
ambitious.translationZh: 根据讲话者的观点，如果你的最终目标相当宏大，你应该怎么做？

ambitious.sentenceEn: Use a key tool for setting ambitious goals.
ambitious.translationZh: 使用关键工具设定远大目标。

appreciation.sentenceEn: Dr. Curry hopes that this research helps to promote mutual understanding between people of different cultures and appreciation of what we have in common and how and why we differ.
appreciation.translationZh: 柯里博士希望这项研究能够促进不同文化背景人们之间的相互理解，增进对我们共同之处以及差异所在及其原因的认识。
appreciation.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第3段，第5句

appreciation.sentenceEn: Sprinkling in positivity via appreciation , affectionate smiles, and warm comments helps.
appreciation.translationZh: 通过表达欣赏、亲切的微笑和温暖的话语来传递积极情绪，这会很有帮助。
appreciation.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第2段，第3句

appreciation.sentenceEn: It found that the public had the most appreciation for—and gained the most value from—the wildest parts of the park.
appreciation.translationZh: 研究发现，公众对公园中最原始的区域最为欣赏，也从中获得了最大价值。

appreciation.sentenceEn: "Why is it so difficult for folks to develop an appreciation and understanding for the mannerisms and traditions of classical music?" asked another.
appreciation.translationZh: 另一位评论者问道：“为什么人们就这么难培养对古典音乐礼仪和传统的欣赏与理解呢？”

appreciation.sentenceEn: This can help develop understanding, acceptance and appreciation of diversity.
appreciation.translationZh: 这有助于培养对多样性的理解、接纳和欣赏。
appreciation.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第2段，第6句

appreciation.sentenceEn: The appreciation of their beauty is not subject to objective standards.
appreciation.translationZh: 对它们美的欣赏没有客观标准。

approval.sentenceEn: This means increasing housing density throughout the region and building upwards while streamlining the approval process.
approval.translationZh: 这意味着需要在整个地区提高住房密度，增加高层建筑，同时简化审批流程。

approval.sentenceEn: Wardian started saving for the trip in 2014, connecting with sponsors and getting approval from his wife, Jennifer, before committing.
approval.translationZh: 沃迪安从2014年开始为这次旅程存钱，在最终确定参加前，他联系了赞助商并征得了妻子詹妮弗的同意。

approval.sentenceEn: Instead of a quest for knowledge, it engages us in an endless zest(热情) for instant approval from an audience, for which we are constantly but unconsciously performing.
approval.translationZh: 它没有激发我们对知识的追求，反而使我们热衷于不断从观众那里获得即时认可，为此我们一直在无意识地表演。
approval.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第4段，第3句

approval.sentenceEn: In Atomic Habits, I wrote, "Humans are herd animals. We want to fit in, to bond with others, and to earn the respect and approval of our peers. Such inclinations are essential to our survival. For most of our evolutionary history, our ancestors lived in tribes. Becoming separated from the tribe—or worse, being cast out—was a death sentence."
approval.translationZh: 在《原子习惯》一书中，我写道：“人类是群居动物。我们渴望融入群体、与他人建立联系，并获得同伴的尊重与认可。这些倾向对我们的生存至关重要。在人类进化史的大部分时间里，我们的祖先都生活在部落中。脱离部落——或者更糟的是被驱逐出去——无异于被判死刑。”

approval.sentenceEn: One way to deal with the housing crisis is for the government to simplify approval procedures for housing projects.
approval.translationZh: 解决住房危机的一个方法是政府简化住房项目的审批程序。

approval.sentenceEn: They are constantly seeking approval from their audience.
approval.translationZh: 他们在不断寻求观众的认可。

approximately.sentenceEn: It seems I am just lazy, because elite sleepers are defined as the approximately 3 percent of the population who are biologically programmed to need less sleep than the rest of us.
approximately.translationZh: 看来我只是懒而已，因为精英睡眠者被定义为大约3%的人群，他们的生理结构决定了他们比我们其他人需要更少的睡眠。
approximately.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第2段，第2句

approximately.sentenceEn: After a century of ignorance, London was hit by the Great Smog of December 1952—the worst air-pollution event in the history of the United Kingdom which caused the deaths of approximately 12,000 people.
approximately.translationZh: 在经历了一个世纪的忽视之后，伦敦于1952年12月遭遇了"大烟雾"事件——这是英国历史上最严重的空气污染事件，造成约12,000人死亡。

approximately.sentenceEn: Federal Reserve data reveals that the highest-income 40 percent of households owe approximately 60 percent of outstanding student debt, while the lowest 40 percent owe just under 20 percent.
approximately.translationZh: 美联储数据显示，收入最高的40%家庭欠下了约60%的未偿还学生债务，而收入最低的40%家庭仅欠下不到20%。
approximately.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第2段，第3句

approximately.sentenceEn: Plus, the majority of student debt is held by graduate degree earners, who earn approximately 25 percent more than their undergraduate counterparts.
approximately.translationZh: 此外，大部分学生债务由研究生学历持有者承担，他们的收入比本科生大约高出25%。
approximately.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第2段，第5句

approximately.sentenceEn: The government keeps a steady supply of approximately two billion bills in circulation at all times.
approximately.translationZh: 美国政府始终保持着约20亿张纸币的稳定流通量。
approximately.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第6段，第2句

approximately.sentenceEn: Approximately 60% of student debt remains unpaid.
approximately.translationZh: 大约60%的学生贷款尚未偿还。

array.sentenceEn: Possible universal principles of beauty—such as proportion, fittingness, radiance, and others—are general categories, which allow for a wide array of embodiments.
array.translationZh: 美的可能普世原则——如比例、适宜性、光彩等——是一般性范畴，允许广泛的具体体现形式。
array.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第9段，第1句

array.sentenceEn: We've come to believe that a good college should have many academic programs and excellent facilities, posh(豪华的) dorms, an array of athletic programs, and a world-class student activity center.
array.translationZh: 我们逐渐认为，一所优秀的大学应该拥有众多学术项目和一流设施、豪华宿舍、一系列体育项目以及世界级的学生活动中心。

array.sentenceEn: For now, research suggests dog ownership can have an array of benefits in and of itself.
array.translationZh: 就目前而言，研究表明养狗本身就可以带来诸多益处。
array.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第4段，第3句

array.sentenceEn: Researchers believe that companies that sell a wide array of products online can benefit most from the insights this study provides.
array.translationZh: 研究人员认为，销售多种在线产品的公司能从这项研究提供的见解中获益最多。
array.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第5段，第1句

array.sentenceEn: It is about devising retail models that work for people who are making increasing use of a growing array of internet-connected tools to change how they search, shop, and buy.
array.translationZh: 它关乎设计适合当下消费者的零售模式——这些消费者正越来越多地使用各类联网工具来改变他们搜索、购物和购买的方式。

array.sentenceEn: It embodies beauty with a wide array of aesthetic features.
array.translationZh: 它集多种美学特色于一身，彰显美感。

arrow.sentenceEn: When a flashing yellow arrow is shown, you can take the turn after yielding to pedestrians and traffic.
arrow.translationZh: 当黄色箭头闪烁时，您可以在礼让行人及车辆后进行转弯。

arrow.sentenceEn: The red arrow is about to start.

However, you can take a right on a red arrow after a full stop in the states of Illinois, Kansas, Louisiana, Maryland, Michigan, New Hampshire, North Dakota, Oregon, South Carolina, Utah, Washington State and Wyoming.
arrow.translationZh: 但在伊利诺伊州、堪萨斯州、路易斯安那州、马里兰州、密歇根州、新罕布什尔州、北达科他州、俄勒冈州、南卡罗来纳州、犹他州、华盛顿州和怀俄明州，红灯箭头亮起时，在完全停车确认安全后可以右转。

arrow.sentenceEn: The green arrow , in these cases, is the only time you can make the turn.
arrow.translationZh: 在这种情况下，只有绿色箭头亮起时你才能转弯。

arrow.sentenceEn: In a four-signal system that has a flashing yellow arrow , the steady yellow arrow is a signal that the yield period is ending.
arrow.translationZh: 在具有闪烁黄箭头的四信号系统中，常亮黄箭头表示避让时间即将结束。

arrow.sentenceEn: Upon seeing a flashing yellow arrow , a driver should let pedestrians and traffic pass first before taking the turn.
arrow.translationZh: 看到黄色闪烁箭头时，驾驶员应在转弯前先礼让行人和车辆优先通过。

abstract.sentenceEn: They can generalize such abstract concepts as causal relationships and social roles from just a few examples.
abstract.translationZh: 他们仅从少数几个例子中就能归纳出因果关系和社会角色等抽象概念。
abstract.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第2段，第3句

abstract.sentenceEn: The ability to make inferences from same and different, once thought to be unique to humans, is viewed as a cornerstone of abstract intelligent thought.
abstract.translationZh: 从相同与不同中进行推理的能力，曾一度被认为是人类独有的，如今被视为抽象智能思维的基石。
abstract.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第1段，第1句

abstract.sentenceEn: These findings suggest that ducklings use abstract relationships between sensory inputs like color, shape, sounds and odor to recognize their mothers, said Dr. Kacelnik.
abstract.translationZh: 卡塞尔尼克博士表示，这些发现表明，小鸭会利用颜色、形状、声音和气味等感官输入之间的抽象关系来识别自己的母亲。
abstract.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第8段，第1句

abstract.sentenceEn: Adding ducklings to the list—particularly untrained newborn ducklings—suggests that the ability to compare abstract concepts "is far more necessary to a wider variety of animals' survival than we previously thought," Dr. Martinho said.
abstract.translationZh: 马丁霍博士表示，将小鸭——尤其是未经训练的新生小鸭——加入这一列表，表明比较抽象概念的能力'对于更多种类动物的生存而言，远比我们之前认为的更为必要'。
abstract.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第11段，第1句

abstract.sentenceEn: To assess whether the authors claimed any causation, researchers then looked for telltale verbs in each paper's title and abstract , verbs like "enhance," "promote," "facilitate," and "strengthen."
abstract.translationZh: 为了评估作者是否声称存在因果关系，研究人员随后在每篇论文的标题和摘要中寻找能说明问题的动词，如“增强”、“促进”、“推动”和“加强”等。

abstract.sentenceEn: It avoids detailing abstract concepts of physics.
abstract.translationZh: 它避免详述物理学的抽象概念。

academically.sentenceEn: Meanwhile, the average child with even just one unexcused absence does much worse academically than peers with none.
academically.translationZh: 与此同时，即使只有一次无故缺课的普通儿童，其学业表现也比从未缺课的同龄人差得多。
academically.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第7段，第1句

academically.sentenceEn: So academically , I'd say they're pretty much the same.
academically.translationZh: 所以从学术角度来说，我认为它们基本上是一样的。
academically.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第3段，第3句

academically.sentenceEn: Follow up studies have found that those who chose to delay satisfaction are now more academically successful, have greater self-worth, and even tend to be healthier.
academically.translationZh: 后续研究发现，那些选择延迟满足的孩子如今在学业上更成功，拥有更强的自我价值感，甚至往往更健康。
academically.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第3段，第5句

academically.sentenceEn: This teaches them how to handle and recover from disappointment, which is associated with greater success and satisfaction academically , financially and in personal relationships.
academically.translationZh: 这教会他们如何应对失望并从中恢复，这与学术、经济以及人际关系方面更大的成功和满足感息息相关。
academically.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第4段，第2句

academically.sentenceEn: For Copeland, the experience has not only been academically satisfying, but also has enriched his life in several ways.
academically.translationZh: 对科普兰而言，这段经历不仅在学术上令他感到满足，还在多个方面丰富了他的人生。
academically.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第3段，第1句

academically.translationZh: 他们在学业上表现更好。

accompany.sentenceEn: This constant need to succeed has blinded us from seeing through the whirlwind of change that accompanies our everyday lives.
accompany.translationZh: 这种对成功的不断渴求，让我们在日常生活的变革旋涡中迷失了双眼。
accompany.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第7段，第1句

accompany.sentenceEn: The chaos and never-ending turmoil that accompanies everyday life is an aggressive obstacle in the pursuit of stable friendships.
accompany.translationZh: 日常生活中伴随的混乱与无休止的纷扰，是追求稳定友谊道路上的巨大障碍。
accompany.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第2段，第1句

accompany.sentenceEn: Take illustration for example: most readers don't care whether the graphic accompanying a magazine article was drawn by a person or a computer — they just want it to be relevant, new and perhaps entertaining.
accompany.translationZh: 以插画为例：大多数读者并不关心杂志文章的配图是出自人手还是计算机之手——他们只希望这些图片具有相关性、新颖性，并带有一些趣味性。
accompany.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第4段，第2句

accompany.sentenceEn: When there was a great deal of food available, ancient people would gorge on calories; this massive calorie intake was accompanied by an urge to get active.
accompany.translationZh: 当食物供应充足时，古人会大量摄入卡路里；这种大量的卡路里摄入会伴随着活动的冲动。
accompany.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第2段，第2句

accompany.sentenceEn: Biodiversity loss, environmental degradation, and severe impacts on ecosystem services have not only accompanied conventional farming systems but have often extended well beyond their field boundaries.
accompany.translationZh: 生物多样性减少、环境退化以及对生态系统服务的严重影响不仅伴随着传统农业体系，而且往往远远超出了其田间范围。
accompany.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第6段，第2句

accompany.sentenceEn: Young children should be accompanied by parents during screen time.
accompany.translationZh: 幼儿在使用屏幕时应有家长陪同。

accuracy.sentenceEn: It turns out that if we're unable to see the face, but rather focus on the voice of the person in question, our accuracy rate improves considerably.
accuracy.translationZh: 事实证明，如果我们不去看对方的脸，而是专注于其声音，我们的判断准确率会显著提高。
accuracy.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第4段，第4句

accuracy.sentenceEn: Using scientific methods, some of them can define authorship with 85% accuracy .
accuracy.translationZh: 借助科学方法，其中一些技术能够以85%的准确率确定作者身份。
accuracy.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第6段，第5句

accuracy.sentenceEn: However, truth and accuracy are not the only things that matter to the human mind.
accuracy.translationZh: 然而，对人类心智而言，真相与准确性并非唯一重要的事物。

accuracy.sentenceEn: With research results showing the cumulative effects of sleep loss and its impact on productivity, doubt has been voiced about the accuracy of Steel's self-assessment.
accuracy.translationZh: 研究结果显示睡眠不足会产生累积效应并影响工作效率，因此有人对斯蒂尔自我评估的准确性提出了质疑。
accuracy.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第4段，第2句

accuracy.sentenceEn: When we absorb information for the purpose of imparting it to others, we do so with greater accuracy and depth.
accuracy.translationZh: 当我们为了教授他人而吸收信息时，我们会学得更加准确和深入。

accuracy.sentenceEn: It ensures the accuracy of their arguments.
accuracy.translationZh: 它确保了他们论点的准确性。

accurately.sentenceEn: So understanding and accurately forecasting flood risks is a key challenge for vulnerable cities around the globe.
accurately.translationZh: 因此，理解并准确预测洪水风险是全球易受影响城市面临的一项关键挑战。
accurately.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第1段，第3句

accurately.sentenceEn: The human visual system tends to misjudge size, shape, color, and angles but artists perceive these qualities more accurately than non-artists.
accurately.translationZh: 人类的视觉系统往往会错误判断大小、形状、颜色和角度，但艺术家比非艺术家能更准确地感知这些特质。
accurately.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第7段，第2句

accurately.sentenceEn: There's also evidence that drawing talent is based on how accurately someone perceives the world.
accurately.translationZh: 还有证据表明，绘画天赋取决于一个人感知世界的准确程度。
accurately.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第7段，第1句

accurately.sentenceEn: But few people indeed can accurately describe the world's most powerful, important currency.
accurately.translationZh: 但真正能准确描述这种世界上最具影响力、最重要货币的人却寥寥无几。
accurately.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第1段，第3句

accurately.sentenceEn: Research shows that when we absorb information in order to teach it to someone else, we learn it more accurately and deeply, perhaps in part because we are engaging our social cognition.
accurately.translationZh: 研究表明，当我们为了教别人而吸收信息时，我们会学得更准确、更深入，这可能部分是因为我们在调动自己的社会认知能力。

accurately.sentenceEn: It can accurately pinpoint a country's current economic problems.
accurately.translationZh: 它能够准确地找出一个国家当前的经济问题。

accuse.sentenceEn: It can be tempting in this situation to react harshly to the advice giver and to accuse them of being manipulative, but this approach might produce an undesired result.
accuse.translationZh: 在这种情况下，人们往往会忍不住对提建议的人恶语相向，并指责对方在操纵局面，但这种做法可能会产生适得其反的效果。
accuse.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第4段，第2句

accuse.sentenceEn: In her long explanation filled with cursing and swearing, the bride accused her friends and family of ruining her marriage and her life.
accuse.translationZh: 在她那充满污言秽语的长篇解释中，新娘指责亲友们毁了她的婚姻和人生。
accuse.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第2段，第3句

accuse.sentenceEn: Young people in this country have been accused of not caring for their parents the way they would have in the old country.
accuse.translationZh: 这个国家的年轻人被指责不像在故国那样照顾父母。
accuse.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第2段，第1句

accuse.sentenceEn: Accusing individuals or groups of being radical often serves to silence them into submission, thereby maintaining the existing state of affairs, and, more important, preserving the power of a select minority who are mostly wealthy white males in western society.
accuse.translationZh: 指责个人或群体"极端"，往往是为了迫使他们保持沉默、顺从，从而维持现状，更重要的是，维护少数精英的权力——在西方社会，这些精英大多是富有的白人男性。
accuse.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第1段，第3句

accuse.sentenceEn: What have young Americans been accused of?
accuse.translationZh: 美国年轻人被指责什么？

accuse.sentenceEn: Accuse them of trying to control others.
accuse.translationZh: 指责他们企图控制他人。

adhere.sentenceEn: I try not to adhere to social norms and expectations.
adhere.translationZh: 我尽量不去遵循社会规范和期望。
adhere.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第2段，第2句

adhere.sentenceEn: I read recently that only 41% of Americans adhere to a budget.
adhere.translationZh: 我最近看到的数据显示，只有41%的美国人坚持执行预算计划。
adhere.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第5段，第2句

adhere.sentenceEn: Good science journalists are specialists in making complex topics accessible to a general audience, while adhering to scientific accuracy.
adhere.translationZh: 优秀的科学记者是将复杂话题普及给普通大众的专家，同时又能坚持科学的准确性。
adhere.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第4段，第3句

adhere.sentenceEn: W: I'm afraid you have to adhere to the assigned topic.
adhere.translationZh: 恐怕你必须坚持既定的题目。
adhere.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第6段，第1句

adhere.sentenceEn: In Europe, parts of Italy, Greece, Portugal, Spain, and southern France adhere to principles of the Mediterranean diet, as do Morocco and Tunisia in North Africa.
adhere.translationZh: 在欧洲，意大利、希腊、葡萄牙、西班牙的部分地区以及法国南部都遵循地中海饮食原则，北非的摩洛哥和突尼斯也是如此。
adhere.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第3段，第3句

adhere.sentenceEn: Take pride in its history and adhere to its cultural tradition.
adhere.translationZh: 以其历史为荣，坚守其文化传统。

admission.sentenceEn: Students chair both the admissions and the curriculum committees.
admission.translationZh: 招生委员会和课程委员会均由学生担任主席。

admission.sentenceEn: "I think the opportunity to give people a choice is important," says Florida state Senator Jeremy Ring, who introduced a bill last year that would allow Florida students to choose between foreign language and coding classes for the purpose of university admissions requirements, "I think if you're going to give two years of language in high school, you might as well do computer coding."
admission.translationZh: 佛罗里达州参议员杰里米·林表示：“我认为给予人们选择的机会非常重要。”他去年提出了一项法案，允许佛罗里达学生在满足大学入学要求时，在外语课程和编程课程之间做出选择。“我认为，如果要在高中学习两年语言课程，那还不如学习计算机编程。”

admission.sentenceEn: Under the Washington bill, public universities would accept two years of computer science classes in place of two years of foreign language for admission purposes.
admission.translationZh: 根据华盛顿州的法案，公立大学在录取时将接受两年计算机科学课程替代两年外语课程。

admission.sentenceEn: When you're feeling hard done by—taken for granted by your partner, say, or obliged to work for a half-witted boss—it's easy to become attached to the position that it's not your job to address the matter, and that doing so would be an admission of fault.
admission.translationZh: 当你感到受了委屈——比如被伴侣视为理所当然，或者不得不为一个愚笨的老板工作时——你很容易固执地认为，解决这个问题不是你的责任，而这样做（指解决问题）将是承认自己有错。
admission.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第2段，第2句

admission.sentenceEn: Since there were few museums anywhere in Europe before the close of the eighteenth century, Grand Tourists often saw paintings and sculptures by gaining admission to private collections, and many were eager to acquire examples of Greco-Roman and Italian art for their own collections.
admission.translationZh: 由于18世纪末以前欧洲各地博物馆寥寥无几，大游学旅行者们常常通过获准进入私人收藏来观赏绘画和雕塑，而且许多人渴望为自己的收藏获取希腊罗马和意大利艺术品。
admission.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第3段，第6句

admission.sentenceEn: Insofar as early decision offers a genuine admissions edge, that advantage goes largely to students who already have numerous advantages.
admission.translationZh: 尽管提前录取确实能给学生带来真正的录取优势，但这种优势主要流向了那些本就拥有诸多优势的学生。
admission.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第5段，第1句

adolescence.sentenceEn: Loneliness and social isolation are growing public health concerns for people of all ages in the United States, from adolescence to the elderly.
adolescence.translationZh: 在美国，从青少年到老年人，孤独和社交隔离正成为各个年龄段人群日益严重的公共健康问题。
adolescence.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第1段，第2句

adolescence.sentenceEn: W: I feel that children's tastes in books change as they reach adolescence .
adolescence.translationZh: 我觉得孩子们到了青春期，对书籍的品味会发生变化。
adolescence.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第9段，第1句

adolescence.sentenceEn: These early attitudes, reinforced by social conditioning, continue to play an active part in the friendships of both sexes during adolescence .
adolescence.translationZh: 这些早期形成的态度，在社会环境的不断强化下，在青春期男女的友谊关系中继续发挥着重要作用。
adolescence.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第4段，第1句

adolescence.sentenceEn: This is most apt to be the case in late adolescence , when dating and relationships with boys take sharp precedence over sisterhood.
adolescence.translationZh: 这种情况在青春期后期尤为常见，此时与男孩约会和恋爱的重要性明显优先于姐妹情谊。
adolescence.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第4段，第6句

adolescence.sentenceEn: What do children do when they reach late adolescence ?
adolescence.translationZh: 孩子们进入青春期后期会做什么？

adolescence.sentenceEn: It tracked their eating habits since their adolescence .
adolescence.translationZh: 该研究对她们自青春期以来的饮食习惯进行了追踪。

adulthood.sentenceEn: Marketing may help socialize children as consumers, inform them about products, and help them carve out unique identities as they reach adulthood .
adulthood.translationZh: 市场营销或许能帮助儿童适应消费者角色，向他们介绍产品信息，并在他们成年过程中帮助他们塑造独特的身份认同。
adulthood.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第5段，第5句

adulthood.sentenceEn: I've also been profoundly disappointed in each of these institutions, and in many of my colleagues, especially when it comes to helping students and preparing them for the many responsibilities of adulthood .
adulthood.translationZh: 我也对这些院校以及我的许多同事深感失望，尤其是在帮助学生以及培养他们承担成年后的诸多责任方面。

adulthood.sentenceEn: But I'm now convinced there's an educational need that's now going almost completely unmet: namely, the need to help young people transition into adulthood .
adulthood.translationZh: 但我现在确信，有一种教育需求几乎完全没有得到满足：即帮助年轻人向成年过渡的需求。

adulthood.sentenceEn: In addition, researchers have reported other positive effects of bilingualism for cognitive abilities in later life, even when the person acquired the language in adulthood .
adulthood.translationZh: 此外，研究人员还报告了双语能力对晚年认知能力的其他积极影响，即使是在成年后才习得第二语言的人身上也是如此。

adulthood.sentenceEn: But bilingualism certainly occurs in adulthood as well.
adulthood.translationZh: 但双语能力当然也会在成年时期形成。

adulthood.sentenceEn: It focused on their ways of life during young adulthood .
adulthood.translationZh: 该研究关注的是她们青年时期的生活方式。

align.sentenceEn: Sections 4, 5, 8 and 9 still have to be aligned to the new framework.
align.translationZh: 第 4、5、8 和 9 章节仍需与新框架保持一致。
align.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第9段，第2句

align.sentenceEn: They must feel the need to stay working at a company whose values align with their own.
align.translationZh: 他们必须感到有必要留在一家价值观与自己相契合的公司工作。
align.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第12段，第3句

align.sentenceEn: Big clouds of ash from volcanic eruptions or fires can do the trick, but it doesn't happen often, and the stars would certainly have to align for two such rare instances to occur at once.
align.translationZh: 火山爆发或火灾产生的大量火山灰云可以达到这种效果，但这种情况并不常见，而且要让两个如此罕见的事件同时发生，确实需要诸多条件的完美配合。

align.sentenceEn: They focus on things they can control and align their daily habits to the goals they have set for themselves.
align.translationZh: 他们专注于自己能掌控的事情，并使日常习惯与为自己设定的目标保持一致。
align.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第3段，第8句

align.sentenceEn: Marconi needed to achieve the goal that was set in his mind as an adolescent; by the time he reached adulthood, he understood, intuitively, that in order to have an impact he had to both develop an independent economic base and align himself with political power.
align.translationZh: 马可尼自青少年时期起心中就确立了一个必须实现的目标；到成年时，他凭直觉明白，要想产生影响力，就必须既建立独立的经济基础，又与政治权力结盟。

align.sentenceEn: Conversely, she says, opting for clothes that fit well and align with your sense of style can improve your confidence.
align.translationZh: 相反，她说，选择合身且符合个人风格的衣物能够增强自信。
align.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第1段，第3句

amazing.sentenceEn: These examples are just a few of the many amazing things that public libraries around the United States (and the world) are doing to build and maintain strong community connections.
amazing.translationZh: 这些例子只是美国（乃至全世界）的公共图书馆为建立和维护强大的社区联系所做的众多了不起的事情中的一小部分。

amazing.sentenceEn: "Catch This Weekend's AMAZING SUPERMOON," one headline will announce.
amazing.translationZh: “本周末不容错过的精彩超级月亮，”一条新闻标题将这样宣布。

amazing.sentenceEn: In the past, people might have been skeptical of a new product claimed to be able to achieve amazing cleaning results, but they now have faith in technology's ability to do what was once thought impossible.
amazing.translationZh: 过去，人们可能会对声称能实现惊人清洁效果的新产品持怀疑态度，但现在他们相信技术能够做到曾经被认为不可能的事情。
amazing.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第3段，第4句

amazing.sentenceEn: Considering all that goes into driving these larger vehicles, it's amazing that we could soon have that kind of technology.
amazing.translationZh: 想想驾驶这些大型车辆需要付出的所有努力，我们很快就能拥有这种技术真是太神奇了。
amazing.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第5段，第3句

amazing.sentenceEn: "It's amazing to think that just 60 years ago, we knew next to nothing of the behavior of our sister species in the wild," Whiten says.
amazing.translationZh: 怀滕说：“想想就在60年前，我们对野生近亲物种的行为还几乎一无所知，这真是令人惊叹。”
amazing.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第5段，第1句

amazing.sentenceEn: And in doing so, it offers an amazing opportunity for those who care about the elderly to find new ways to love them.
amazing.translationZh: 而在这样做的过程中，它为那些关心老年人的人提供了一个绝佳的机会，去寻找关爱他们的新方式。
amazing.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第3段，第4句

automate.sentenceEn: Automated at-table ordering and payment is seen as the next landmark.
automate.translationZh: 自动化的餐桌点餐和支付被视为行业发展的下一个里程碑。

automate.sentenceEn: It is designed for domestic use, but a commercial version is planned that opens up the possibility of restaurant kitchens automating even highly technically challenging tasks.
automate.translationZh: 该产品专为家庭使用而设计，但其计划推出的商业版本将使餐厅厨房实现极具技术挑战的任务自动化成为可能。

automate.sentenceEn: Automating traffic signals stalled after the London incident.
automate.translationZh: 在伦敦事件发生后，交通信号自动化的进程陷入了停滞。

automate.sentenceEn: From automated warehouses to cashierless grocery stores to neighborhood libraries that offer self-checkout lanes instead of employing real people—automation is increasingly replacing jobs and leaving too few good new jobs behind.
automate.translationZh: 从自动化仓库到无人收银杂货店，再到提供自助结账通道而非雇佣真人的社区图书馆——自动化正日益取代众多工作岗位，却未能创造足够多的优质新岗位。
automate.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第2段，第2句

automate.sentenceEn: It is now possible to fully automate a burger restaurant with little human supervision.
automate.translationZh: 现在已经可以在几乎不需要人工监管的情况下，实现汉堡餐厅的全自动化运营。

automate.sentenceEn: About half of current jobs might be automated .
automate.translationZh: 现有工作中约有一半可能会被自动化取代。

automated.sentenceEn: Fully automated burger restaurants managed with minimal human oversight — where customers order at screens, pay electronically, and eat food cooked and delivered by robots — are now a possibility.
automated.translationZh: 现在，通过极少的人工监管即可运行的全自动化汉堡餐厅已成为可能——在这里，顾客通过屏幕点餐并进行电子支付，而食物的烹饪与配送均由机器人完成。

automated.sentenceEn: Some airports have sophisticated automated systems, including scanners that read baggage labels, destination-coded vehicles that load and unload the bags without stopping, and sorting machines that route baggage to the appropriate gate.
automated.translationZh: 部分机场配备了先进的自动化系统，包括读取行李标签的扫描仪、无需停顿即可装卸行李的目的地代码自动传送车，以及将行李分拣至对应登机口的自动分拣机。
automated.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第2段，第5句

automated.sentenceEn: So, to gain access to an automated service that will benefit financially from my input, I first have to do some unpaid labor to help improve the performance of autonomous vehicles.
automated.translationZh: 所以，为了获得一项能从我的输入中获利的自动化服务，我首先得干些义务劳动，去帮他们改进自动驾驶汽车的性能。
automated.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第3段，第2句

automated.sentenceEn: But note also the delicious additional irony that the Captcha is described as an " automated Turing test".
automated.translationZh: 但请注意，还有一个极具讽刺意味的细节：验证码被描述为一种“自动图灵测试”。
automated.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第4段，第2句

automated.sentenceEn: What may happen to your baggage even when there are sophisticated automated systems?
automated.translationZh: 即使有先进的自动化系统，您的行李仍可能遇到什么情况？

automated.sentenceEn: It is well located and completely automated .
automated.translationZh: 它地理位置优越，且完全自动化。

automatically.sentenceEn: Also, humans are such absorbent social beings that when we surround ourselves with others, we automatically take in their opinions and aesthetics.
automatically.translationZh: 此外，人类是极具感染力的社会性生物，当我们身处人群中时，会不由自主地接纳他人的观点和审美。

automatically.sentenceEn: Rather than having a chef shouting out diners' orders, the QSR system automatically distributes those orders across screens.
automatically.translationZh: QSR（快餐餐厅）系统不再需要厨师大声喊出顾客的订单，而是会自动将这些订单分配到各个显示屏上。

automatically.sentenceEn: Finally, in San Francisco the first red and green electric light system that could be operated automatically (or manually) was introduced in 1917.
automatically.translationZh: 最终，旧金山于1917年引入了首套可自动（或手动）操作的红绿电力信号灯系统。

automatically.sentenceEn: Researchers asked participants to wear audio recorders that automatically activated every 9.5 minutes between 7 a.m. and 2 a.m. to record 30 seconds of audio.
automatically.translationZh: 研究人员要求参与者佩戴录音设备，该设备在早上7点至凌晨2点期间每9.5分钟自动激活一次，录制30秒的音频。
automatically.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第1段，第4句

automatically.sentenceEn: It is equally imperative to emphasize that being an expert on a topic does not automatically make a scholar qualified to communicate it to a nonscientific audience.
automatically.translationZh: 同样必须强调的是，成为某一领域的专家并不自动意味着这位学者就有资格向非科学受众传播该领域知识。
automatically.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第5段，第1句

automatically.sentenceEn: People in need of money work hard automatically .
automatically.translationZh: 需要钱的人会自然而然地努力工作。

adjustment.sentenceEn: Once we've successfully made that change, we then have to make other adjustments to our lives to ensure that we continue to maintain it, which is often a whole other challenge in itself.
adjustment.translationZh: 一旦我们成功做出改变，就必须对生活做出其他调整，以确保能够继续保持这种改变，而这本身往往是另一项全新的挑战。

adjustment.sentenceEn: Discussing a disability with the potential employer may help them make reasonable workplace adjustments in their favor.
adjustment.translationZh: 与潜在雇主讨论自身残疾情况，可能会帮助雇主做出有利于求职者的合理工作场所调整。
adjustment.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第2段，第5句

adjustment.sentenceEn: M: If you're committed to your current topic, maybe you could make some adjustments rather than abandon it completely.
adjustment.translationZh: 男：如果你坚持要做现在这个题目，或许可以做些调整，而不是完全放弃。
adjustment.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第9段，第1句

adjustment.sentenceEn: In February they made adjustments to the format, dropping some catwalk items immediately and promising that others would launch in the coming months.
adjustment.translationZh: 今年2月，博柏利对该模式做出了调整，立即取消了部分走秀单品，并承诺其他产品将在未来几个月内推出。

adjustment.sentenceEn: The dynamic adjustment to low oil prices may, however, be different this time around.
adjustment.translationZh: 然而，此次市场对低油价的动态调整可能会有所不同。

adjustment.sentenceEn: "While these numbers are still being validated by the state, we feel any adjustments they might suggest will be immaterial," Morgan wrote to the presidents.
adjustment.translationZh: 摩根在致各位校长的信中写道：“虽然这些数字仍在由州政府审核，但我们认为他们可能提出的任何调整都不会产生实质性影响。”
adjustment.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第3段，第1句

advertise.sentenceEn: They get paid millions of dollars for their efforts, and their names and faces appear on everything from running shoes to advertising boards.
advertise.translationZh: 他们凭借自己的努力获得数百万美元的收入，他们的名字和面孔出现在从跑鞋到广告牌的各种物品上。
advertise.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第1段，第3句

advertise.sentenceEn: If people don't think their disability will impact their ability to perform in the advertised position, then it's entirely their entitlement to choose when, and whether to share this information.
advertise.translationZh: 如果人们认为自己的残疾不会影响其在招聘职位上的工作能力，那么他们完全有权选择何时以及是否分享此信息。
advertise.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第4段，第4句

advertise.sentenceEn: And considering that people don't see these products in shops, or advertised on TV or in the press, it has been a pretty steep rise.
advertise.translationZh: 考虑到人们既不会在商店里看到这些产品，也不会在电视或报刊上看到相关广告，其销量的增长确实相当迅猛。
advertise.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第4段，第3句

advertise.sentenceEn: And practically everything that's advertised for children is unhealthy processed foods.
advertise.translationZh: 而且实际上，所有针对儿童的广告宣传的几乎都是不健康的加工食品。
advertise.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第6段，第2句

advertise.sentenceEn: What will advertising agencies often do before a national campaign?
advertise.translationZh: 广告公司在全国性活动前通常会做什么？

advertise.sentenceEn: Most of them are as effective as advertised .
advertise.translationZh: 它们中的大多数都如广告宣传的那样有效。

ageing.sentenceEn: Abundant research shows the harms of social isolation, considered a serious public health problem in countries that have rapidly ageing populations (though talk of a 'loneliness epidemic' may be exaggerated).
ageing.translationZh: 大量研究表明，社会隔离会带来诸多危害。在人口快速老龄化的国家，这已被视为一个严重的公共卫生问题（尽管有关“孤独流行病”的说法可能言过其实）。

ageing.sentenceEn: But while there is money available to be spent on it, the search to understand the secrets of ageing will be ongoing.
ageing.translationZh: 但只要有资金投入，探索衰老奥秘的研究就会继续下去。
ageing.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第7段，第2句

ageing.sentenceEn: But we cannot stop the ageing process.
ageing.translationZh: 但我们无法阻止衰老过程。
ageing.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第4段，第7句

ageing.sentenceEn: In the same way, the idea that the resolution of age-associated disease like heart disease and stroke will inform us about ageing is not based on sound science or logic.
ageing.translationZh: 同理，认为解决心脏病和中风等与年龄相关的疾病就能帮助我们了解衰老过程的观点，是缺乏可靠科学依据和逻辑基础的。
ageing.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第6段，第4句

ageing.sentenceEn: Despite the huge investment into research, ageing remains somewhat obscure, although there are certain things researchers do understand.
ageing.translationZh: 尽管在研究上投入巨大，但衰老过程仍然有些神秘莫测，不过研究人员确实已经了解了一些相关情况。
ageing.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第2段，第1句

ageing.sentenceEn: The resolution of age-related diseases will solve the mystery of ageing .
ageing.translationZh: 解决与年龄相关的疾病就能揭开衰老的奥秘。

alumnus.sentenceEn: We have built endowments from donations by alumni (校友) and parents who understand and appreciate our mission to provide access and opportunity, and a significant portion of the returns from these endowments is used to fund financial aid.
alumnus.translationZh: 我们通过校友和家长的捐赠建立了捐赠基金，他们理解并认同我们提供教育机会的使命。这些捐赠基金产生的收益中有很大一部分用于资助助学金。
alumnus.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第6段，第2句

alumnus.sentenceEn: If all of a university's alumni (往届毕业生) were to become students again, the student body would be much bigger than it is now, and it could become unsustainable for the campus in terms of both size and resources.
alumnus.translationZh: 如果一所大学的所有往届毕业生都再次成为学生，学生规模将比现在大得多，校园在规模和资源方面都可能难以承受。

alumnus.sentenceEn: Ludacris and the former CEO of Bank of America Ken Lewis are alumni of my college, as well as VICE's first female editor-in-chief, Ellis Jones.
alumnus.translationZh: 卢达·克里斯、美国银行前首席执行官肯·刘易斯以及《VICE》杂志首任女性主编埃利斯·琼斯都是我校校友。

alumnus.sentenceEn: In fact, lower-tier school alumni networks are arguably stronger, because fellow alumni recognize that you didn't necessarily have an easy path to follow.
alumnus.translationZh: 事实上，非顶尖大学的校友网络反而可能更为强大，因为校友们会意识到你的求学之路未必一帆风顺。

alumnus.sentenceEn: Modest institutions can also have successful graduates and strong alumni networks.
alumnus.translationZh: 普通院校也能培养出成功的毕业生，并拥有强大的校友网络。

alumnus.sentenceEn: Consult the current students and alumni .

analyst.sentenceEn: Then analysts who didn't know which condition each baby was in, watched video tapes of the experiment and counted how many times babies tried to activate the toy by pressing the button.
analyst.translationZh: 然后，不清楚每个婴儿处于哪种实验条件的分析师们观看了实验录像，并统计了婴儿们通过按按钮试图启动玩具的次数。
analyst.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第3段，第6句

analyst.sentenceEn: The problem was that analysts from the FAO used a comprehensive life-cycle assessment to study the climate impact of livestock, but a different method when they analyzed transportation.
analyst.translationZh: 问题在于，联合国粮农组织(FAO)的分析师在研究畜牧业对气候的影响时使用了全面的生命周期评估方法，而在分析交通运输时却采用了另一种不同的方法。

analyst.sentenceEn: Some analysts say it is in fact inevitable.
analyst.translationZh: 一些分析人士认为，这实际上是不可避免的。

analyst.sentenceEn: Analysts say the biggest problem is high unemployment, which weakens demand and makes banks reluctant to lend.
analyst.translationZh: 分析师表示，最大的问题是高失业率，这削弱了市场需求，也使银行不愿放贷。
analyst.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第6段，第1句

analyst.sentenceEn: Part of the answer is that this is what always happens during periods of high unemployment—in part because experts and analysts believe that declaring the problem deeply rooted, with no easy answers, makes them sound serious.
analyst.translationZh: 部分原因在于，高失业率时期总会出现这种情况——部分是因为专家和分析师认为，宣称问题根深蒂固且没有简单解决方案，会让他们听起来很严肃。
analyst.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第4段，第1句

analyst.sentenceEn: Contrary to analysts' doubts, the author believes drug prices may be lowered through negotiation.
analyst.translationZh: 与分析师的疑虑相反，作者认为可以通过谈判降低药品价格。

anxious.sentenceEn: But the highly anxious people in this study represent individuals who are managing their anxiety and for whom anxiety is not a serious problem.
anxious.translationZh: 但本研究中的高度焦虑人群代表的是那些正在管理自身焦虑且焦虑并未构成严重问题的个体。
anxious.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第5段，第2句

anxious.sentenceEn: In other words, when highly anxious individuals took in otherwise emotionally neutral information that was presented to them, it became colored by their negative mindset, making them remember the information better.
anxious.translationZh: 换句话说，当高度焦虑的人接收那些原本情绪中立的信息时，这些信息会被他们的负面心态所“染色”，从而使他们能更好地记住这些信息。
anxious.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第4段，第2句

anxious.sentenceEn: It is impossible to be fearful, anxious , irritated, and healthy at the same time.
anxious.translationZh: 人不可能同时处于恐惧、焦虑、愤怒的情绪中，又保持健康的状态。
anxious.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第3段，第2句

anxious.sentenceEn: The middle child is influenced by many variables; however, middles are less likely to take initiative and more anxious and self-critical than others.
anxious.translationZh: 排行中间的孩子会受到多种因素的影响；不过，他们不太可能主动采取行动，并且比其他孩子更容易焦虑和自我批评。
anxious.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第6段，第1句

anxious.sentenceEn: And although anxious parents may not welcome the notion, educators could turn adolescent recklessness to academic ends.
anxious.translationZh: 尽管焦虑的父母们可能并不认同这一观点，但教育者们却可以将青少年的鲁莽特质转化为学业上的优势。

anxious.sentenceEn: They are both anxious to go home.

appealing.sentenceEn: The researchers also discovered that presenting a vegetarian dish as the chef's recommendation, or including a more appealing description of a non-meat meal, leads to a greater proportion of infrequent vegetarian eaters choosing a vegetarian option.
appealing.translationZh: 研究人员还发现，将素食菜肴标注为厨师推荐，或为非肉类餐食提供更具吸引力的描述，都会促使不常吃素的人群中有更高比例的人选择素食。
appealing.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第2段，第7句

appealing.sentenceEn: It doesn't sound that appealing to me.
appealing.translationZh: 我觉得这听起来没什么吸引力。
appealing.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第4段，第2句

appealing.sentenceEn: The marketing professors believe that the real solution to obesity is making food look appealing and focusing on the pleasure of both looking at and eating that food.
appealing.translationZh: 市场营销学教授们认为，解决肥胖问题的真正方法是让食物看起来更诱人，并强调观赏食物和享用食物所带来的双重愉悦感。
appealing.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第7段，第1句

appealing.sentenceEn: Research shows that just seeing an appealing photograph of a hamburger in an advertisement, for example, can cause individuals to imagine the taste or smell of that hamburger.
appealing.translationZh: 例如，研究表明，仅仅看到广告中诱人的汉堡图片，就能让人们想象出汉堡的味道或气味。
appealing.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第4段，第1句

appealing.sentenceEn: Statistics show while computer-related jobs have been on the rise, foreign languages have become less appealing to American students since mid-1990s.
appealing.translationZh: 统计数据显示，虽然计算机相关工作岗位一直在增加，但自20世纪90年代中期以来，外语对美国学生的吸引力已有所下降。

appealing.sentenceEn: They find vegetarian dishes become more appealing .
appealing.translationZh: 他们发现素食变得越来越有吸引力。

appliance.sentenceEn: Because of this, food product placement within the appliance is far more important than you probably realize.
appliance.translationZh: 正因为如此，家电内部的食品摆放位置远比你想象的重要得多。
appliance.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第1段，第4句

appliance.sentenceEn: W: Yes, all the appliances are brand-new.
appliance.translationZh: 是的，所有家电都是全新的。
appliance.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第4段，第1句

appliance.sentenceEn: We want appliances that are designed for use most of the time, not for occasional use.
appliance.translationZh: 我们需要的家电应该是为日常高频使用而设计的，而非偶尔使用。
appliance.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第5段，第2句

appliance.sentenceEn: The number of devices you can talk to is multiplying—first it was your phone, then your car, and now you can tell your kitchen appliance what to do.
appliance.translationZh: 你可以与之对话的设备数量正在不断增加——起初是手机，然后是汽车，现在你甚至可以吩咐厨房电器该做什么。
appliance.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第1段，第1句

appliance.sentenceEn: Having to install a different app for each smart appliance in your home is annoying; it would be nicer if you could manage everything together.
appliance.translationZh: 家里的每台智能家电都需要安装不同的应用程序，这很烦人；如果能将所有设备集中管理就好多了。

appliance.sentenceEn: It may make household appliances serve an additional air cleaner function.
appliance.translationZh: 它能使家用电器兼备空气净化器的功能。

approve.sentenceEn: In the workplace, managers routinely make decisions about who to hire or fire and which loan to approve , to name a few.
approve.translationZh: 在工作场所，管理者通常要对聘用谁、解雇谁以及批准哪笔贷款等问题做出决策，这些只是其中的几个例子。
approve.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第4段，第1句

approve.sentenceEn: The American Medical Association this month approved new ethical guidelines for telemedicine, calling for participating doctors to recognize the limitations of such services and ensure that they have sufficient information to make clinical recommendations.
approve.translationZh: 美国医学协会本月批准了新的远程医疗伦理指南，要求参与的医生认识到此类服务的局限性，并确保他们掌握足够的信息来提出临床建议。

approve.sentenceEn: Results of USA WEEKEND's Teens & Parents survey reveal a generation of young people who get along well with their parents and approve of the way they're being raised.
approve.translationZh: 《美国周末》杂志的“青少年与父母”调查结果显示，这一代年轻人与父母相处融洽，并认同父母的教养方式。

approve.sentenceEn: The changes would have to be approved or rejected as a whole by Congress, making it hard for narrow-interest lobbies to bend lawmakers to their will.
approve.translationZh: 这些改革措施将由国会进行整体表决，要么全部批准，要么全部否决，这将使狭隘利益游说团体难以迫使立法者屈从于他们的意愿。

approve.sentenceEn: Changes in policy would be approved or rejected as a whole so that lobbyists would find it hard to influence lawmakers.
approve.translationZh: 政策变更必须整体批准或否决，这将使游说团体难以左右立法者。

approve.sentenceEn: They are less likely to approve of policies to fight inequality.
approve.translationZh: 他们不太可能支持旨在消除不平等的政策。

attraction.sentenceEn: In time, the tree came to be something of a tourist attraction , known as The Tree That Owns Itself.
attraction.translationZh: 随着时间推移，这棵树逐渐成了一处旅游景点，被称为“拥有自我的树”。

attraction.sentenceEn: Most visitors come to Cape Canaveral, on the northeast coast of Florida, for the tourist attractions .
attraction.translationZh: 大多数游客来到佛罗里达州东北海岸的卡纳维拉尔角，是为了这里的旅游景点。

attraction.sentenceEn: Yet some of Cape Canaveral's most legendary attractions lie unseen, wedged under the sea's surface in mud and sand, for this part of the world has a reputation as a deadly ship trap.
attraction.translationZh: 然而，卡纳维拉尔角一些最具传奇色彩的景点却隐匿于海面之下，深陷泥砂之中——因为这片海域素有"船只死亡陷阱"之称。

attraction.sentenceEn: Among the room's many stress-reducing gadgets, the main attraction is a boss doll with detachable arms and legs.
attraction.translationZh: 在这个房间众多的减压小物件中，最吸引人的是一个手臂和腿部可拆卸的老板玩偶。
attraction.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第4段，第3句

attraction.sentenceEn: You can think of it as physical attraction .
attraction.translationZh: 你可以将其视为身体吸引力。
attraction.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第2段，第7句

attraction.sentenceEn: They are focused more on attraction than love.
attraction.translationZh: 这些实验实际上更多聚焦于吸引力而非爱情。

automatic.sentenceEn: "Payments being automatic " could be useful, he adds.
automatic.translationZh: 他补充道，“支付自动化”可能会很有用。

automatic.sentenceEn: They could be manual or automatic .
automatic.translationZh: 它们可以是手动的，也可以是自动的。

automatic.sentenceEn: Even for the most productive and disciplined among us, undoing something that has become an automatic part of who we are takes more than an overnight effort.
automatic.translationZh: 即便是我们当中最高效自律的人，要改变那些已成为自身本能的习惯，也绝非一朝一夕之功。

automatic.sentenceEn: The idea is simple—you repeat something so many times that it becomes automatic .
automatic.translationZh: 这个原理很简单——你反复重复某件事，直到它变成一种自然而然的习惯。

automatic.sentenceEn: The red and green automatic traffic light system originated in an American city.
automatic.translationZh: 红绿自动交通信号灯系统起源于一座美国城市。

automatic.sentenceEn: Gain automatic control of their businesses.
automatic.translationZh: 实现对其业务的自动化控制

acupuncture.sentenceEn: Few, though, can adequately explain how acupuncture works.
acupuncture.translationZh: 然而，几乎没有人能充分解释针灸的工作原理。
acupuncture.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第4段，第6句

acupuncture.sentenceEn: Acupuncture points are stimulated to balance the circulation of qi.
acupuncture.translationZh: 刺激穴位是为了平衡气血运行。
acupuncture.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第4段，第10句

acupuncture.sentenceEn: "The truth is, though acupuncture is at least 2,200 years old, nobody really knows what's happening," says Paul Zmiewski, a Ph.D. in Chinese studies who practices acupuncture in Philadelphia.
acupuncture.translationZh: 费城的针灸师、汉学博士保罗·兹米耶夫斯基说：“事实上，尽管针灸已有至少2200年的历史，但没人真正知道它的原理。”
acupuncture.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第4段，第11句

acupuncture.sentenceEn: Nowadays, a lot of medical doctors have learned acupuncture techniques; so have a number of dentists.
acupuncture.translationZh: 如今，许多医生都学习了针灸技术；不少牙医也一样。
acupuncture.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第4段，第3句

acupuncture.sentenceEn: What accounts for the growing popularity of acupuncture in the United States, according to the speaker?
acupuncture.translationZh: 根据讲述者所说，针灸在美国越来越受欢迎的原因是什么？

acupuncture.sentenceEn: He had heard of the wonders acupuncture could work.
acupuncture.translationZh: 他早听说过针灸的神奇疗效。

adversely.sentenceEn: Yet, adversely , those who listened to the critical audio clips were noted as having a higher heart rate and sweat response afterwards, both of which signify feelings of threat and distress.
adversely.translationZh: 然而，相反的是，那些听过批评性音频片段的参与者随后被发现心率更高，出汗反应更强烈，这两种反应都表明存在威胁感和痛苦情绪。
adversely.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第3段，第3句

adversely.sentenceEn: It adversely impacts one's eating experience.
adversely.translationZh: 它会对进食体验产生负面影响。

allocate.sentenceEn: In a review published in the journal *Trends in Cognitive Sciences* on February 11th, researchers propose an explanation for why this might be happening: the brains of older adults allocate more space to accumulated knowledge and have more material to navigate when attempting to access memories.
allocate.translationZh: 在2月11日发表于《认知科学趋势》期刊的一篇综述中，研究人员对这种现象提出了一种解释：老年人的大脑为积累的知识分配了更多空间，在试图提取记忆时需要处理更多信息。
allocate.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第2段，第1句

allocate.sentenceEn: We're allocating too many resources to disciplines that don't match the needs of employers.
allocate.translationZh: 我们正在将过多资源分配给那些不符合雇主需求的学科。
allocate.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第4段，第2句

allocate.sentenceEn: Although it can generate foreign exchange, income and employment, there's no guarantee that multinational hotel chains will allocate these benefits equitably among local communities.
allocate.translationZh: 尽管旅游业能够创造外汇收入、提供就业机会，但无法保证跨国酒店连锁企业会在当地社区间公平分配这些利益。
allocate.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第5段，第2句

allocate.sentenceEn: Plus, the money generated would be allocated to environmental protection, which benefits everyone.
allocate.translationZh: 此外，由此产生的资金将用于环境保护，这对每个人都有益。
allocate.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第10段，第2句

allocate.sentenceEn: Allocate a tiny amount of 1 or 2 percent for savings, and gradually increase that amount.
allocate.translationZh: 先将1%或2%的小额收入用于储蓄，然后逐步提高这一比例。
allocate.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第2段，第3句

allocate.sentenceEn: How should the education budget be allocated according to the man?
allocate.translationZh: 根据这位男士的观点，教育预算应如何分配？

alongside.sentenceEn: Personalisation is seen as key to the appeal of this technology, alongside its ability to reliably push so-called "upsells" (meal deals, extras, larger drinks) to customers.
alongside.translationZh: 个性化被视为这项技术的吸引力核心，同时它还能可靠地向客户推送所谓的“追加销售”（如套餐、加餐、大杯饮料）。

alongside.sentenceEn: For infants and toddlers(学步儿童), ages 15 months to 2 years old, there's limited evidence from a couple of very small studies that they can learn new words from educational media, if and only if parents are watching alongside them, repeating what the video says and/or drawing attention to what is on the screen.
alongside.translationZh: 对于15个月至2岁大的婴幼儿（学步儿童），少数小型研究提供的有限证据表明，当且仅当父母在一旁陪同观看，重复视频内容和/或引导孩子注意屏幕上的内容时，他们才能从教育类媒体中学习新词汇。
alongside.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第7段，第1句

alongside.sentenceEn: Other actors have been revived, with the permission of their estates, for advertising purposes: for example, a 2011 advertisement for Dior featured contemporary actress Charlize Theron alongside iconic 20th-century stars Marilyn Monroe, Grace Kelly and Marlene Dietrich.
alongside.translationZh: 其他演员也在其遗产继承人的许可下被“复活”用于广告目的：例如，2011年迪奥的一则广告中，当代女演员查理兹·塞隆与20世纪的传奇巨星玛丽莲·梦露、格蕾丝·凯利和玛琳·黛德丽共同出镜。

alongside.sentenceEn: Alongside this enlightenment develops an ever growing understanding of other persons, including their attitudes and views of the world.
alongside.translationZh: 随着这种启蒙，儿童对他人的理解也日益加深，包括理解他人的态度和世界观。

alongside.sentenceEn: About 10 percent of students in the Portland, Oregon public schools are assigned by lottery to dual-language classrooms that offer instruction in Spanish, Japanese or Mandarin, alongside English.
alongside.translationZh: 在俄勒冈州波特兰市的公立学校中，约10%的学生通过抽签被分配到双语课堂，接受西班牙语、日语或汉语普通话与英语的双语教学。

alongside.sentenceEn: Privacy advocates now have Apple fighting alongside them against government access to personal data.
alongside.translationZh: 如今，隐私倡导者们有了苹果公司并肩作战，共同抵制政府获取个人数据

arrange.sentenceEn: It's a French phrase that means to gather and arrange the ingredients and tools needed for cooking.
arrange.translationZh: 这是一个法语短语，意思是收集并整理烹饪所需的食材和工具。
arrange.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第3段，第3句

arrange.sentenceEn: Managers at one of her former human resources jobs arranged so many meetings that attendees would fall asleep at the table or intentionally arrive late.
arrange.translationZh: 在她曾任职的一家人力资源公司，经理们安排了太多会议，以至于参会者要么在桌上睡着，要么故意迟到。

arrange.sentenceEn: The app's mathematical approach can arrange a more meticulous workout schedule.
arrange.translationZh: 这款应用的数学算法能够制定出更细致的锻炼计划。
arrange.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第1段，第14句

arrange.sentenceEn: "I have to work with these people," he tells my friend, Dr. Karen Brudney, when she mercifully intervenes on my behalf and arranges for me to be transferred to another hospital.
arrange.translationZh: 当我的朋友凯伦·布拉德尼医生出于好意出面为我斡旋，并安排我转院时，他对她说：“我还得和这些人共事呢。”
arrange.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第4段，第6句

arrange.sentenceEn: The mind-body connection is such that if, for example, we want to avoid something, very often our subconscious mind will arrange it.
arrange.translationZh: 身心之间存在着这样的联系：例如，当我们想要逃避某件事时，我们的潜意识往往会加以安排。
arrange.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第6段，第1句

arrange.sentenceEn: They cannot match humans in arranging meticulous workout schedules.
arrange.translationZh: 它们无法像人类一样制定细致的锻炼计划。

aspirational.translationZh: 人类是追求理想目标的生物。
aspirational.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第1段，第1句

aspirational.sentenceEn: If you're not pursuing intentional aspirational goals, you have nothing to strive for.
aspirational.translationZh: 如果你不追求明确的理想目标，就没有什么可以为之奋斗的。
aspirational.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第4段，第2句

aspirational.sentenceEn: One way is to become more intentionally aspirational .
aspirational.translationZh: 一种方法是更有意识地树立远大志向。
aspirational.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第2段，第1句

aspirational.sentenceEn: Your intentional aspirational goals will also include striving to be your personal best—a person of "good" character, integrity, and trustworthiness.
aspirational.translationZh: 你有意识的远大目标还应包括努力成为最好的自己——一个品格“优良”、正直可靠的人。
aspirational.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第3段，第2句

aspirational.sentenceEn: To be intentionally aspirational includes consciously aspiring to be the person you need to be to succeed in your professional and personal life.
aspirational.translationZh: 有意识地树立远大志向，包括自觉地努力成为在职业和个人生活中取得成功所需要成为的那种人。
aspirational.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第2段，第2句

aspirational.sentenceEn: What does the passage say about our intentional aspirational goals?
aspirational.translationZh: 这篇文章关于我们有意识的理想目标说了些什么？

assortment.sentenceEn: M: The assortments of accessories in this collection have had quite the impact on critics.
assortment.translationZh: 男士：这个系列的配饰组合对评论家产生了相当大的影响。
assortment.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第3段，第1句

assortment.sentenceEn: By now, it is generally accepted that regular exercise comes with an assortment of health benefits for people who maintain the habit over time.
assortment.translationZh: 目前，人们普遍公认，长期坚持规律运动能为人体健康带来诸多益处。
assortment.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第1段，第1句

assortment.sentenceEn: Basically, it allows me to have a more varied diet with a far wider assortment of nutrients, because it's not only fruit in my morning juices you see.
assortment.translationZh: 基本上，它让我的饮食更加多样化，能摄入的营养种类也丰富得多，因为你知道，我的晨间果汁里可不仅仅只有水果。
assortment.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第13段，第2句

assortment.sentenceEn: Public health experts are worried because loneliness seems to be on the rise, and studies have long found correlations between loneliness and an assortment of medical conditions that threaten health and longevity.
assortment.translationZh: 公共卫生专家对此感到担忧，因为孤独感似乎在不断加剧，并且长期以来的研究发现，孤独感与多种威胁健康和寿命的疾病之间存在关联。
assortment.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第1段，第3句

assortment.sentenceEn: Some researchers assert dogs will one day help doctors diagnose diseases, as some dogs have already demonstrated the ability to detect an assortment of ailments, including diabetes and certain types of cancer.
assortment.translationZh: 一些研究人员断言，未来有一天狗将帮助医生诊断疾病，因为有些狗已经展示出探测多种疾病的能力，包括糖尿病和某些类型的癌症。
assortment.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第4段，第1句

assortment.sentenceEn: It contains an assortment of nutrients.

audio.sentenceEn: While the parent read the words in the printed books aloud, the electronic books had audio of voice actors reading the text.
audio.translationZh: 家长大声朗读纸质书中的文字，而电子书则配备了由配音演员录制的文本音频。
audio.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第3段，第4句

audio.sentenceEn: Some of this discrepancy could be because the observers used only audio clips, and thus could not read cues like body language, but there are probably other explanations, as people should be able to hear when a participant is being kind versus being rude.
audio.translationZh: 这种差异的部分原因可能是观察者仅使用了音频片段，因此无法读取肢体语言等线索，但可能还有其他解释，因为人们应该能够听出参与者表现得友善还是粗鲁。
audio.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第2段，第5句

audio.sentenceEn: Six laboratory assistants rated each participant's audio clips to see how their observations compared with people's assessment of themselves.
audio.translationZh: 六位实验室助理对每位参与者的音频片段进行了评分，以比较他们的观察结果与参与者的自我评估。
audio.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第2段，第1句

audio.sentenceEn: The study used data from 248 participants, all of whom answered questions about their behavior for two consecutive weeks and wore the audio device for one of those weeks.
audio.translationZh: 该研究使用了248名参与者的数据，所有参与者连续两周回答关于自身行为的问题，并在其中一周佩戴了录音设备。
audio.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第1段，第6句

audio.sentenceEn: Researchers asked participants to wear audio recorders that automatically activated every 9.5 minutes between 7 a.m. and 2 a.m. to record 30 seconds of audio .
audio.translationZh: 研究人员要求参与者佩戴录音设备，该设备在早上7点至凌晨2点期间每9.5分钟自动激活一次，录制30秒的音频。
audio.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第1段，第4句

audio.sentenceEn: For the study, five groups of participants were presented with a different set of audio instructions, some of which encouraged the participants to think amiably about themselves and others which persuaded them to think in a self-critical manner.
audio.translationZh: 在这项研究中，五组参与者分别听取了不同的音频指令，其中一些音频鼓励参与者友善地看待自己，另一些则引导他们以自我批评的方式思考。
audio.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第2段，第1句

absurd.sentenceEn: Rather, I always try to incorporate something slightly absurd into my aesthetic.
absurd.translationZh: 相反，我总是尝试在我的美学风格中融入些许荒诞元素。
absurd.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第2段，第3句

absurd.sentenceEn: M: I would say the food is just OK, but the prices are absurd .
absurd.translationZh: 男：我觉得这里的食物味道平平，但价格实在是离谱。
absurd.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第4段，第1句

absurd.sentenceEn: They've become so embedded in our consciousness that people think it's absurd to think otherwise.
absurd.translationZh: 它们已深深植根于我们的意识中，以至于人们认为任何不同的想法都是荒谬的。
absurd.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第1段，第2句

absurd.sentenceEn: Some have argued that the public is not educated enough to understand scientific information, especially for any complex phenomena, but this is absurd .
absurd.translationZh: 有些人认为公众受教育程度不足以理解科学信息，尤其是对于任何复杂现象，但这种说法是荒谬的。
absurd.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第4段，第1句

absurd.sentenceEn: With such an assertion, the work was predictably greeted by a lot of absurd claims about "genetics determining academic success".
absurd.translationZh: 基于这样的论断，可以预见，这项研究引发了诸多关于“基因决定学业成功”的荒谬说法。
absurd.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第2段，第2句

absurd.sentenceEn: A fight is going on to remove pressure on women to conform to an absurd beauty ideal.
absurd.translationZh: 一场旨在消除女性承受的、需符合荒谬 beauty 理想的压力的斗争正在进行中。

abundance.sentenceEn: In a 2015 study which examined how thinking about scarcity or abundance influences how creatively people use their resources, Ravi Mehta at the University of Illinois and Meng Zhu at Johns Hopkins University found that people simply have no incentive to use what's available to them in novel ways.
abundance.translationZh: 2015年的一项研究探讨了对稀缺或充裕的思考如何影响人们创造性地利用资源的方式。伊利诺伊大学的拉维·梅塔和约翰·霍普金斯大学的朱萌发现，人们根本没有动力以新颖的方式利用可用资源。
abundance.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第3段，第2句

abundance.sentenceEn: If a population is perfectly adapted to a particular environment and has access to an abundance of resources, then there really is no reason to move or change.
abundance.translationZh: 如果一个种群能完美适应特定环境，并且拥有丰富的资源，那么它们确实没有理由迁移或改变。
abundance.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第4段，第2句

abundance.sentenceEn: Despite the abundance of financial products, services and solutions geared towards accumulating wealth, it all begins with the same equation: getting ahead financially requires a reduction of spending, so that income is greater than expenses.
abundance.translationZh: 尽管市面上充斥着各种旨在积累财富的金融产品、服务和解决方案，但一切都始于同一个等式：实现财务增长需要减少支出，使收入大于支出。
abundance.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第2段，第1句
文章原文 · 第5段，第3句

abundance.sentenceEn: Such rapid change underlines the role of environmental factors, like the abundance of rich foods, in Americans' overeating.
abundance.translationZh: 这种快速变化凸显了环境因素在 Americans 暴饮暴食中的作用，比如高热量食物的泛滥。
abundance.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第4段，第3句

abundance.sentenceEn: Scarcity or abundance of resources has little impact on people's creativity.
abundance.translationZh: 资源的稀缺或充裕对人们的创造力影响甚微。

acceleration.sentenceEn: It is time that we showed successes and accelerations in ecological awareness, action and restoration: stories that include past successes and future visions about the rise of urban gardening and of renaturalised riverscapes, of successful protests against polluted air and water, of the rise of regional markets and slow food, and the planting of trees around the globe, of initiatives and enterprises that work towards ecological restoration.
acceleration.translationZh: 现在是时候展示我们在生态意识、行动和恢复方面取得的成功和进展了：这些故事应包含过去的成就和未来的愿景，如城市园艺的兴起、河流景观的自然化修复、成功抗议空气和水污染的行动、区域市场和慢食运动的发展、全球植树造林，以及致力于生态恢复的各类倡议和企业。

acceleration.sentenceEn: For all the fuss made about top speeds, cornering ability and acceleration , the most useful gadgets on a modern car are those which work when you're going very slowly: parking sensors, sound systems, and navigation apps which will show a way around upcoming traffic jams.
acceleration.translationZh: 尽管人们对汽车的最高速度、转弯性能和加速能力大肆吹嘘，但现代汽车上最有用的装置却是那些在车速很慢时派上用场的设备：泊车传感器、音响系统，以及能指引绕过前方交通拥堵的导航应用。
acceleration.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第2段，第1句

acceleration.sentenceEn: The acceleration of human production, consumption and travel has changed the animate and inanimate spheres.
acceleration.translationZh: 人类生产、消费和旅行的加速已经改变了生物界与非生物界。

acceleration.sentenceEn: Species extinction, deforestation, damming of rivers, occurrence of floods, the depletion of ozone, the degradation of ocean systems and many other areas are all experiencing acceleration .
acceleration.translationZh: 物种灭绝、森林砍伐、河流筑坝、洪水频发、臭氧消耗、海洋系统退化以及其他诸多领域都在加速恶化。

acceleration.sentenceEn: It is obvious that solutions must be found to curb the fast worsening environment and social acceleration .
acceleration.translationZh: 显然，我们必须找到方法来遏制环境的快速恶化和社会加速发展。

acceleration.sentenceEn: It is primarily caused by the acceleration of climate change.
acceleration.translationZh: 这主要是由气候变化加速造成的。

acceptable.sentenceEn: In developing countries there is a low life expectancy, a high infant mortality rate, high levels of unemployment and illiteracy, nutritional levels below acceptable standards and widespread disease with very little or poor quality medical assistance.
acceptable.translationZh: 发展中国家的预期寿命较低，婴儿死亡率较高，失业率和文盲率居高不下，营养水平低于可接受标准，疾病普遍存在，医疗援助极少或质量低劣。
acceptable.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第1段，第2句

acceptable.sentenceEn: This, in turn, leads to more social interaction, which encourages them to develop a friendlier and socially more acceptable personality.
acceptable.translationZh: 这反过来又会增加社交互动，从而促使人们培养出更友善且在社交上更受欢迎的性格。
acceptable.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第2段，第2句

acceptable.sentenceEn: By doing so, we will be able to build affordable housing within acceptable commuting distances for a significant bulk of the workforce.
acceptable.translationZh: 通过这样做，我们将能够为大部分劳动力在可接受的通勤距离内建造经济适用房。

acceptable.sentenceEn: Bears are very often hungry and since they will feed on almost any kind of plant or animal, garbage is quite acceptable .
acceptable.translationZh: 熊通常很饥饿，而且由于它们几乎以任何动植物为食，垃圾对它们来说也相当合口味。
acceptable.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第2段，第5句
文章原文 · 第4段，第4句

acceptable.sentenceEn: But a number of scientists question the assumption that the presence of alien species can never be acceptable in a natural ecosystem.
acceptable.translationZh: 但是，一些科学家对"外来物种在自然生态系统中绝不可接受"这一假设提出了质疑。
acceptable.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第2段，第1句

advertiser.sentenceEn: We seem to take it for granted that advertisers and marketers are allowed to condition even the youngest children.
advertiser.translationZh: 我们似乎想当然地认为，广告商和营销人员甚至被允许影响年幼的儿童。
advertiser.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第2段，第1句

advertiser.sentenceEn: It's crept up on us in the 60 years since advertisers started to target the young and found that they could recruit them to a commercial assault on their parents.
advertiser.translationZh: 自广告商开始将年轻人作为目标群体，并发现可以利用他们向父母发起商业攻势以来，这一现象在60年间悄然蔓延。
advertiser.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第3段，第2句

advertiser.sentenceEn: Advertisers use an assortment of tactics, such as bright colors, happy music and celebrity endorsements to appeal to children.
advertiser.translationZh: 广告商运用各种策略来吸引儿童，例如鲜艳的色彩、欢快的音乐和名人代言。
advertiser.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第4段，第3句

advertiser.sentenceEn: So when advertisers try to sell me ways to "turn back the clock", I have to suppress a laugh.
advertiser.translationZh: 因此，当广告商试图向我推销各种“时光倒流”的方法时，我只能忍住笑意。
advertiser.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第2段，第2句

advertiser.sentenceEn: While companies like Facebook harvest attention to generate revenue from advertisers , other technologies have no such agenda.
advertiser.translationZh: 虽然像Facebook这样的公司通过获取用户注意力来从广告商那里创收，但其他技术却没有这样的目的。

advertiser.sentenceEn: It would violate the rights endowed upon advertisers .
advertiser.translationZh: 这将侵犯赋予广告商的权利。

agenda.sentenceEn: If all that's on the agenda is a quick catch-up, or some non-urgent information sharing, it may better suit the group to send around an email instead.
agenda.translationZh: 如果议程上只有简短的近况交流，或是一些非紧急的信息分享，那么发一封邮件给大家可能更合适。

agenda.sentenceEn: All those women who had previously been excluded from the covers of magazines, television series and the public agenda , have become "legitimate".
agenda.translationZh: 所有那些此前被排除在杂志封面、电视剧集和公众议题之外的女性，如今都已变得“名正言顺”。
agenda.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第2段，第4句

agenda.sentenceEn: With rewilding now firmly on the environmental policy agenda , the hope is that in future, spiders will be enabled to migrate by themselves, adapting to climate change by moving along wildlife corridors.
agenda.translationZh: 随着生态恢复现已被正式提上环境政策议程，人们希望未来蜘蛛将能够自行迁徙，通过野生动物走廊移动来适应气候变化。
agenda.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第5段，第3句

agenda.sentenceEn: However, research agendas need to be focused on the needs of the poorest and most resource-limited countries.
agenda.translationZh: 然而，研究议程需要聚焦于最贫困和资源最匮乏国家的需求。
agenda.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第3段，第6句

agenda.sentenceEn: In March, for example, they came together at the first Global Conference on Agricultural Research to begin working out how to change research agendas to help meet the needs of farmers in poorer nations.
agenda.translationZh: 例如，今年3月，他们齐聚首届全球农业研究大会，开始探讨如何调整研究议程，以帮助满足贫困国家农民的需求。
agenda.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第4段，第2句

agenda.sentenceEn: But obviously it didn't hijack the news agenda in the manner of a major terrorist attack or declaration of war.
agenda.translationZh: 但显然，它并未像重大恐怖袭击或宣战那样占据新闻议程的主导地位。
agenda.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第1段，第3句

ambition.sentenceEn: The "American Dream" promises that in the Land of Opportunity, any individual can climb the economic ladder and prosper through hard work and ambition alone.
ambition.translationZh: "美国梦"承诺，在这片充满机遇的土地上，任何人都可以仅凭勤奋和抱负攀登经济阶梯，实现繁荣。
ambition.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第1段，第1句

ambition.sentenceEn: They also rated the extent to which they believed success in life is related to various internal factors (such as ambition ) and external factors (such as family wealth).
ambition.translationZh: 他们还对自己认为人生成功与各种内部因素（如雄心壮志）和外部因素（如家庭财富）相关的程度进行了评分。
ambition.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第6段，第2句

ambition.sentenceEn: And while successful people are driven to achieve their goals, the ultra successful have even greater ambition .
ambition.translationZh: 而且，虽然成功人士都致力于实现自己的目标，但那些超级成功的人拥有更大的抱负。
ambition.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第3段，第2句

ambition.sentenceEn: W: Yes, greater ambition as well as a burning desire to be the best of the best is also a common characteristic.
ambition.translationZh: 是的，更大的抱负以及成为精英中的精英的强烈渴望也是一个共同特征。
ambition.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第4段，第1句

ambition.sentenceEn: Smartphones offer new tools for achieving these ambitions , providing rich data about everyday behaviors in a variety of contexts.
ambition.translationZh: 智能手机为实现这些目标提供了新工具，能够收集人们在各种情境下日常行为的丰富数据。
ambition.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第7段，第3句

ambition.sentenceEn: They have greater ambitions than their parents.
ambition.translationZh: 他们比父母有更大的志向。

anytime.sentenceEn: I'm not sure bugs will become a popular snack anytime soon, but they're definitely food for thought.
anytime.translationZh: 我不确定昆虫能否很快成为受欢迎的零食，但它们绝对值得我们深思。
anytime.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第5段，第4句

anytime.sentenceEn: " Anytime you're repairing or building muscle," Pipitone says, such as if you're an extreme endurance athlete, training for a marathon, or you're a body builder.
anytime.translationZh: 皮普itone说：“任何时候当你在修复或构建肌肉时，比如你是极限耐力运动员、正在备战马拉松，或者你是健美运动员。”

anytime.sentenceEn: W: If there is anything else you need, please come see me in my office anytime .
anytime.translationZh: W：如果你还有其他任何需要，随时可以来我办公室找我。
anytime.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第10段，第1句

anytime.sentenceEn: Let's face it, it wasn't too long ago that the idea of working from anywhere and at anytime was some form of a distant Utopian(乌托邦式的) dream, and yet now we can perform almost any office-based task from any location in the world as long as we have access to the internet.
anytime.translationZh: 说实话，就在不久前，随时随地工作的想法还只是某种遥远的乌托邦式梦想，然而现在，只要能接入互联网，我们几乎可以在世界上任何地方完成所有办公室工作。
anytime.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第8段，第2句

anytime.sentenceEn: What does the author think about working from anywhere and at anytime ?
anytime.translationZh: 作者如何看待随时随地工作？

anytime.sentenceEn: It aims at allowing everyone to read books anytime they like.
anytime.translationZh: 图书馆希望能让所有人随时不受限制地阅读图书。

archive.sentenceEn: Archives preserve historic artifacts, oral histories, digital history projects, and scholarly writings relevant to the community, including minority groups.
archive.translationZh: 档案馆保存与社区相关的历史文物、口述历史、数字历史项目和学术著作，包括少数群体的相关资料。

archive.sentenceEn: With projects like the Massachussets Memories Road Show and the Veterans History Project, evidence of the importance of archives is everywhere.
archive.translationZh: 从马萨诸塞记忆巡回展和退伍军人历史项目等计划中可以看出，档案的重要性无处不在。

archive.sentenceEn: An organized archive is a place where people can research their ancestry and immigration history, do environmental research, and more.
archive.translationZh: 有组织的档案馆是人们可以研究自己的祖先和移民历史、进行环境研究等活动的地方。

archive.sentenceEn: On top of all this, there is no hard evidence such a deed ever existed, despite the fact that deed records in Athens go back many decades before Jackson's death in 1876 and that it was supposed to have existed in 1890 in the archives according to the original anonymous news reporter who claims to have seen it.
archive.translationZh: 除此之外，没有确凿证据表明这份契约曾经存在过。尽管雅典的契约记录可以追溯到1876年杰克逊去世前数十年，而且据那位声称见过这份契约的匿名记者最初的报道，这份契约本应在1890年就存放在档案馆中。

archive.sentenceEn: The team accessed the world's best archives to analyze accounts from more than 600 sources of 60 societies around the world.
archive.translationZh: 该团队查阅了全球最优质的档案，对来自世界60个社会600多个来源的记录进行了分析。
archive.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第3段，第2句

archive.sentenceEn: In an organized archive , people can do research on their family history and find out how their ancestors came to settle in the new land.
archive.translationZh: 在井然有序的档案库中，人们可以研究自己的家族史，了解祖先如何来到这片新土地定居。

arguably.sentenceEn: Guglielmo Marconi was arguably the first truly global figure in modern communication.
arguably.translationZh: 古列尔莫·马可尼可以说是现代通信领域首位真正具有全球影响力的人物。

arguably.sentenceEn: The brand told The New York Times that the plan was to reduce prices to move the stock, arguably encouraging consumers to buy and throw away with little thought.
arguably.translationZh: 该品牌向《纽约时报》表示，其计划通过降价来清理库存，这可能会促使消费者不假思索地购买和丢弃商品。

arguably.sentenceEn: So, Venus was arguably a cozier habitat for life than Earth.
arguably.translationZh: 因此，可以说当时的金星是比地球更宜居的生命栖息地。
arguably.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第7段，第3句

arguably.sentenceEn: In fact, lower-tier school alumni networks are arguably stronger, because fellow alumni recognize that you didn't necessarily have an easy path to follow.
arguably.translationZh: 事实上，非顶尖大学的校友网络反而可能更为强大，因为校友们会意识到你的求学之路未必一帆风顺。

arguably.sentenceEn: Researchers at small labs or at institutions focused on teaching arguably have the most to lose when sharing hard-won data.
arguably.translationZh: 可以说，小型实验室的研究人员或教学型机构的研究人员在分享来之不易的数据时，可能损失最大。

arguably.sentenceEn: China has arguably the fastest-growing operations in Antarctica.
arguably.translationZh: 中国在南极洲的活动可以说是发展最为迅速的。

ascertain.sentenceEn: My counterpart and I agreed we might never ascertain the actual facts of the matter; quite likely there were elements of truth in both employees' stories.
ascertain.translationZh: 我和对方一致认为，我们可能永远无法查明此事的真相；很可能这两名员工的说法中都包含一定的属实成分。
ascertain.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第1段，第8句

ascertain.sentenceEn: In the early 2000s, researcher Eddie Yoon conducted a survey to ascertain Americans' attitudes to cooking.
ascertain.translationZh: 21 世纪初，研究员艾迪·尹（Eddie Yoon）开展了一项调查，旨在查明美国人对烹饪的态度。
ascertain.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第1段，第4句

ascertain.sentenceEn: There are hundreds of personality quizzes online that assert they can ascertain whether the right or left half of your brain is dominant.
ascertain.translationZh: 网上有数百个人格测试声称能够确定你的大脑右半球还是左半球占主导地位。
ascertain.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第1段，第1句

ascertain.sentenceEn: In their new study, the scientists intended to ascertain how the brain computes possibilities as expressed by words such as "may," "might," and "if."
ascertain.translationZh: 在这项新研究中，科学家们旨在探究大脑如何处理由“可能”（may）、“也许”（might）和“如果”（if）等词语所表达的可能性概念。
ascertain.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第2段，第1句

ascertain.sentenceEn: Well, economists have been working to ascertain the roots of the decline for decades and have come up with several theories.
ascertain.translationZh: 那么，数十年来经济学家们一直在努力探究这一下降趋势的根源，并提出了几种理论。
ascertain.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第2段，第2句

ascertain.sentenceEn: They tried to ascertain the actual facts of the matter.
ascertain.translationZh: 他们试图查明事情的真相。

assignment.sentenceEn: Since last summer, that has meant 11 am until 7 pm shifts at Caliburger in Pasadena, California, as well as short assignments at Chick-N-Tots at Dodger Stadium in Los Angeles.
assignment.translationZh: 自去年夏天以来，这意味着他需要在加利福尼亚州帕萨迪纳市的 Caliburger 餐厅轮班工作，时间从上午 11 点到晚上 7 点；此外，他还曾在洛杉矶道奇体育场的 Chick-N-Tots 担任过短期工作。

assignment.sentenceEn: But others actually fall behind on work, unable to complete assignments unless they are, well, perfect.
assignment.translationZh: 但另一些完美主义者实际上会在工作中落后，除非能做到完美无缺，否则他们无法完成任务。

assignment.sentenceEn: In such studies, researchers would need to follow groups of children with and without music lessons over a long period of time—even if the assignments are not completely random.
assignment.translationZh: 在这类研究中，研究人员需要对接受和未接受音乐课程的儿童群体进行长期跟踪——即使分组并非完全随机。

assignment.sentenceEn: Be sure to attend all classes and leave enough time to finish assignments and prepare well for examinations.
assignment.translationZh: 务必参加所有课程，并留出足够时间完成作业和好好准备考试。
assignment.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第7段，第2句

assignment.sentenceEn: If employees respond quickly to their job assignments , the employer is likely to demand more from them.
assignment.translationZh: 如果员工对工作任务响应迅速，雇主很可能会对他们提出更多要求。

assignment.sentenceEn: He is too busy to finish his assignment in time.
assignment.translationZh: 他太忙了，无法及时完成作业。

astronomer.sentenceEn: Yes, all the astronomers on site here are very excited.
astronomer.translationZh: 是的，这里所有在场的天文学家都非常兴奋。
astronomer.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第2段，第2句

astronomer.sentenceEn: Astronomer David Chapman explained that this is merely a peculiarity of our calendar; once we stopped doing things based on the moon and started trying to follow the sun and the seasons, we stopped having one reliable full moon per month.
astronomer.translationZh: 天文学家大卫·查普曼解释说，这只是我们日历的一个特殊之处；一旦我们不再根据月亮行事，而是开始尝试跟随太阳和季节，我们就不再每月有一个可靠的满月了。

astronomer.sentenceEn: Particle physicists and astronomers collaborate often.
astronomer.translationZh: 粒子物理学家和天文学家经常开展合作。
astronomer.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第11段，第1句

astronomer.sentenceEn: Some communities have agreed to share online—geneticists, for example, post DNA sequences at the GenBank repository(库), and astronomers are accustomed to accessing images of galaxies and stars from, say, the Sloan Digital Sky Survey, a telescope that has observed some 500 million objects—but these remain the exception, not the rule.
astronomer.translationZh: 一些学术群体已经同意在线共享数据——例如，遗传学家会将DNA序列发布到GenBank数据库，天文学家则习惯于通过诸如斯隆数字巡天望远镜（该望远镜已观测约5亿个天体）获取星系和恒星的图像——但这些仍属例外，而非普遍现象。
astronomer.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第2段，第1句

astronomer.sentenceEn: What does the woman say about all the astronomers at the Denver Observatory?
astronomer.translationZh: 这位女士对丹佛天文台的所有天文学家有何评价？

astronomer.sentenceEn: They are joined by astronomers all across North America.
astronomer.translationZh: 来自整个北美的天文学家们也加入了他们的行列。

attain.sentenceEn: Then how does one attain this level of organization?
attain.translationZh: 那么，如何才能达到这种组织水平呢？
attain.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第5段，第1句

attain.sentenceEn: The illusion of control can also interfere with our best judgment, leading us to overestimate our ability to control events and attain a positive outcome.
attain.translationZh: 控制错觉还会干扰我们的理性判断，导致我们过高估计自己控制事件并获得积极结果的能力。

attain.sentenceEn: Do you think you can attain this?
attain.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第9段，第5句

attain.sentenceEn: But they can attain more distant orbits; NASA plans for most of its future Earth-escaping payloads (to the moon and Mars especially) to carry CubeSats.
attain.translationZh: 但它们也能到达更远的轨道；美国国家航空航天局计划在其未来大多数脱离地球轨道的有效载荷（尤其是前往月球和火星的任务）中搭载立方体卫星。

attain.sentenceEn: Piaget argued that attaining and accepting a vocation is one of the best ways to modify idealized views and to mature.
attain.translationZh: 皮亚杰认为，获得并接受一份职业是修正理想化观点并走向成熟的最佳途径之一。
attain.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第3段，第5句

attain.sentenceEn: It would have been attained with the continuation of the 1980s trend.
attain.translationZh: 若延续20世纪80年代的趋势，这一目标本可以实现。

authentic.sentenceEn: Those who have produced their own music, or even fans of authentic , artistic music, will also argue that a computer could never emulate the work (and human touch) of a true musician.
authentic.translationZh: 那些自己创作音乐的人，甚至是真正艺术音乐的爱好者，也会认为计算机永远无法模仿真正音乐家的作品（以及其中的人文温度）。
authentic.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第3段，第4句

authentic.sentenceEn: I feel more seen than I ever have, and for the first time in my life, I have a clear-eyed view of myself that is authentic , compassionate and accepting.
authentic.translationZh: 我感觉自己比以往任何时候都更被看见，并且人生中第一次能够以清晰的视角看待真实、悲悯且接纳的自己。
authentic.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第1段，第5句

authentic.sentenceEn: Although humans are more advanced and intelligent, animals are more genuine and authentic in their behavior and responses than human beings.
authentic.translationZh: 尽管人类更为先进和聪慧，但动物在行为和反应上比人类更加真诚和真实。
authentic.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第1段，第6句

authentic.sentenceEn: When we hide our emotions and our true feelings, we stop being genuine, spontaneous and authentic in our relationships.
authentic.translationZh: 当我们隐藏自己的情绪和真实感受时，在人际关系中我们就不再真诚、自然和真实。
authentic.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第1段，第3句

authentic.sentenceEn: Demand for authentic Italian food in China is growing rapidly.
authentic.translationZh: 中国对正宗意大利食品的需求正在迅速增长。
authentic.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第11段，第3句

authentic.sentenceEn: It would hinder the understanding of authentic music.
authentic.translationZh: 这会阻碍人们对真正音乐的理解。
